1.1.1.3 validate_json_request()

注释已读 · 原始行号 658–673
658async def validate_json_request(raw_request: Request):
659 """Validate that the request content-type is application/json.
660 tip fastapi 组件，验证 请求
661 """
662 content_type = raw_request.headers.get("content-type", "").lower()
663 media_type = content_type.split(";", maxsplit=1)[0]
664 if media_type != "application/json":
665 raise RequestValidationError(
666 errors=[
667 {
668 "loc": ["header", "content-type"],
669 "msg": "Unsupported Media Type: Only 'application/json' is allowed",
670 "type": "value_error",
671 }
672 ]
673 )

1.1.1.4 generate_request()

注释已读 · 原始行号 912–969
内含已读局部方法：generate_request.stream_results
912# fastapi implicitly converts json in the request to obj (dataclass)
913@app.api_route(
914 "/generate",
915 methods=["POST", "PUT"],
916 response_class=SGLangORJSONResponse,
917)
918async def generate_request(obj: GenerateReqInput, request: Request):
919 """Handle a generate request.
920 NOTE 请求入口
921 """
922 if envs.SGLANG_ENABLE_REQUEST_HEADER_OVERRIDES.get():
923 apply_header_overrides(obj, request.headers)
924 # note 流式链路
925 if obj.stream:
926
927 async def stream_results() -> AsyncIterator[bytes]:
928 try:
929 # note 支持 stream，generate_request 通过 yield 返回结果
930 async for out in _global_state.tokenizer_manager.generate_request(
931 obj, request
932 ):
933 # tip 通过 yield 向上游返回结果
934 yield b"data: " + dumps_json(out) + b"\n\n"
935 except ValueError as e:
936 # A client disconnect also surfaces here. It's a client-side
937 # cancellation, not a server error or bad input -- log it and
938 # stop (the request was already aborted upstream) instead of
939 # emitting a 400.
940 if request is not None and await request.is_disconnected():
941 logger.info(f"[http_server] Client disconnected: {e}")
942 return
943 out = {
944 "error": {
945 "message": str(e),
946 "type": "invalid_request_error",
947 "code": getattr(e, "status_code", 400),
948 "retryable": False,
949 }
950 }
951 logger.error(f"[http_server] Error: {e}")
952 yield b"data: " + dumps_json(out) + b"\n\n"
953 yield b"data: [DONE]\n\n"
954
955 return StreamingResponse(
956 stream_results(),
957 media_type="text/event-stream",
958 background=_global_state.tokenizer_manager.create_abort_task(obj),
959 )
960 else:
961 # note 非流式链路，await获取全部结果
962 try:
963 ret = await _global_state.tokenizer_manager.generate_request(
964 obj, request
965 ).__anext__()
966 return orjson_response(ret)
967 except ValueError as e:
968 logger.error(f"[http_server] Error: {e}")
969 return _create_error_response(e)

1.1.1.7 launch_server()

注释已读 · 原始行号 2811–2884
2811def launch_server(
2812 # python3 -m sglang.launch_server --model-path qwen/qwen2.5-0.5b-instruct --port 30000 中的参数
2813 server_args: ServerArgs,
2814 # 创建分词管理器（TokenizerManager）的函数，默认使用标准初始化逻辑。
2815 # tip init 对象
2816 init_tokenizer_manager_func: Callable = init_tokenizer_manager,
2817 # 调度器（Scheduler）子进程的入口函数，负责初始化调度器并运行调度循环 NOTE 设置了默认值
2818 # tip run xx process() 和 init 对象在命名上就有区别
2819 run_scheduler_process_func: Callable = run_scheduler_process,
2820 # 反分词管理器（DetokenizerManager）子进程的入口函数，负责将输出 token 解码为文本。
2821 run_detokenizer_process_func: Callable = run_detokenizer_process,
2822 # HTTP 服务路径的预热函数，默认通过预热请求检查服务是否可用。
2823 execute_warmup_func: Callable = _execute_server_warmup,
2824 # 服务完成初始化和预热后的回调；未提供时不执行。
2825 launch_callback: Optional[Callable[[], None]] = None,
2826):
2827 """
2828 Launch SRT (SGLang Runtime) Server.
2829
2830 The SRT server consists of an HTTP server and an SRT engine.
2831
2832 - HTTP server: A FastAPI server that routes requests to the engine.
2833 - The engine consists of three components:NOTE 执行引擎的核心组件
2834 1. TokenizerManager: Tokenizes the requests and sends them to the scheduler.
2835 2. Scheduler (subprocess): Receives requests from the Tokenizer Manager, schedules batches, forwards them, and sends the output tokens to the Detokenizer Manager.
2836 3. DetokenizerManager (subprocess): Detokenizes the output tokens and sends the result back to the Tokenizer Manager.
2837
2838 Note:
2839 1. The HTTP server, Engine, and TokenizerManager all run in the main process.
2840 2. Inter-process communication is done through IPC (each process uses a different port) via the ZMQ library. NOTE
2841 """
2842
2843 # Launch subprocesses
2844 # NOTE 太重要了，启动服务重要组件
2845 # 主进程里只有 TokenizerManager；Scheduler 和 DetokenizerManager 都是 mp.Process 子进程，彼此靠 ZMQ（ZeroMQ）通信
2846 (
2847 tokenizer_manager, # tip
2848 template_manager,
2849 port_args,
2850 scheduler_init_result,
2851 subprocess_watchdog,
2852 _weight_cache_daemon_procs,
2853 ) = Engine._launch_subprocesses( # 调用一个函数返回变量列表
2854 server_args=server_args,
2855 init_tokenizer_manager_func=init_tokenizer_manager_func,
2856 run_scheduler_process_func=run_scheduler_process_func,
2857 run_detokenizer_process_func=run_detokenizer_process_func,
2858 )
2859
2860 if envs.SGLANG_RUST_SERVER.get():
2861 # The Rust server serves api-server, tokenizer, and detokenizer, so the
2862 # main process has no Python HTTP server / tokenizer manager to run.
2863 # Run a warmup /generate before advertising readiness: the Rust /health
2864 # and /get_model_info endpoints are static (200 as soon as the server
2865 # binds, before any forward pass), so without this the first real request
2866 # pays the cold-start cost (observed as a >60s first generation).
2867 if not get_serving().skip_server_warmup:
2868 _execute_server_warmup(server_args)
2869 logger.info("The server is fired up and ready to roll!")
2870 if launch_callback is not None:
2871 launch_callback()
2872 scheduler_init_result.block_until_scheduler_exits()
2873 else:
2874 # NOTE 将重要组件和 http 服务绑定并启动
2875 _setup_and_run_http_server(
2876 server_args,
2877 tokenizer_manager, # tip
2878 template_manager,
2879 port_args,
2880 scheduler_init_result.scheduler_infos,
2881 subprocess_watchdog, # tip
2882 execute_warmup_func=execute_warmup_func,

1117def _process_messages(
1118 self, request: ChatCompletionRequest, is_multimodal: bool
1119) -> MessageProcessingResult:
1120 """Process chat messages and apply chat template"""

1122 ctk = dict(request.chat_template_kwargs or {})
1123 for k, v in self.default_chat_template_kwargs.items():
1124 ctk.setdefault(k, v)
1125 request.chat_template_kwargs = ctk
1126 effort = ctk.get("reasoning_effort")
1127 if effort is not None and request.reasoning_effort is None:
1128 request.reasoning_effort = effort
1129
1130 # GptOss model needs to keep special tokens for harmony parsing
1131 if self.is_gpt_oss or self.is_gemma4:
1132 request.skip_special_tokens = False
1133
1134 self._patch_reasoning_skip_special_tokens(request)
1135
1136 thinking_mode = self._get_reasoning_from_request(request)
1137 # SGLang's ReasonerGrammarBackend owns the reasoning prefix
1138 # when --reasoning-parser is configured, so builtin xgrammar
1139 # tags must describe only the post-reasoning tool-call suffix.
1140 xgrammar_reasoning = thinking_mode and (self.reasoning_parser is None)
1141 tool_call_constraint = None
1142
1143 # Apply chat template and its stop strings
1144 tools = None
1145 tool_call_stop = None
1146 required_parsed_natively = False
1147 effective_tools = self._effective_tools(request)
1148 if effective_tools and request.tool_choice != "none":
1149 request.skip_special_tokens = False
1150 if not isinstance(request.tool_choice, str):
1151 tools = [
1152 item.model_dump()
1153 for item in request.tools or []
1154 if item.function.name == request.tool_choice.function.name
1155 ] or None
1156 elif request.tools:
1157 tools = [item.model_dump() for item in request.tools]
1158 if self.tool_call_parser:

1160 effective_tools,

1163 )

1167 thinking_mode=xgrammar_reasoning,
1168 )
1169 required_parsed_natively = parser.detector.parses_required_natively()
1170 if self.chat_encoding_spec == "kimi_k3":
1171 tool_call_stop = parser.detector.eot_token
1172 if (
1173 tool_call_constraint is None
1174 and not required_parsed_natively
1175 and not (
1176 self.chat_encoding_spec == "kimi_k3"
1177 and self.tool_call_parser == "kimi_k3"
1178 )
1179 and (
1180 request.tool_choice == "required"
1181 or isinstance(request.tool_choice, ToolChoice)
1182 )
1183 ):
1184 json_schema = get_json_schema_constraint(
1185 effective_tools,
1186 request.tool_choice,
1187 parallel_tool_calls=request.parallel_tool_calls,
1188 )
1189 tool_call_constraint = ("json_schema", json_schema)
1190
1191 # When input_ids are provided, skip template tokenization entirely;
1192 # only stop tokens and tool_call_constraint are needed.
1193 if request.input_ids is not None:
1194 result = MessageProcessingResult(
1195 prompt="",
1196 prompt_ids=request.input_ids,
1197 image_data=None,
1198 audio_data=None,
1199 video_data=None,
1200 modalities=[],
1201 stop=request.stop or [],
1202 )
1203 elif self.template_manager.chat_template_name is None:

1205 else:
1206 result = self._apply_conversation_template(request, is_multimodal)
1207
1208 if tool_call_stop is not None:

1211 elif result.stop is None:
1212 result.stop = []
1213 else:
1214 result.stop = list(result.stop)
1215 if tool_call_stop not in result.stop:
1216 result.stop.append(tool_call_stop)
1217
1218 result.tool_call_constraint = tool_call_constraint
1219 result.require_reasoning = thinking_mode

1237

1245 ThinkingMode.THINKING if thinking_requested else ThinkingMode.CHAT
1246 )

1267 msg_dict,
1268 "openai",
1269 image_data,
1270 video_data,
1271 audio_data,
1272 modalities,
1273 )

1279 # OpenAI parts-list content here so the encoder sees a plain string.

1282 messages[i] = process_content_for_template_format(
1283 msg, "string", [], [], [], []
1284 )
1285
1286 for msg in messages:

1288 msg["content"] = ""

1291 template_content_format,
1292 image_data,
1293 video_data,
1294 audio_data,

1297 )
1298 msg.update(processed_msg)

1303 )
1304

1317 effort_source = env_val

1319 assert reasoning_effort_profile is not None

1321 reasoning_effort_profile
1322 ]

1324 effort_source if effort_source in accepted_efforts else None
1325 )

1329 )

1340 )

1346 prompt_ids, assistant_prefix
1347 )
1348 else:
1349 for msg_dict in copy.deepcopy(messages):
1350 if msg_dict.get("content") is None:
1351 msg_dict["content"] = ""
1352
1353 # Process content based on detected template format
1354 processed_msg = process_content_for_template_format(
1355 msg_dict,

1357 image_data,
1358 video_data,
1359 audio_data,

1361 )

1365 )

1371 self._handle_last_assistant_message(openai_compatible_messages, request)
1372 )
1373
1374 extra_template_kwargs = {}
1375 if request.reasoning_effort is not None:
1376 extra_template_kwargs["reasoning_effort"] = request.reasoning_effort
1377 if request.chat_template_kwargs:
1378 extra_template_kwargs.update(request.chat_template_kwargs)
1379
1380 rc = self.template_manager.reasoning_config

1390 )

1398 {"add_special_tokens": False}

1400 else {}

1408 return_dict=False,
1409 **extra_template_kwargs,
1410 )

1413 )
1414 except Exception:
1415 # If the first attempt fails, try with flat function-only format.
1416 # Some templates (e.g. Mistral) expect tools without the OpenAI wrapper.
1417 tools = (
1418 [t["function"] if "function" in t else t for t in tools]
1419 if tools
1420 else None
1421 )
1422 try:
1423 rendered_prompt = (
1424 self.tokenizer_manager.tokenizer.apply_chat_template(
1425 openai_compatible_messages,
1426 tokenize=False,
1427 add_generation_prompt=True,
1428 tools=tools,
1429 return_dict=False,
1430 **extra_template_kwargs,
1431 )
1432 )
1433 prompt_ids = self.tokenizer_manager.tokenizer.encode(
1434 rendered_prompt, **encode_kwargs
1435 )

1446 )

1453 audio_data = audio_data if audio_data else None
1454 video_data = video_data if video_data else None
1455 modalities = modalities if modalities else []
1456 return MessageProcessingResult(

1458 prompt_ids=prompt_ids,

1532async def _handle_streaming_request(
1533 self,
1534 adapted_request: GenerateReqInput,
1535 request: ChatCompletionRequest,
1536 raw_request: Request,
1537) -> Union[StreamingResponse, ErrorResponse]:
1538 """Handle streaming chat completion request"""
1539 generator = self._generate_chat_stream(adapted_request, request, raw_request)
1540
1541 # Kick-start the generator to trigger validation before HTTP 200 is sent.
1542 # If validation fails (e.g., context length exceeded), we can still return
1543 # a proper HTTP 400 error response instead of streaming it as SSE payload.
1544 try:
1545 first_chunk = await generator.__anext__()
1546 except ValueError as e:
1547 return self.create_error_response(str(e))
1548
1549 async def prepend_first_chunk():
1550 yield first_chunk
1551 async for chunk in generator:
1552 yield chunk
1553
1554 return StreamingResponse(
1555 prepend_first_chunk(),
1556 media_type="text/event-stream",
1557 background=self.tokenizer_manager.create_abort_task(adapted_request),
1558 )

1560async def _generate_chat_stream(
1561 self,
1562 adapted_request: GenerateReqInput,
1563 request: ChatCompletionRequest,
1564 raw_request: Request,
1565) -> AsyncGenerator[str, None]:
1566 """Generate streaming chat completion response"""
1567 # Parsers for tool calls and reasoning
1568 parser_dict = {}
1569 reasoning_parser_dict = {}
1570
1571 # State tracking for streaming
1572 is_firsts = {}
1573 stream_offsets = {}
1574 n_prev_tokens = {}
1575 has_tool_calls = {}
1576 finish_reasons = {}
1577
1578 # Usage tracking
1579 prompt_tokens = {}
1580 reasoning_tokens = {}
1581 completion_tokens = {}
1582 cached_tokens = {}
1583 hidden_states = {}
1584 routed_experts = {}
1585 cached_tokens_details = {}
1586 spec_tokens_details = {}
1587 image_tokens = {}
1588 audio_tokens = {}
1589 video_tokens = {}
1590
1591 stream_started = False
1592 try:
1593 include_usage, continuous_usage_stats = should_include_usage(
1594 request.stream_options,
1595 self.tokenizer_manager.server_args.stream_response_default_include_usage,
1596 )
1597
1598 async for content in self.tokenizer_manager.generate_request(
1599 adapted_request, raw_request
1600 ):
1601 index = content.get("index", 0)
1602
1603 prompt_tokens[index] = self._reported_prompt_tokens(
1604 content["meta_info"]
1605 )
1606 completion_tokens[index] = content["meta_info"].get(
1607 "completion_tokens", 0
1608 )
1609 reasoning_tokens[index] = content["meta_info"].get(
1610 "reasoning_tokens", 0
1611 )
1612 cached_tokens[index] = content["meta_info"].get("cached_tokens", 0)
1613 hidden_states[index] = content["meta_info"].get("hidden_states", None)
1614 routed_experts[index] = content["meta_info"].get("routed_experts", None)
1615 cached_tokens_details[index] = content["meta_info"].get(
1616 "cached_tokens_details", None
1617 )
1618 if request.return_spec_tokens_details:
1619 spec_tokens_details[index] = spec_tokens_details_from_meta_info(
1620 content["meta_info"]
1621 )
1622 image_tokens[index] = content["meta_info"].get("image_tokens", 0)
1623 audio_tokens[index] = content["meta_info"].get("audio_tokens", 0)
1624 video_tokens[index] = content["meta_info"].get("video_tokens", 0)
1625
1626 # Handle logprobs
1627 choice_logprobs = None
1628 if request.logprobs:
1629 n_prev_token = n_prev_tokens.get(index, 0)
1630 total_output_logprobs = content["meta_info"][
1631 "output_token_logprobs_length"
1632 ]
1633 if n_prev_token < total_output_logprobs:
1634 choice_logprobs = self._process_streaming_logprobs(
1635 content, n_prev_token, total_output_logprobs
1636 ).model_dump()
1637 n_prev_tokens[index] = total_output_logprobs
1638
1639 finish_reason = content["meta_info"].get("finish_reason", None)
1640 finish_reason_type = finish_reason["type"] if finish_reason else None
1641
1642 # Track finish_reason for each index
1643 if finish_reason_type:
1644 # Abort with an explicit error status_code is a system error
1645 # (timeout, OOM, validation): emit a streaming error chunk.
1646 # A graceful abort (no status_code, e.g. user-initiated via
1647 # /abort_request or session lifecycle cleanup) falls through
1648 # to the normal chunk path, matching the non-stream behavior
1649 # in tokenizer_manager._handle_abort_finish_reason.
1650 if finish_reason_type == "abort" and isinstance(
1651 finish_reason.get("status_code"), HTTPStatus
1652 ):
1653 code = finish_reason["status_code"]
1654 error = self.create_streaming_error_response(
1655 finish_reason.get("message", "Generation aborted."),
1656 code.name,
1657 code.value,
1658 )
1659 yield f"data: {error}\n\n"
1660 break
1661 finish_reasons[index] = finish_reason
1662
1663 # First chunk with role
1664 if is_firsts.get(index, True):
1665 is_firsts[index] = False
1666 yield build_sse_content(
1667 chunk_id=content["meta_info"]["id"],
1668 created=int(time.time()),
1669 model=request.model,
1670 index=index,
1671 role="assistant",
1672 content="",
1673 )
1674 stream_started = True
1675
1676 # Generate streaming content (override in subclass for custom behavior)
1677 async for chunk in self._generate_stream_content(
1678 content=content,
1679 index=index,
1680 request=request,
1681 stream_offsets=stream_offsets,
1682 reasoning_parser_dict=reasoning_parser_dict,
1683 parser_dict=parser_dict,
1684 has_tool_calls=has_tool_calls,
1685 choice_logprobs=choice_logprobs,
1686 finish_reason_type=finish_reason_type,
1687 continuous_usage_stats=continuous_usage_stats,
1688 prompt_tokens=prompt_tokens,
1689 reasoning_tokens=reasoning_tokens,
1690 completion_tokens=completion_tokens,
1691 ):
1692 yield chunk
1693
1694 # Send finish_reason chunks for each index that completed
1695 for idx, finish_reason_data in finish_reasons.items():
1696 finish_reason_type = finish_reason_data["type"]
1697
1698 # Change finish_reason to "tool_calls" if we had tool calls and stopped naturally
1699 final_finish_reason = finish_reason_type
1700 if has_tool_calls.get(idx, False) and finish_reason_type == "stop":
1701 final_finish_reason = "tool_calls"
1702
1703 matched_stop = finish_reason_data.get("matched")
1704 yield build_sse_content(
1705 chunk_id=content["meta_info"]["id"],
1706 created=int(time.time()),
1707 model=request.model,
1708 index=idx,
1709 finish_reason=final_finish_reason,
1710 matched_stop=matched_stop,
1711 )
1712
1713 # Send hidden states if requested
1714 if request.return_hidden_states and hidden_states:
1715 for index, choice_hidden_states in hidden_states.items():
1716 if choice_hidden_states:
1717 response_hidden_states = process_hidden_states_for_response(
1718 choice_hidden_states, request.return_hidden_states
1719 )
1720 hidden_states_chunk = ChatCompletionStreamResponse(
1721 id=content["meta_info"]["id"],
1722 created=int(time.time()),
1723 choices=[
1724 ChatCompletionResponseStreamChoice(
1725 index=index,
1726 delta=DeltaMessage(
1727 hidden_states=response_hidden_states
1728 ),
1729 finish_reason=None, # Hidden states don't need finish_reason
1730 )
1731 ],
1732 model=request.model,
1733 )
1734 yield f"data: {hidden_states_chunk.model_dump_json()}\n\n"
1735
1736 sglext_routed = None
1737 if request.return_routed_experts and routed_experts:
1738 sglext_routed = next(
1739 (v for v in routed_experts.values() if v is not None), None
1740 )
1741
1742 sglext_cached_tokens_details = None
1743 if request.return_cached_tokens_details and cached_tokens_details:
1744 first_details = next(
1745 (v for v in cached_tokens_details.values() if v is not None), None
1746 )
1747 if first_details is not None:
1748 sglext_cached_tokens_details = cached_tokens_details_from_dict(
1749 first_details
1750 )
1751
1752 sglext_spec_tokens_details = None
1753 if request.return_spec_tokens_details and spec_tokens_details:
1754 spec_details = [
1755 spec_tokens_details[index]
1756 for index in sorted(spec_tokens_details)
1757 if spec_tokens_details[index] is not None
1758 ]
1759 if spec_details:
1760 sglext_spec_tokens_details = (
1761 spec_details if request.n > 1 else spec_details[0]
1762 )
1763
1764 if any(
1765 obj is not None
1766 for obj in [
1767 sglext_routed,
1768 sglext_cached_tokens_details,
1769 sglext_spec_tokens_details,
1770 ]
1771 ):
1772 sglext_chunk = ChatCompletionStreamResponse(
1773 id=content["meta_info"]["id"],
1774 created=int(time.time()),
1775 choices=[], # sglext is at response level
1776 model=request.model,
1777 sglext=SglExt(
1778 routed_experts=sglext_routed,
1779 cached_tokens_details=sglext_cached_tokens_details,
1780 spec_tokens_details=sglext_spec_tokens_details,
1781 ),
1782 )
1783 yield f"data: {sglext_chunk.model_dump_json()}\n\n"
1784
1785 # Additional usage chunk
1786 if include_usage:
1787 # Multimodal tokens are per-prompt (input side), so aggregate
1788 # once per prompt (first choice), matching prompt/cached semantics.
1789 total_image_tokens = sum(
1790 tok for idx, tok in image_tokens.items() if idx % request.n == 0
1791 )
1792 total_audio_tokens = sum(
1793 tok for idx, tok in audio_tokens.items() if idx % request.n == 0
1794 )
1795 total_video_tokens = sum(
1796 tok for idx, tok in video_tokens.items() if idx % request.n == 0
1797 )
1798 usage = UsageProcessor.calculate_streaming_usage(
1799 prompt_tokens,
1800 reasoning_tokens,
1801 completion_tokens,
1802 cached_tokens=cached_tokens,
1803 n_choices=request.n,
1804 enable_cache_report=self.tokenizer_manager.server_args.enable_cache_report,
1805 image_tokens=total_image_tokens,
1806 audio_tokens=total_audio_tokens,
1807 video_tokens=total_video_tokens,
1808 )
1809 usage_chunk = ChatCompletionStreamResponse(
1810 id=content["meta_info"]["id"],
1811 created=int(time.time()),
1812 choices=[], # Empty choices array as per OpenAI spec
1813 model=request.model,
1814 usage=usage,
1815 )
1816 yield f"data: {usage_chunk.model_dump_json()}\n\n"
1817
1818 except ValueError as e:
1819 if not stream_started:
1820 raise
1821 error = self.create_streaming_error_response(str(e))
1822 yield f"data: {error}\n\n"
1823
1824 yield "data: [DONE]\n\n"

注释已读 · 原始行号 1826–1860
1826async def _handle_non_streaming_request(
1827 self,
1828 adapted_request: GenerateReqInput,
1829 request: ChatCompletionRequest,
1830 raw_request: Request,
1831) -> Union[ChatCompletionResponse, ErrorResponse, ORJSONResponse]:
1832 """Handle non-streaming chat completion request
1833
1834 NOTE 处理 non-stream 请求
1835 参数说明：
1836 self: 当前处理器实例，例如 OpenAIServingChat，由 Python 自动传入。
1837 adapted_request/GenerateReqInput: 转换后的 SGLang 内部生成请求，包含提示词或 token IDs、
1838 采样参数等，用于执行推理。
1839 """
1840 try:
1841 # note 核心逻辑：
1842 # 处理输入 → 分词 → 发给 Scheduler → 模型推理 → 收到输出 → yield 结果 → 赋值给 ret
1843 response_generator = self.tokenizer_manager.generate_request(
1844 adapted_request, raw_request
1845 )
1846 # 处罚执行核心逻辑
1847 ret = await response_generator.__anext__()
1848 except ValueError as e:
1849 return self.create_error_response(str(e))
1850
1851 if not isinstance(ret, list):
1852 ret = [ret]
1853
1854 response = self._build_chat_response(
1855 request,
1856 ret,
1857 int(time.time()),
1858 )
1859
1860 return response

604def init_ipc_channels(self, port_args: PortArgs):
605 """
606 IPC：Inter-Process Communication 进程间通信
607 """
608 context = zmq.asyncio.Context(
609 2
610 ) # 异步版 Context，创建出的 socket 可以 await 收发
611 # NOTE 接收结果的管道：单 worker、多 worker 两种模式都会创建
612 # Detokenizer 进程 TokenizerManager 进程
613 # PUSH socket ---- 生成结果(共用通信地址 tokenizer_ipc_name) ----> PULL socket（后台 handle_loop 一直在收）
614 self.recv_from_detokenizer = get_zmq_socket(
615 context, # ZeroMQ 上下文，用于创建通信 socket。
616 zmq.PULL, # 这个是通信的 PULL 端，只收
617 port_args.tokenizer_ipc_name, # 接收结果所使用的通信地址，Detokenizer 往这里发
618 True, # 当前接收端绑定该地址（bind），由 Detokenizer 连接。
619 )
620 if get_serving().tokenizer_worker_num == 1:
621 # 【note】get_zmq_socket：创建并配置当前进程的 socket 对象。
622 # 单 Tokenizer worker 模式下的请求发送链路：
623 # TokenizerManager 进程 Scheduler 进程
624 # | |
625 # PUSH socket ---- 已分词的请求(共用通信地址 scheduler_input_ipc_name) ----> PULL socket
626 # | |
627 # send() recv()
628 #
629 self.send_to_scheduler = get_zmq_socket(
630 context, # ZeroMQ 上下文，用于创建通信 socket。
631 zmq.PUSH, # 这个是通信的 PUSH 端
632 port_args.scheduler_input_ipc_name, # 发送请求给 Scheduler 所使用的通信地址，双方使用同一个地址
633 True, # 当前发送端绑定该地址（bind），由接收端连接。
634 )
635 self.tokenizer_ipc_name = None
636 else:
637 # Use tokenizer_worker_ipc_name in multi-tokenizer mode
638 # 【note】初始化 send_to_scheduler
639 self.send_to_scheduler = get_zmq_socket(
640 context, zmq.PUSH, port_args.tokenizer_worker_ipc_name, False
641 )
642 self.tokenizer_ipc_name = port_args.tokenizer_ipc_name
643
644 self.load_snapshot_reader = create_load_snapshot_reader(
645 port_args,
646 caller="TokenizerManager",
647 )

850async def generate_request(
851 self,
852 req_obj: Union[GenerateReqInput, EmbeddingReqInput], # note: adapted_request
853 request: Optional[fastapi.Request] = None, # note: raw_request
854):
855 """
856 note 接收 http 推理请求的入口函数
857 """
858
859 # NOTE 【重点】创建监听 DetokenizerManager resp 的后台任务
860 # // 懒初始化，第一个请求过来在初始化
861 self.auto_create_handle_loop()
862
863 # Normalize the request
864 req_obj.normalize_batch_and_arguments()
865 self._set_default_priority(req_obj) # 设置请求优先级，请求中有对应参数
866
867 if (
868 isinstance(req_obj, GenerateReqInput)
869 and req_obj.max_thinking_tokens is not None
870 and not get_serving().enable_strict_thinking
871 ):
872 raise ValueError(
873 "max_thinking_tokens requires the server to be launched with "
874 "--enable-strict-thinking"
875 )
876
877 if isinstance(req_obj, GenerateReqInput) and req_obj.routed_dp_rank is not None:
878 dp_size = self.elastic_worker_count
879 if dp_size <= 1 and req_obj.routed_dp_rank == 0:
880 logger.debug(
881 f"routed_dp_rank={req_obj.routed_dp_rank} is ignored because dp_size={dp_size}"
882 )
883 elif req_obj.routed_dp_rank < 0 or req_obj.routed_dp_rank >= dp_size:
884 raise ValueError(
885 f"routed_dp_rank={req_obj.routed_dp_rank} out of range [0, {dp_size})"
886 )
887
888 # note 将 rid 对应的 ReqState 保存到 rid_to_state
889 self._init_req_state(req_obj, request)
890 try:
891 # get_disagg()：获取分离部署相关配置
892 if get_disagg().language_only:
893 self._handle_epd_disaggregation_encode_request(req_obj)
894
895 # Log the request 记录收到请求的日志
896 self.request_logger.log_received_request(req_obj, self.tokenizer, request)
897
898 # 如果服务已暂停，则等待恢复后继续处理。
899 async with self.is_pause_cond:
900 await self.is_pause_cond.wait_for(lambda: not self.is_pause)
901
902 # 获取模型更新读锁，并校验和解析本次请求的 LoRA 配置。
903 async with self.model_update_lock.reader_lock:
904 # 定义：使用 async def 定义的异步函数
905 # 调用：请求 async def func_x() 时返回一个待执行的协程对象
906 # 执行：await 执行该协程，并等待方法完成后再继续执行后面的代码
907 await self._validate_and_resolve_lora(req_obj)
908
909 # Tokenize the request and send it to the scheduler
910 if req_obj.is_single:
911 # NOTE 对数据进行 tokenize
912 tokenized_obj = await self._tokenize_one_request(req_obj)
913 state = self.rid_to_state[req_obj.rid]
914 if req_obj.return_prompt_token_ids:
915 # 如果调用方要求返回提示词 token IDs，则保存到请求状态中。
916 state.prompt_token_ids = list(tokenized_obj.input_ids)
917 # NOTE 将请求给到 Scheduler 并等待结果
918 # 结果返回链路：Scheduler -> DetokenizerManager -> TokenizerManager(_wait_one_response 在监听获取信息)
919 self._send_one_request(tokenized_obj)
920 # note _wait_one_response 用于监听获取结果
921 # for ... _wait_one_response(...) 是遍历获取 _wait_one_response 中的 yield/生成器 返回的结果
922 # yield response 表示向上游返回 response，上游可以通过 next(x) 或者也通过 for 获取（注意，这里的yeild和 _wait_one_response 中的yield没语法联系）
923 # 补充：yield 支持实现 chat stream api，yield经常用来实现在数据通道中的数据流式传输
924 # 这里的 async 是和上游使用 wait 调用思路比较类似，上游直接wait表示执行并等待获取结果
925 async for response in self._wait_one_response(req_obj, request):
926 yield response
927 else:
928 # 批量请求由此方法统一组织分词、发送和等待结果。
929 async for response in self._handle_batch_request(req_obj, request):
930 # 将取得的批量请求结果交给调用方。
931 yield response
932 except BaseException:
933 # _init_req_state created a rid_to_state entry per (sub-)request up
934 # front. The normal remover is the scheduler-response path
935 # (_handle_batch_output), so a failure *before* a request reaches the
936 # scheduler -- e.g. input-length validation rejecting an over-context
937 # request -- would otherwise leak those entries forever. Drop any that
938 # are still pending; entries already removed on the normal completion
939 # path are left untouched (pop is a no-op).
940 # 异常退出时清理尚未移除的请求状态，并向调用方继续抛出异常。
941 self._discard_pending_req_states(req_obj)
942 raise

995async def _tokenize_texts(
996 self, texts: Union[str, List[str]], is_cross_encoder: bool = False
997) -> Union[
998 Tuple[List[int], Optional[List[int]]],
999 Tuple[List[List[int]], Optional[List[List[int]]]],
1000]:
1001 """对输入进行token化"""
1002 if not texts or self.tokenizer is None:
1003 raise ValueError("texts cannot be empty and tokenizer must be initialized")
1004
1005 # Step 1: Detect input format and prepare for tokenization
1006 input_format = self._detect_input_format(texts, is_cross_encoder)
1007 tokenizer_input = self._prepare_tokenizer_input(texts, input_format)
1008 original_batch_size = len(texts) if not isinstance(texts, str) else 1
1009
1010 # Step 2: Set up tokenizer arguments
1011 tokenizer_kwargs = (
1012 {"return_token_type_ids": is_cross_encoder} if is_cross_encoder else {}
1013 )
1014
1015 # Step 3: Choose tokenization strategy
1016 use_async_tokenizer = (
1017 self.async_dynamic_batch_tokenizer is not None
1018 and input_format == InputFormat.SINGLE_STRING
1019 )
1020
1021 if use_async_tokenizer:
1022 logger.debug("Using async dynamic batch tokenizer for single text")
1023 result = await self.async_dynamic_batch_tokenizer.encode(
1024 tokenizer_input[0], **tokenizer_kwargs
1025 )
1026 # Convert to batch format for consistency
1027 input_ids = [result["input_ids"]]
1028 token_type_ids = (
1029 [result["token_type_ids"]]
1030 if is_cross_encoder and result.get("token_type_ids")
1031 else None
1032 )
1033 else:
1034 logger.debug(f"Using regular tokenizer for {len(tokenizer_input)} inputs")
1035
1036 if not is_cross_encoder and (not getattr(self.tokenizer, "is_fast", False)):
1037 # NOTE self.tokenizer.encode(t) 是使用 tokenizer 对输入进行token化
1038 input_ids = [self.tokenizer.encode(t) for t in tokenizer_input]
1039 token_type_ids = None
1040 else:
1041 encoded = self.tokenizer(tokenizer_input, **tokenizer_kwargs)
1042 input_ids = encoded["input_ids"]
1043 token_type_ids = (
1044 encoded.get("token_type_ids") if is_cross_encoder else None
1045 )
1046
1047 # vLLM's OpenAI embeddings endpoint includes special tokens for
1048 # encoder models. EmbeddingGemma's restored Gemma tokenizer adds BOS
1049 # but, by its checkpoint default, omits EOS. Add EOS explicitly here
1050 # rather than mutating tokenizer-global post-processing state.
1051 if (
1052 self.model_config.is_embedding_gemma
1053 and self.tokenizer.eos_token_id is not None
1054 ):
1055 input_ids = [
1056 (
1057 ids
1058 if ids and ids[-1] == self.tokenizer.eos_token_id
1059 else [*ids, self.tokenizer.eos_token_id]
1060 )
1061 for ids in input_ids
1062 ]
1063
1064 # Step 4: Extract results based on input format
1065 return self._extract_tokenizer_results(
1066 input_ids, token_type_ids, input_format, original_batch_size
1067 )

1222 try:
1223 item.set_hash(int(hex_hash, 16))
1224 except (TypeError, ValueError):
1225 logger.warning(

1228 hex_hash,
1229 )
1230 if (
1231 envs.SGLANG_MM_PRECOMPUTE_HASH.get()
1232 and mm_inputs
1233 and mm_inputs.mm_items
1234 ):
1235 for item in mm_inputs.mm_items:
1236 if isinstance(item, MultimodalDataItem):
1237 item.set_pad_value()
1238 else:
1239 mm_inputs = None

1283def _validate_one_request(
1284 self, obj: Union[GenerateReqInput, EmbeddingReqInput], input_ids: List[int]
1285) -> None:
1286 """Validates that the input token count and the requested token count doesn't exceed the model's context length.
1287
1288 校验输入长度，并按配置检查本次请求的总 token 预算是否超过模型上下文长度。 requested token count 理解为 max_new_tokens。
1289 总预算 = 输入 token 数 + max_new_tokens（最多生成多少 token）。
1290 max_new_tokens 是生成上限，不是实际已生成的数量。
1291 """
1292 # FIXME: unify the length validation logic with the one in the scheduler.
1293 _max_req_len = self.context_len
1294 input_token_num = len(input_ids) if input_ids is not None else 0
1295 input_token_num += self.num_reserved_tokens
1296
1297 # Validate input length
1298 if input_token_num >= self.context_len:
1299 if self.allow_auto_truncate:
1300 logger.warning(
1301 f"The input ({input_token_num} tokens) is longer than the "
1302 f"model's context length ({self.context_len} tokens). "
1303 "Truncating the input."
1304 )
1305 del input_ids[_max_req_len:]
1306 input_token_num = len(input_ids)
1307 else:
1308 raise ValueError(
1309 f"The input ({input_token_num} tokens) is longer than the "
1310 f"model's context length ({self.context_len} tokens)."
1311 )
1312
1313 # Validate total tokens (input + max_new_tokens)
1314 max_new_tokens = obj.sampling_params.get("max_new_tokens")
1315 if (
1316 self.validate_total_tokens
1317 and max_new_tokens is not None
1318 and (max_new_tokens + input_token_num) > _max_req_len
1319 ):
1320 if self.allow_auto_truncate:
1321 logger.warning(
1322 f"Requested token count ({input_token_num} input + {max_new_tokens} new) "
1323 f"exceeds the model's context length ({self.context_len} tokens). "
1324 "Truncating max_new_tokens."
1325 )
1326 obj.sampling_params["max_new_tokens"] = max(
1327 0, _max_req_len - input_token_num
1328 )
1329 else:
1330 total_tokens = max_new_tokens + input_token_num
1331 error_msg = (
1332 f"Requested token count exceeds the model's maximum context length "
1333 f"of {self.context_len} tokens. You requested a total of {total_tokens} "
1334 f"tokens: {input_token_num} tokens from the input messages and "
1335 f"{max_new_tokens} tokens for the completion. Please reduce the number "
1336 f"of tokens in the input messages or the completion to fit within the limit."
1337 )
1338 raise ValueError(error_msg)
1339
1340 # Validate embedding requests
1341 if isinstance(obj, EmbeddingReqInput) and self.is_generation:
1342 raise ValueError(
1343 "This model does not appear to be an embedding model by default. "
1344 "Please add `--is-embedding` when launching the server or try another model."
1345 )
1346
1347 # Validate Matryoshka embeddings
1348 if isinstance(obj, EmbeddingReqInput):
1349 self._validate_for_matryoshka_dim(obj)
1350
1351 # Validate generation-specific fields
1352 if isinstance(obj, GenerateReqInput):
1353 self._validate_token_ids_logprob(obj)
1354 requested_hidden_mode = get_request_return_hidden_states_mode(
1355 obj.return_hidden_states
1356 )
1357 server_hidden_mode = get_server_return_hidden_states_mode()
1358 if requested_hidden_mode > server_hidden_mode:
1359 if server_hidden_mode.need_capture():
1360 raise ValueError(
1361 "The requested return_hidden_states mode exceeds the "
1362 f"server maximum `{get_exec().features.return_hidden_states_mode}`. "
1363 "Please launch with `--return-hidden-states-mode full` "
1364 "to allow return_hidden_states=True."
1365 )
1366 raise ValueError(
1367 "The server is not configured to return hidden states. "
1368 "Please set `--return-hidden-states-mode last`, "
1369 "`--return-hidden-states-mode full`, or the legacy "
1370 "`--enable-return-hidden-states` flag."
1371 )
1372 if (
1373 obj.custom_logit_processor
1374 and not get_exec().features.enable_custom_logit_processor
1375 ):
1376 raise ValueError(
1377 "The server is not configured to enable custom logit processor. "
1378 "Please set `--enable-custom-logit-processor` to enable this feature."
1379 )

1462def _create_tokenized_object(
1463 self, # 当前 TokenizerManager 实例。

1465 GenerateReqInput, EmbeddingReqInput
1466 ], # 当前请求对象，包含请求 ID、采样参数等信息。
1467 input_text: str, # 请求中的输入文本，直接传 token IDs 时可为空。
1468 input_ids: Optional[List[int]], # 输入的 token ID 序列。
1469 input_embeds: Optional[
1470 List[List[float]]
1471 ] = None, # 调用方直接提供的输入向量，普通文本请求通常为 None。
1472 mm_inputs=None, # 预处理后的多模态数据，普通纯文本请求通常为 None。
1473 token_type_ids: Optional[
1474 List[int]
1475 ] = None, # 各 token 的类型或分段编号，普通文本生成通常为 None。
1476) -> Union[TokenizedGenerateReqInput, TokenizedEmbeddingReqInput]:
1477 """Create a tokenized request object from common parameters.
1478 对输入进行token化
1479 """
1480
1481 # 条件表达式 a = operation if con else non：con 为真时取 operation 的值，否则取 non 的值。
1482 # 这里 input_ids 不为 None 时转换为整数数组，否则 input_ids_arr 赋值为 None。

1484 array("q", input_ids) if input_ids is not None else None
1485 )
1486

1489 # explicitly passed in sampling_params
1490 if (
1491 self.preferred_sampling_params
1492 ): # self.preferred_sampling_params 是服务端配置的默认采样参数，例如 temperature、top_p
1493 sampling_kwargs = {**self.preferred_sampling_params, **obj.sampling_params}
1494 else:
1495 sampling_kwargs = obj.sampling_params

1497 sampling_kwargs = dict(sampling_kwargs)
1498 custom_params = dict(sampling_kwargs.get("custom_params") or {})
1499 custom_params["thinking_budget"] = obj.max_thinking_tokens
1500 sampling_kwargs["custom_params"] = custom_params
1501 # SamplingParams(**sampling_kwargs)
1502 # msgspec.Struct.init()
1503 # SamplingParams.post_init()
1504 sampling_params = self.sampling_params_class(**sampling_kwargs)

1508 sampling_params.verify(self.model_config.vocab_size)
1509

1518 bootstrap_room = obj.bootstrap_room

1.3.2.12 _wait_one_response()

注释已读 · 原始行号 1841–1972
1841async def _wait_one_response(
1842 self,
1843 obj: Union[GenerateReqInput, EmbeddingReqInput],
1844 request: Optional[fastapi.Request] = None,
1845):
1846 """Wait for the response of one request.
1847 tip 等待 DeTokenizerManager 返回的结果
1848 """
1849 state = self.rid_to_state[obj.rid]
1850 # Not all request types have `stream` (e.g., EmbeddingReqInput). Default to non-streaming.
1851 is_stream = getattr(obj, "stream", False)
1852 while True:
1853 try:
1854 # note 阻塞等待直到：
1855 # 1）state.event.set() 被调用
1856 # 2）或者 _REQUEST_STATE_WAIT_TIMEOUT 时间到达的时候抛出 asyncio.TimeoutError 超时异常
1857 await asyncio.wait_for(
1858 state.event.wait(), timeout=_REQUEST_STATE_WAIT_TIMEOUT
1859 )
1860 except asyncio.TimeoutError:
1861 # tip 超时：客户端已断开则中止请求，否则 continue 继续等
1862 if (
1863 request is not None
1864 and not obj.background
1865 and await request.is_disconnected()
1866 ):
1867 # Abort the request for disconnected requests (non-streaming, waiting queue)
1868 self.abort_request(obj.rid)
1869 # Use exception to kill the whole call stack and asyncio task
1870 raise ValueError(
1871 f"Request is disconnected from the client side (type 1). Abort request {obj.rid=}"
1872 )
1873 continue
1874
1875 # Drain all pending outputs atomically.
1876 # Drain: to remove all items from a queue or buffer until it is empty
1877 # atomically: as a single, indivisible operation that cannot be interrupted
1878 out_list = state.out_list # 获取目前积攒的全部结果
1879 state.out_list = [] # 清空积攒结果的变量
1880 finished = state.finished # 判断推理是否完成
1881 state.event.clear() # wait() -> set() -> clear() -> wait()
1882
1883 # With incremental streaming, each chunk is a delta — coalesce
1884 # multiple queued chunks to avoid dropping token ids.
1885 incremental_stream = is_stream and self.incremental_streaming_output
1886 if incremental_stream and len(out_list) > 1:
1887 # tip 增量流式且积压多块：每块只是 delta，合并成一块，避免丢 token
1888 out = self._coalesce_streaming_chunks(
1889 out_list,
1890 obj.rid,
1891 state.customized_info_accumulated.keys(),
1892 )
1893 else:
1894 # tip 非流式/非增量流式：每个 out 都是 state.output_ids 等累计值的快照，最后一个最全，前面的可丢弃
1895 # NOTE out_list 类型是 List[Dict[Any, Any]]，则 out 类型是 dict
1896 out = out_list[-1]
1897
1898 # Resolve deferred text for non-incremental streaming.
1899 # _handle_batch_output sets "text": None on intermediate chunks
1900 # to avoid O(n) string rebuild per step (O(n^2) total).
1901 if (
1902 is_stream
1903 and not incremental_stream
1904 and "text" in out
1905 and out["text"] is None
1906 ):
1907 out["text"] = (
1908 state.get_text()
1909 ) # 流式链路， NOTE 非流失链路在 _handle_batch_output 中
1910
1911 # Flattened so the downstream finished/logging/metrics logic is shared.
1912 if out.get("beam_results"):
1913 if not finished:
1914 # Intermediate beam output; skip until finished.
1915 continue
1916 out = build_beam_search_out(out)
1917
1918 if finished:
1919 # tip 请求已结束：记录日志和指标，yield 最后一个结果后 break 退出循环
1920 # Record response sent time right before we log finished results and metrics.
1921 if not state.time_stats.response_sent_to_client_time:
1922 state.time_stats.set_response_sent_to_client_time()
1923 out["meta_info"][
1924 "response_sent_to_client_ts"
1925 ] = state.time_stats.get_response_sent_to_client_realtime()
1926 self.request_logger.log_finished_request(
1927 obj,
1928 out,
1929 request=request,
1930 )
1931
1932 if self.request_metrics_exporter_manager.exporter_enabled():
1933 asyncio.create_task(
1934 self.request_metrics_exporter_manager.write_record(obj, out)
1935 )
1936
1937 # Check if this was an abort/error created by scheduler
1938 # tip finish_reason 是 dict 表示 Scheduler 侧中止或出错，改为返回错误结果
1939 if isinstance(out["meta_info"].get("finish_reason"), dict):
1940 abort_out = await self._handle_abort_finish_reason(
1941 out, state, is_stream
1942 )
1943 if abort_out is not None:
1944 yield abort_out
1945 break
1946
1947 # NOTE yield 最后一个结果后 break 退出循环
1948 yield out
1949 break
1950
1951 if is_stream:
1952 # tip 流式且未结束：yield 本块给上游，回到 while 等下一块
1953 # Record response sent time right before we send response.
1954 if not state.time_stats.response_sent_to_client_time:
1955 state.time_stats.set_response_sent_to_client_time()
1956 out["meta_info"][
1957 "response_sent_to_client_ts"
1958 ] = state.time_stats.get_response_sent_to_client_realtime()
1959 yield out
1960 else:
1961 # tip 非流式且未结束：不返回，只检查客户端是否断开，然后继续等
1962 if (
1963 request is not None
1964 and not obj.background
1965 and await request.is_disconnected()
1966 ):
1967 # Abort the request for disconnected requests (non-streaming, running)
1968 self.abort_request(obj.rid)
1969 # Use exception to kill the whole call stack and asyncio task
1970 raise ValueError(
1971 f"Request is disconnected from the client side (type 3). Abort request {obj.rid=}"
1972 )

2307def auto_create_handle_loop(self):
2308 """
2309 NOTE 创建监听 DetokenizerManager resp 的后台任务
2310 """
2311 # tip event_loop 已经创建了则直接返回
2312 if self.event_loop is not None:
2313 return
2314
2315 # Create and start the handle_loop task
2316 loop = get_or_create_event_loop()
2317 self.asyncio_tasks.add(
2318 # NOTE 创建监听 DetokenizerManager resp 的后台任务
2319 # 【重点】这里调用了 handle_loop 并异步执行，不阻塞上层调用继续执行
2320 loop.create_task(print_exception_wrapper(self.handle_loop))
2321 )
2322 # tip 创建了 event_loop 并赋值给 self.event_loop
2323 self.event_loop = loop
2324
2325 # We only add signal handler when the tokenizer manager is in the main thread
2326 # due to the CPython limitation.
2327 # 3. 仅在主线程注册 SIGTERM 和 SIGQUIT 的退出处理，这是 Python 的限制。
2328 if threading.current_thread() is threading.main_thread():
2329 signal_handler = self.signal_handler_class(self)
2330 loop.add_signal_handler(signal.SIGTERM, signal_handler.sigterm_handler)
2331 # Update the signal handler for the process. It overrides the sigquit handler in the launch phase.
2332 loop.add_signal_handler(
2333 signal.SIGQUIT, signal_handler.running_phase_sigquit_handler
2334 )
2335
2336 # 4. 启动退出监控任务，处理收到退出信号后的收尾工作。
2337 self.asyncio_tasks.add(
2338 loop.create_task(print_exception_wrapper(self.sigterm_watchdog))
2339 )

2341async def handle_loop(self):
2342 """The event loop that handles requests
2343
2344 NOTE 创建监听 DetokenizerManager resp 的后台任务
2345 """
2346 while True:
2347 with self.soft_watchdog.disable():
2348 # NOTE 阻塞从 DeTokenizerManager 获取 response
2349 # self.recv_from_detokenizer 是从 detokenizer 获取结果的 zmq 通信管道
2350 recv_obj = await async_sock_recv(self.recv_from_detokenizer)
2351 if isinstance(
2352 recv_obj,
2353 (BatchStrOutput, BatchEmbeddingOutput, BatchTokenIDOutput),
2354 ):
2355 # NOTE 将 DeTokenizerManager response 处理后赋值给 ReqState 并通知 wait_one_response()
2356 await self._handle_batch_output(recv_obj)
2357 else:
2358 self._result_dispatcher(recv_obj)
2359 self.last_receive_tstamp = real_time()
2360 self.soft_watchdog.feed()

2618 out_dict["pooled_hidden_state"] = pooled_hidden_states[i]
2619
2620 # Set first_token_time on the first output batch.
2621 # This is the single write point for first_token_time.
2622 if state.time_stats.first_token_time == 0.0:
2623 state.time_stats.set_first_token_time()
2624
2625 if state.finished:
2626 if state.time_stats.trace_ctx.tracing_enable:
2627 state.time_stats.trace_ctx.trace_set_root_attrs(
2628 self.convert_to_span_attrs(state, recv_obj, i)
2629 )
2630 state.time_stats.set_finished_time()
2631 meta_info["e2e_latency"] = state.time_stats.get_e2e_latency()
2632
2633 if get_spec().speculative_algorithm:
2634 self._calculate_spec_decoding_metrics(meta_info, recv_obj, i)
2635 if self.enable_metrics:
2636 scheduler_time_stats = (
2637 recv_obj.time_stats[i]
2638 if recv_obj.time_stats is not None
2639 else None
2640 )
2641 completion_tokens = (
2642 recv_obj.completion_tokens[i]
2643 if not isinstance(recv_obj, BatchEmbeddingOutput)
2644 else 0
2645 )
2646 meta_info.update(
2647 state.time_stats.convert_to_output_meta_info(
2648 scheduler_time_stats, completion_tokens
2649 )
2650 )
2651
2652 # tip 请求结束，从 rid_to_state 删除（state 仍被 _wait_one_response 持有）
2653 del self.rid_to_state[rid]
2654
2655 # Mark ongoing LoRA request as finished.
2656 if self.enable_lora and state.obj.lora_path:
2657 asyncio.create_task(self.lora_registry.release(state.obj.lora_id))
2658
2659 if out_dict is not None:
2660 # tip 结果放进 out_list，再由下面的 event.set() 唤醒 _wait_one_response 来取
2661 state.out_list.append(out_dict)
2662 pending_notify[rid] = state
2663
2664 if len(pending_notify) >= batch_notify_size:
2665 for s in pending_notify.values():
2666 s.event.set() # tip 通知 wait_one_response 接收到结果
2667 pending_notify = {}
2668 await asyncio.sleep(0)
2669
2670 if self.enable_metrics and state.obj.log_metrics:
2671 self.collect_metrics(state, recv_obj, i)
2672 if self.dump_requests_folder and state.finished and state.obj.log_metrics:
2673 self.dump_requests(state, out_dict)
2674 if self.crash_dump_folder and state.finished and state.obj.log_metrics:
2675 self.record_request_for_crash_dump(state, out_dict)
2676
2677 # handle_loop awaits next recv immediately
2678 for s in pending_notify.values():
2679 s.event.set() # tip 通知 wait_one_response 接收到结果

3582def _init_req_state(
3583 self,
3584 obj: Union[GenerateReqInput, EmbeddingReqInput],
3585 request: Optional[fastapi.Request] = None,
3586):
3587 """
3588 NOTE 为请求初始化 ReqState 并存入 TokenizerManager.rid_to_state（请求id及其对应的 请求状态/结果）
3589 """
3590 created_time = obj.received_time
3591
3592 external_trace_header = None
3593 if self.enable_trace:
3594 if obj.external_trace_header:
3595 # When the request comes from the rust grpc server or Engine there isn't a
3596 # real request object but we still need to propagate the trace context from
3597 # the trace context that is explicitly passed in
3598 external_trace_header = obj.external_trace_header
3599 elif request:
3600 external_trace_header = extract_trace_headers(request.headers)
3601 obj.external_trace_header = external_trace_header
3602
3603 # Normalize single/batch into a uniform list of (rid, sub_obj, bootstrap_room)
3604 # note is_single 表示单条请求， batch 是批推理请求
3605 if not hasattr(obj, "is_single") or obj.is_single:
3606 # tip rid：调用方传递；SGLang Model Gateway生成；SGLang 用uuid生成
3607 items = [(obj.rid, obj, getattr(obj, "bootstrap_room", None))]
3608 else:
3609 items = [
3610 (
3611 obj.rid[i],
3612 obj[i],
3613 (
3614 obj.bootstrap_room[i]
3615 if hasattr(obj, "bootstrap_room") and obj.bootstrap_room
3616 else None
3617 ),
3618 )
3619 for i in range(len(obj.rid))
3620 ]
3621
3622 for rid, sub_obj, bootstrap_room in items:
3623 # tip rid 主要是为了获取下游推理结果，这里避免重复值相互覆盖
3624 if rid in self.rid_to_state:
3625 raise ValueError(f"Duplicate request ID detected: {rid}")
3626 time_stats = APIServerReqTimeStats(disagg_mode=self.disaggregation_mode)
3627
3628 # NOTE 初始化 ReqState 并保存到 TokenizerManager.rid_to_state
3629 # 一个服务器示例默认有一个 TokenizerManager，可通过 --tokenizer-worker-num 配置
3630 state = ReqState([], False, asyncio.Event(), sub_obj, time_stats)
3631 self.rid_to_state[rid] = state
3632
3633 if self.enable_trace:
3634 time_stats.init_trace_ctx(rid, bootstrap_room, external_trace_header)
3635 time_stats.set_created_time(created_time)

271def _initialize_model(
272 model_config: ModelConfig,
273 load_config: LoadConfig,
274 quant_config: Optional[QuantizationConfig] = None,
275) -> nn.Module:
276 """Initialize a model with the given configurations.
277 创建模型参数，参考
278
279 ModelRunner.__init__()
280 → ModelRunner.initialize()
281 → ModelRunner.load_model()
282 → load_model_with_memory_saver()
283 → DefaultModelLoader.load_model()
284 │
285 ├─ ① _initialize_model()：创建模型和参数 // NOTE 这里
286 │ → Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration.__init__()
287 │ → Qwen3VLForConditionalGeneration.__init__()
288 │ → Qwen3_5ForCausalLM.__init__()
289 │ → VocabParallelEmbedding.__init__()
290 │ → UnquantizedEmbeddingMethod.create_weights()
291 │ ├─ 创建 weight，并注册到 embedding 层
292 │ └─ 把 embedding 层的 weight_loader 保存到 weight 上
293 │
294 └─ ② load_weights_and_postprocess()：加载实际权重
295 → Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration.load_weights()
296 → 根据参数名找到之前创建的 weight
297 → 取出 weight.weight_loader 并执行
298 → VocabParallelEmbedding.weight_loader()
299 → 把文件中的权重数据拷贝进 weight
300 """
301
302 # NOTE 从模型配置中获取模型架构
303 # 比如 qwen3.8-27B 是 Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration
304 model_class, _ = get_model_architecture(model_config)
305 # Decide the shared-experts-fusion question here, once per runner, before any
306 # layer exists: this is the only place a model class is instantiated, and it
307 # is the last point that still knows both the checkpoint's quantization and
308 # (through the build scope) whether this runner is a draft.
309 install_shared_experts_fusion_decision(
310 model_class, model_config.hf_config, quant_config
311 )
312 kwargs = {
313 "config": model_config.hf_config,
314 "quant_config": quant_config,
315 }
316
317 # Only add sparse head kwargs if envs.SGLANG_EMBEDDINGS_SPARSE_HEAD.is_set()
318 if envs.SGLANG_EMBEDDINGS_SPARSE_HEAD.is_set():
319 kwargs["sparse_head"] = envs.SGLANG_EMBEDDINGS_SPARSE_HEAD.get()
320 kwargs["model_path"] = model_config.model_path
321
322 if load_config.draft_model_idx is not None:
323 kwargs["draft_model_idx"] = load_config.draft_model_idx
324
325 # NOTE 创建模型架构类
326 #
327 # 比如 qwen3.8-27B 是 Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration
328 #
329 # │ → Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration.__init__()
330 # │ → Qwen3VLForConditionalGeneration.__init__()
331 # │ → Qwen3_5ForCausalLM.__init__()
332 # │ → VocabParallelEmbedding.__init__()
333 # │ → UnquantizedEmbeddingMethod.create_weights()
334 # │ ├─ 创建 weight，并注册到 embedding 层
335 # │ └─ 把 embedding 层的 weight_loader 保存到 weight 上
336 return model_class(**kwargs)

962def load_model(
963 self,
964 *,
965 model_config: ModelConfig,
966 device_config: DeviceConfig,
967) -> nn.Module:
968 """
969 NOTE 加载模型权重的核心方法
970 """
971 if hasattr(model_config, "modelopt_quant") and model_config.modelopt_quant:
972 # Load base model using shared method
973 model = self._load_modelopt_base_model(model_config)
974 # Note: DefaultModelLoader doesn't do additional quantization processing
975 # For full ModelOpt quantization, use ModelOptModelLoader
976 return model.eval()
977
978 target_device = torch.device(device_config.device)
979 quant_config = _get_quantization_config(model_config, self.load_config)
980 with set_default_torch_dtype(model_config.dtype):
981 with target_device:
982 # NOTE 重点，init 模型相关类，比如 Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration.__init__()
983 model = _initialize_model(
984 model_config, # tip 模型配置
985 self.load_config,
986 quant_config,
987 )
988 # NOTE 加载实际权重数据
989 #
990 # 1）_get_all_weights() 返回权重生成器；遍历时读取权重，需要时准备或下载文件
991 #
992 # 2）load_weights_and_postprocess()：// 加载实际权重
993 # → Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration.load_weights()
994 # → 根据参数名找到之前创建的 weight
995 # → 取出 weight.weight_loader 并执行
996 # → VocabParallelEmbedding.weight_loader()
997 # → 把文件中的权重数据拷贝进 weight
998 self.load_weights_and_postprocess(
999 model, # tip 模型对象，实际 checkpoint 权重数据尚未加载
1000 # NOTE 权重生成器被遍历后进入以下准备链路；使用本地目录时跳过下载
1001 # _get_all_weights(...)
1002 # → _get_weights_iterator(...)
1003 # → _prepare_weights(...)
1004 # → download_weights_from_hf(...)
1005 # → huggingface_hub.snapshot_download(...)
1006 self._get_all_weights(model_config, model),
1007 target_device,
1008 )
1009
1010 self.counter_after_loading_weights = time.perf_counter()
1011 return model.eval()

注释已读 · 原始行号 1013–1080
1013@staticmethod
1014def load_weights_and_postprocess(model, weights, target_device):
1015 # Used in tests to verify memory savings when using online quantization.
1016 if is_cuda_alike():
1017 peak_memory = torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated()
1018 logger.debug(
1019 "Peak GPU memory before loading weights: %s GiB",
1020 f"{peak_memory / GIB_BYTES:.3f}",
1021 )
1022 memory_start = get_available_gpu_memory(
1023 target_device.type, gpu_id=torch.cuda.current_device()
1024 )
1025
1026 quant_config = getattr(model, "quant_config", None)
1027 is_nvfp4_online = getattr(quant_config, "is_nvfp4_online", False)
1028 is_modelopt_fp4_online = (
1029 quant_config is not None
1030 and quant_config.get_name() == "modelopt_fp4"
1031 and not quant_config.is_checkpoint_nvfp4_serialized
1032 )
1033 is_mxfp8 = quant_config is not None and quant_config.get_name() == "mxfp8"
1034 if is_mxfp8:
1035 weights = (
1036 (
1037 f"{name}_inv" if name.endswith(".weight_scale") else name,
1038 loaded_weight,
1039 )
1040 for name, loaded_weight in weights
1041 )
1042
1043 if is_nvfp4_online or is_modelopt_fp4_online:
1044 # Scope exact FP4 quantization math to load-time conversion only;
1045 # restore the original environment before serving starts.
1046 with temp_set_env(
1047 FLASHINFER_DISABLE_FP4_QUANT_FAST_MATH="1",
1048 FLASHINFER_NVFP4_4OVER6="1",
1049 FLASHINFER_NVFP4_4OVER6_E4M3_USE_256="0",
1050 FLASHINFER_NVFP4_4OVER6_ERR_MODE="MSE",
1051 FLASHINFER_NVFP4_4OVER6_ERR_USE_FAST_MATH="1",
1052 ):
1053 model.load_weights(weights)
1054 if target_device.type == "cuda":
1055 torch.cuda.synchronize()
1056 torch.cuda.empty_cache()
1057 else:
1058 # NOTE 加载模型权重
1059 model.load_weights(weights)
1060
1061 # Used in tests to verify memory savings when using online quantization.
1062 if is_cuda_alike():
1063 memory_end = get_available_gpu_memory(
1064 target_device.type, gpu_id=torch.cuda.current_device()
1065 )
1066 logger.debug(
1067 "Memory increase during load_weights: %s GiB",
1068 f"{memory_start - memory_end:.3f}",
1069 )
1070
1071 for _, module in model.named_modules():
1072 quant_method = getattr(module, "quant_method", None)
1073 if quant_method is not None:
1074 # When quant methods need to process weights after loading
1075 # (for repacking, quantizing, etc), they expect parameters
1076 # to be on the global target device. This scope is for the
1077 # case where cpu offloading is used, where we will move the
1078 # parameters onto device for processing and back off after.
1079 with device_loading_context(module, target_device):
1080 quant_method.process_weights_after_loading(module)

1004def init_target_memory_pool(self):
1005 """Allocate target KV cache pools if they have not been allocated yet.
1006
1007 初始化 KV Cache 相关GPU显存池，核心链路：
1008 Scheduler.__init__()
1009 -> init_model_worker()
1010 -> init_memory_pools()
1011 -> init_target_memory_pool() // 当前方法
1012 -> tp_worker.alloc_memory_pool()
1013 -> model_runner.alloc_memory_pool()
1014 """
1015 if (
1016 self.tp_worker.model_runner.memory_pool_config is not None
1017 and self.tp_worker.model_runner.req_to_token_pool is not None
1018 and self.tp_worker.model_runner.token_to_kv_pool_allocator is not None
1019 ):
1020 return
1021 preloaded_weights_bytes = self.tp_worker.preloaded_weights_bytes
1022 if self.draft_worker is not None:
1023 preloaded_weights_bytes += self.draft_worker.preloaded_weights_bytes
1024 self.tp_worker.model_runner.account_preloaded_weights(preloaded_weights_bytes)
1025 # NOTE 重要，后边调用到 ModelRunner 的内存分配方法，初始化 ReqToTokenPool、KV Pool、TokenToKVPoolAllocator 等方法
1026 self.tp_worker.alloc_memory_pool()

1243def init_chunked_prefill(self):
1244 self.chunked_prefill_size = get_schedule().chunked_prefill_size
1245 self.prefill_decode_interval = get_schedule().prefill_decode_interval
1246 self._prefill_decode_interval_remaining = 0

1248 get_resolved_model_impl(self.model_config) == ModelImpl.TRANSFORMERS
1249 )
1250 if (
1251 self.chunked_prefill_size is not None
1252 and self.chunked_prefill_size > 0
1253 and self.model_config.is_multimodal
1254 and uses_transformers_backend
1255 ):
1256 logger.warning(
1257 "Chunked prefill is disabled for multimodal models with the "
1258 "Transformers backend to avoid partial multimodal chunk mismatches."
1259 )
1260 self.chunked_prefill_size = None
1261 elif self.chunked_prefill_size is not None and self.chunked_prefill_size <= 0:
1262 self.chunked_prefill_size = None

1264 self._pending_chunked_abort_req = None
1265 self.is_mixed_chunk = (
1266 self.chunked_prefill_size is not None and get_schedule().enable_mixed_chunk
1267 )
1268
1269 # Init the dynamic chunking predictor for PP
1270 # tip 动态分块大小：
1271 # 长上下文中，如果按照相同大小分块，越往后执行的越慢
1272 # 动态分块就是越往后切分的越小，让每一块的 prefill 计算大致相同
1273 # predict_next_chunk_size(history_len) 计算下一块的大小
1274 #
1275 # 越往后执行时间越长，因为耗时分两块：
1276 # 1）QKV 投影：和token数量有关
1277 # 2）注意力计算，和当前token总长度有关
1278 self.enable_dynamic_chunking = (
1279 get_schedule().enable_dynamic_chunking and self.ps.pp_size > 1
1280 )
1281 if self.enable_dynamic_chunking:
1282 try:
1283 self.profile_and_init_predictor()
1284 except Exception as e:
1285 logger.warning(
1286 f"[PP Dynamic Chunk] Failed to profile prefill latency: {e}. "
1287 "Dynamic chunking will be disabled."
1288 )
1289 self.enable_dynamic_chunking = False

注释已读 · 原始行号 1791–1832
1791def run_event_loop(self) -> None:
1792 """Run the scheduler's event loop.
1793
1794 tip： event 可以理解为 新的推理请求、组批执行 prefill/decode、收到结果给到 detokenizer_manager
1795 这个方法没有 while true，但是调用了 while true 的方法
1796
1797 Sets up the schedule stream and dispatches to the appropriate event loop.
1798 The event loop blocks until shutdown.
1799 """
1800 # Engine init (graph capture, warmups) is done; from here on any
1801 # Triton kernel device-load is a lazy first-use at serving time.
1802 triton_load_watch.install()
1803 triton_load_watch.mark_serving_started()
1804
1805 if use_mlx():
1806 # tip Apple 芯片 链路
1807 # MLX overlap uses mx.async_eval for CPU/GPU overlap,
1808 # not PyTorch MPS streams.
1809 dispatch_event_loop(self)
1810 return
1811
1812 self.schedule_stream = self.device_module.Stream(priority=0)
1813 if self.device == "cpu":
1814 self.schedule_stream.synchronize = lambda: None # No-op for CPU
1815 elif is_cuda() or _is_hip:
1816 # CUDA/HIP streams come from a fixed round-robin pool. Redraw if this
1817 # stream aliases forward_stream, which would eliminate scheduler
1818 # overlap. Only CUDA/HIP streams expose a ``cuda_stream`` handle;
1819 # other accelerators (e.g. NPU/XPU) skip the alias check.
1820 _redraws = 0
1821 while (
1822 self.schedule_stream.cuda_stream == self.forward_stream.cuda_stream
1823 and _redraws < 64
1824 ):
1825 self.schedule_stream = self.device_module.Stream(priority=0)
1826 _redraws += 1
1827 # The global WAR barrier fences the scheduler's next shared-buffer write
1828 # on the previous forward's read of the unified memory pool.
1829 self._war_barrier_enabled = is_cuda() or envs.SGLANG_ENABLE_WAR_BARRIER.get()
1830 with self.device_module.StreamContext(self.schedule_stream):
1831 # NOTE 核心方法
1832 dispatch_event_loop(self)

1848def event_loop_normal(self):
1849 """A normal scheduler loop."""
1850 while True:
1851 if self.gracefully_exit:
1852 break
1853
1854 # NOTE
1855 # 从 TokenizerManager 接收推理消息并发到任务队列
1856 # Receive requests
1857 recv_reqs = self.request_receiver.recv_requests()
1858 self.process_input_requests(recv_reqs)
1859 if self._engine_paused:
1860 continue
1861
1862 # NOTE
1863 # 从任务队列获取消息进行处理
1864 # Get the next batch to run
1865 plan = self.get_next_batch_to_run(
1866 running_batch=self.running_batch, last_batch=self.last_batch
1867 )
1868 # 更新调度器维护的运行批，供后续调度使用
1869 self.running_batch = plan.running_batch
1870 # NOTE 取出本轮待执行的批次，可能为 None
1871 batch = plan.batch_to_run
1872 self.cur_batch_for_debug = batch
1873
1874 # Launch the current batch
1875 if batch:
1876 result = self.run_batch(batch)
1877 self.process_batch_result(batch, result)
1878 else:
1879 # When the server is idle, do self-check and re-init some states.

1881 self.on_idle()
1882
1883 # Update last_batch
1884 self.last_batch = batch

1886 self.invariant_checker.self_check_during_busy()

1888@DynamicGradMode() # tip 让整个主循环运行时关闭梯度计算
1889def event_loop_overlap(self):
1890 """A scheduler loop that overlaps the CPU processing and GPU computation.
1891 - overlaps a and b：让 a 和 b 同时进行
1892
1893 1. SchedulerRequestReceiver.recv_requests()：接收并广播 TokenizerManager 的请求
1894 2. 任务入队（即加入到 waiting_queue)， waiting_queue 的作用：
1895 2.1 支持 批处理：任务在 waiting_queue 中攒着，组批后交给 GPU，批处理比单个处理 gpu 资源利用更高
1896 2.2 槽位或者 KV 编号不够用的时候，请求在 waiting_queue 中排队
1897 2.3 从 waiting_queue中选择组批的请求的时候也可以按照指定优先级处理
1898
1899 """
1900
1901 # Deque：双端队列，两端都能添加、取出元素。这里用来暂存各个 batch 及其执行结果。
1902 # Tuple：元组，按顺序组合多个元素，创建后不能增删或替换元素。这里每个元组包含两个元素：ScheduleBatch 和对应的结果
1903 self.result_queue: Deque[
1904 Tuple[ScheduleBatch, Union[GenerationBatchResult, EmbeddingBatchResult]]
1905 ] = deque() # deque() 创建空队列
1906
1907 def pop_and_process():
1908 # Process the results of the last batch
1909 # 从队头取出一组 batch 和结果
1910 tmp_batch, tmp_result = self.result_queue.popleft()
1911 # 处理这组结果 【TODO】待分析
1912 self.process_batch_result(tmp_batch, tmp_result)
1913
1914 while (
1915 True
1916 ): # tip 后续代码的 next batch 啥的，每一个batch都是只 while true 执行了一轮
1917 if self.gracefully_exit:
1918 break
1919
1920 # NOTE 【step 1】
1921 # Receive requests
1922 # recv_requests：1）使用 tp_rank=0 的节点收到请求；2）广播给其他 tp_rank 的节点
1923 # tip recv_reqs 格式是 List[Union[TokenizedGenerateReqInput, TokenizedEmbeddingReqInput, Any]]
1924 recv_reqs = self.request_receiver.recv_requests()
1925 # NOTE 【step 2】
1926 # 任务入队、即加入到 waiting queue
1927 self.process_input_requests(recv_reqs)
1928 if self._engine_paused:
1929 continue
1930
1931 # NOTE 【step 3】
1932 # 组批进行处理：gpu利用率、调度优先级
1933 #
1934 # plan 核心变量
1935 # 1）本轮要计算的 batch，例如 EXTEND、DECODE 或混合批 MIXED，也可能为空。
1936 # batch_to_run: Optional[ScheduleBatch]
1937 # 2）NOTE running_batch 是已经 prefill 完成，正在进行 decode 的请求
1938 # running_batch: ScheduleBatch
1939 #
1940 # Get the next batch to run
1941 plan = self.get_next_batch_to_run(
1942 # tips 标识请求集合，比如 今天天气 -> 阴天
1943 # 刚开始在init_running_status()中初始化为空对象
1944 # 后边设置该变量的代码见下一行
1945 running_batch=self.running_batch,
1946 last_batch=self.last_batch, # tips 标识上一轮跑的什么操作，比如 prefill(今天天气) 或者 decode(阴)
1947 # 示例：只有请求 A「今天天气」，依次输出「阴」「天」，最后是 EOS（overlap 模式）
1948 #
1949 # | 轮次 | 进入时 running_batch　　| 进入时 last_batch　 | 本轮执行（GPU） | 本轮处理上一轮结果（CPU） |
1950 # | N　　 | 空　　　　　　　 | None　　　　 | prefill(今天天气) -> 阴　| 无　　　　　　　　　　 |
1951 # | N+1　　 | 空，组批时并入 A　 | prefill(今天天气) | decode(阴) -> 天　　　　 | 追加「阴」　　　　　　 |
1952 # | N+2　　 | {A}　　　　　　　　 | decode(阴)　　　 | decode(天) -> EOS　　　　| 追加「天」　　　　　　 |
1953 # | N+3　　 | {A}　　　　　　　　 | decode(天)　　　 | decode(EOS)，多算一步　 | 追加 EOS，判定结束　　　　 |
1954 # | N+4　　 | {A}，组批时移出变空 | decode(EOS)　　　　 | 无　　　　　 | 跳过已结束请求的结果　 |
1955 )
1956 self.running_batch = plan.running_batch # NOTE 更新 running_batch
1957 batch = plan.batch_to_run
1958 self.cur_batch_for_debug = batch
1959 disable_overlap_for_batch = self.is_disable_overlap_for_batch(
1960 batch, last_batch=self.last_batch
1961 )
1962
1963 # If we do not need to overlap the current batch with the last batch,
1964 # we can process the last batch immediately.
1965 if disable_overlap_for_batch:
1966 pop_and_process()
1967 # Opportunistic flush at the disable_overlap sync boundary:
1968 # forward_stream is idle (prev forward drained, next not launched),
1969 # so `_flush`'s non-urgent guard compacts freely. Sync-free, best-effort.
1970 if self.enable_unified_memory:
1971 try:
1972 self.token_to_kv_pool_allocator.flush_opportunistic()
1973 except Exception:
1974 pass
1975
1976 # Launch the current batch
1977 if batch:
1978 # note 【step 4】执行本批，结果先放进 result_queue
1979 # batch.forward_mode = EXTEND/DECODE/MIXED 决定走 prefill、decode还是混合
1980 batch_result = self.run_batch(batch)
1981 # Fence result processing behind this forward's shared reads.
1982 self._apply_war_barrier()
1983 self.result_queue.append((batch.copy(), batch_result))
1984 else:
1985 batch_result = None
1986 self._sched_idled = True
1987
1988 # 【Step 4】处理上一批的结果：overlap 模式下比执行晚一轮
1989 # Process the last batch
1990 if self.last_batch:
1991 if not disable_overlap_for_batch:
1992 pop_and_process()
1993 elif batch is None:
1994 # When the server is idle, do self-check and re-init some states
1995 self.on_idle()
1996
1997 # Run sample of the current batch
1998 # It depends on the result of the last batch (e.g., grammar), so we run it after the last batch is processed.
1999 if self.is_generation:
2000 self.launch_batch_sample_if_needed(batch_result, batch)
2001
2002 # Update last_batch
2003 self.last_batch = batch
2004
2005 if envs.SGLANG_ENABLE_STRICT_MEM_CHECK_DURING_BUSY.get():
2006 self.invariant_checker.self_check_during_busy()

2056@scheduler_nvtx_method("scheduler.process_input_requests")
2057def process_input_requests(self, recv_reqs: List):
2058 """
2059 NOTE：遍历收到的请求并交给对应的函数入队，即放进 waiting_queue 中
2060 recv_reqs 类型为 List[Union[TokenizedGenerateReqInput, TokenizedEmbeddingReqInput, Any]]
2061 详见 scheduler.py.process_input_requests.md
2062 """

2064 self.session_controller.maybe_reap(now)
2065 # 判断服务是否使用 CUDA VMM 方式传输多模态特征，mm 是多模态模型缩写
2066 if get_mm().mm_feature_transport == "cuda_vmm":
2067 for recv_req in recv_reqs:
2068 self._materialize_cuda_vmm_inputs(recv_req)
2069
2070 # NOTE 遍历收到的请求
2071 for recv_req in recv_reqs:
2072 # Skip health check when server is busy — ongoing requests already carry health info.
2073 if is_health_check_generate_req(recv_req) and not self.is_fully_idle(
2074 for_health_check=True
2075 ):
2076 self.return_health_check_ipcs.append(
2077 getattr(recv_req, "http_worker_ipc", None)
2078 )
2079 continue
2080
2081 # NOTE
2082 # 将消息给到对应的处理方法，主要是将任务入队
2083 # 任务队列中的消息被消费后会进行 prefill、decode、KV Cache 相关的逻辑
2084 output = self._request_dispatcher(recv_req)
2085 if output is not None:
2086 if self.rust_server is not None:
2087 # Embedded Rust server: every control-request response goes
2088 # back through the egress ring (the zmq tokenizer socket is
2089 # not consumed); the Rust api_server shapes it per-endpoint.
2090 self.rust_server.push_control_output(recv_req, output)
2091 elif isinstance(output, RpcReqOutput):
2092 if self.ipc_channels.recv_from_rpc is not None:
2093 sock_send(self.ipc_channels.recv_from_rpc, output)
2094 else:
2095 self.ipc_channels.send_to_tokenizer.send_output(output, recv_req)
2096
2097 self.flush_wrapper.check_pending()
2098 if self.external_corpus_manager is not None:
2099 self.external_corpus_manager.check_pending_load()

2410def init_req_max_new_tokens(self, req):
2411 """根据输入长度和服务端容量限制，设置请求最多可生成的 token 数，并同步约束最少生成数量。"""
2412 input_len = len(req.origin_input_ids) # 输入 token 长度
2413 max_new_tokens = ( # 输出最大长度
2414 req.sampling_params.max_new_tokens
2415 if req.sampling_params.max_new_tokens is not None
2416 else 1 << 30
2417 )
2418 # 将输入的 max_new_tokens 降级成最大允许值
2419 if self.max_new_tokens_limit is not None and self.max_new_tokens_limit > 0:
2420 if max_new_tokens > self.max_new_tokens_limit:
2421 logger.warning(
2422 f"Capping max_new_tokens of request {req.rid} to "
2423 f"SGLANG_MAX_NEW_TOKENS_LIMIT={self.max_new_tokens_limit} "
2424 f"(requested: {req.sampling_params.max_new_tokens})."
2425 )
2426 max_new_tokens = min(max_new_tokens, self.max_new_tokens_limit)
2427
2428 # Keep this bound consistent with PrefillAdder's admission budget:
2429 # ceil_page(input_len) + max_new_tokens + page_size must be strictly
2430 # smaller than max_total_num_tokens. Otherwise a request can be accepted
2431 # into the waiting queue but can never be scheduled, blocking the queue
2432 # and eventually making health checks fail.
2433 paged_input_len = -(-input_len // self.page_size) * self.page_size
2434 req.sampling_params.max_new_tokens = max(
2435 0,
2436 min(
2437 max_new_tokens,
2438 self.max_req_len - input_len - 1,
2439 self.max_total_num_tokens * get_parallel().attn_dcp_size
2440 - paged_input_len
2441 - self.page_size
2442 - 1,
2443 ),
2444 )
2445 # Clipping above can push max_new_tokens below min_new_tokens, which
2446 # would suppress EOS for the whole generation. Restore the invariant.
2447 if req.sampling_params.min_new_tokens > req.sampling_params.max_new_tokens:
2448 req.sampling_params.min_new_tokens = req.sampling_params.max_new_tokens

2742 self.init_req_max_new_tokens(req)
2743 self._add_request_to_queue(req)
2744 return
2745
2746 else:
2747 # Session not found, or session is closing
2748 if session_id in self.session_controller:
2749 error_msg = (
2750 f"Invalid request: close was requested for session {session_id}"
2751 )
2752 else:
2753 error_msg = f"Invalid request: session id {session_id} does not exist"

2755 recv_req.rid,
2756 recv_req.input_text,
2757 recv_req.input_ids,
2758 recv_req.sampling_params,
2759 vocab_size=self.model_config.vocab_size,
2760 http_worker_ipc=recv_req.http_worker_ipc,
2761 )
2762 req.tokenizer = self.tokenizer

2764 self.init_req_max_new_tokens(req)
2765 self._add_request_to_queue(req)
2766 return
2767
2768 self._maybe_namespace_elastic_radix_cache(req)
2769
2770 # 当前是否使用 DFLASH / DSPARK 这类推测解码算法。
2771 if self.spec_algorithm.is_dflash_family():
2772 # 检查请求参数与当前运行模式是否兼容。
2773 error_msg = validate_dflash_request(req, self.enable_overlap)
2774 if error_msg is not None:
2775 req.set_finish_with_abort(error_msg)
2776 self.init_req_max_new_tokens(req)
2777 self._add_request_to_queue(req)
2778 return
2779
2780 if (
2781 req.return_sampling_mask
2782 and self.disaggregation_mode != DisaggregationMode.NULL
2783 and not self.disagg_metadata_buffers.enable_sampling_mask
2784 ):
2785 error_msg = (
2786 "return_sampling_mask with disaggregation requires "
2787 "SGLANG_DISAGGREGATION_SAMPLING_MASK_MAX_TOKENS > 0."
2788 )
2789 req.set_finish_with_abort(error_msg)
2790 self.init_req_max_new_tokens(req)
2791 self._add_request_to_queue(req)
2792 return
2793
2794 if req.return_sampling_mask and req.sampling_params.top_k == TOP_K_ALL:
2795 error_msg = (
2796 "return_sampling_mask requires finite top_k; top_p-only sampling "
2797 "is valid but can return huge masks in the tail, blowing up "
2798 "metadata, so we need a safety cap."
2799 )
2800 req.set_finish_with_abort(error_msg)
2801 self.init_req_max_new_tokens(req)
2802 self._add_request_to_queue(req)
2803 return
2804
2805 if req.return_sampling_mask and not self.spec_algorithm.is_none():
2806 # Spec workers do not emit one sampling support per accepted token, so
2807 # the returned mask would not align 1:1 with generated tokens. Reject
2808 # the combination instead of silently returning a misaligned mask.
2809 error_msg = (
2810 "return_sampling_mask is not supported with speculative decoding."
2811 )
2812 req.set_finish_with_abort(error_msg)
2813 self.init_req_max_new_tokens(req)
2814 self._add_request_to_queue(req)
2815 return
2816
2817 if req.return_sampling_mask and get_exec().kernel.sampling_backend == "ascend":
2818 # The ascend backend samples from logits directly and never builds the
2819 # top-k/top-p support, so it cannot produce a sampling mask.
2820 error_msg = (
2821 "return_sampling_mask is not supported with the ascend "
2822 "sampling backend."
2823 )
2824 req.set_finish_with_abort(error_msg)
2825 self.init_req_max_new_tokens(req)
2826 self._add_request_to_queue(req)
2827 return
2828
2829 # Handle multimodal inputs
2830 if recv_req.mm_inputs is not None:
2831 image_inputs = self._get_multimodal_inputs(recv_req.mm_inputs)
2832
2833 SessionController.adjust_mm_offsets(recv_req, req, image_inputs)
2834
2835 # The following steps are already fast, execute locally on each rank.
2836 # Expand a single image token into multiple dummy tokens for receiving image embeddings.
2837 # The pad function is model-specific and can be None for some backends.
2838 if (
2839 not self._try_apply_padded_mm_input_ids(recv_req, req, image_inputs)
2840 and self.pad_input_ids_func
2841 ):
2842 req.origin_input_ids = array(
2843 "q", self.pad_input_ids_func(req.origin_input_ids, image_inputs)
2844 )
2845 req.extend_image_inputs(image_inputs)
2846 self._maybe_compute_mrope_positions(req)
2847
2848 if len(req.origin_input_ids) >= self.max_req_input_len:
2849 req.set_finish_with_abort(
2850 error_msg=(
2851 "Multimodal prompt is too long after expanding multimodal tokens. "
2852 f"After expanding {len(req.origin_input_ids_unpadded)=} => {len(req.origin_input_ids)} >= {self.max_req_input_len}."
2853 )
2854 )
2855 self.init_req_max_new_tokens(req)
2856 self._add_request_to_queue(req)
2857 return
2858
2859 # initialize before returning
2860 self.init_req_max_new_tokens(req)
2861
2862 # Validate prompt length
2863 error_msg = validate_input_length(
2864 req,
2865 self.max_req_input_len,
2866 get_serving().allow_auto_truncate,
2867 )
2868 if error_msg:
2869 req.set_finish_with_abort(error_msg)
2870 self._add_request_to_queue(req)
2871 return
2872
2873 if not recv_req.return_logprob and recv_req.logprob_start_len != -1:
2874 # When return_logprob is False, logprob_start_len should be ignored
2875 recv_req.logprob_start_len = -1
2876
2877 if recv_req.logprob_start_len == -1:
2878 if recv_req.return_logprob and recv_req.token_ids_logprob is None:
2879 # If logprob is required but neither token_ids_logprob nor logprob_start_len is
2880 # set, return the logprobs for output tokens by default
2881 req.logprob_start_len = len(req.origin_input_ids)
2882 elif req.is_prefill_only:
2883 # For prefill-only requests with logprob_start_len == -1, set logprob_start_len
2884 # beyond input sequence to skip input logprob computation entirely
2885 req.logprob_start_len = len(req.origin_input_ids)
2886 else:
2887 # If return_logprob is False, only the last token requires logprob computation
2888 req.logprob_start_len = -1
2889 else:
2890 req.logprob_start_len = recv_req.logprob_start_len
2891
2892 if req.logprob_start_len > len(req.origin_input_ids):
2893 error_msg = f"{req.logprob_start_len=} is higher than the number of input tokens {len(req.origin_input_ids)=}. Please use a smaller logprob_start_len."
2894 req.logprob_start_len = -1
2895 req.set_finish_with_abort(error_msg)
2896 self._add_request_to_queue(req)
2897 return
2898
2899 if (
2900 get_device().mlx_enable_sampling
2901 and req.return_logprob
2902 and 0 <= req.logprob_start_len < len(req.origin_input_ids)
2903 ):
2904 # The MLX sampling path computes output logprobs only; the
2905 # prefill result carries no input_token_logprobs, so letting
2906 # this through would crash output processing.
2907 error_msg = (
2908 "Prompt input logprobs (logprob_start_len) are not supported "
2909 "on the MLX sampling path; omit logprob_start_len to get "
2910 "output logprobs."
2911 )
2912 req.logprob_start_len = -1
2913 req.set_finish_with_abort(error_msg)
2914 self._add_request_to_queue(req)
2915 return
2916
2917 if recv_req.return_routed_experts:
2918 error_msg = None
2919 if recv_req.routed_experts_start_len < 0:
2920 error_msg = (
2921 f"{recv_req.routed_experts_start_len=} is lower than 0. "
2922 "Please use a non-negative routed_experts_start_len."
2923 )
2924
2925 if recv_req.routed_experts_start_len > len(req.origin_input_ids):
2926 error_msg = (
2927 f"{recv_req.routed_experts_start_len=} is higher than the "
2928 f"number of input tokens {len(req.origin_input_ids)=}. Please "
2929 f"use a smaller routed_experts_start_len."
2930 )
2931
2932 if error_msg is not None:
2933 req.routed_experts_start_len = 0
2934 req.set_finish_with_abort(error_msg)
2935 self._add_request_to_queue(req)
2936 return
2937
2938 added_to_grammar_queue = self.grammar_manager.process_req_with_grammar(req)
2939 if not added_to_grammar_queue:
2940 # NOTE 推理任务放进
2941 self._add_request_to_queue(req)

3000def _add_request_to_queue(self, req: Req, is_retracted: bool = False):
3001 """推理任务入队逻辑/waiting_queue"""
3002 if not self._set_or_validate_priority(req):
3003 return
3004 if self.disaggregation_mode == DisaggregationMode.NULL:
3005 if self._abort_on_queued_limit(req):
3006 return
3007 self._prefetch_kvcache(req)
3008 # NOTE 新请求进入等待队列，下一轮组批时从这里挑
3009 self.waiting_queue.append(req)
3010 req.time_stats.set_wait_queue_entry_time()
3011 # PD 分离由 P/D 实例接力完成请求，流程说明见 docs/learn/03-pd-disaggregation.md。
3012 elif self.disaggregation_mode == DisaggregationMode.PREFILL:
3013 self._prefetch_kvcache(req)
3014 self.disagg_prefill_bootstrap_queue.add(
3015 req, self.model_config.num_key_value_heads
3016 )
3017 req.time_stats.set_prefill_bootstrap_queue_entry_time()
3018 elif self.disaggregation_mode == DisaggregationMode.DECODE:
3019 self.disagg_decode_prealloc_queue.add(req, is_retracted=is_retracted)
3020 if not is_retracted:
3021 req.time_stats.set_decode_prealloc_queue_entry_time()
3022 else:
3023 req.time_stats.set_retract_time()
3024 else:
3025 raise ValueError(f"Invalid {self.disaggregation_mode=}")
