3299@scheduler_nvtx_method("scheduler.get_next_batch_to_run")
3300def get_next_batch_to_run(
3301 self, running_batch: ScheduleBatch, last_batch: Optional[ScheduleBatch]
3302) -> NextBatchPlan:
3303 """
3304 NOTE 决定本轮执行哪个批次，并返回更新后的运行批。
3305
3306 - Prefill（预填充）：处理提示词中尚未缓存的 token 并建立 KV 缓存，
3307 本方法尝试为新请求或尚未完成预填充的请求组织批次。
3308 - Decode（解码）：利用已有 KV 缓存继续生成后续 token，
3309 普通自回归模式下每个请求每步通常生成一个 token。
3310 - Chunked Prefill（分块预填充）：把长提示词分多轮计算，
3311 chunked_req 表示尚需续算的请求，避免将它提前并入普通 decode 批。
3312 - KV Cache（Key–Value Cache，键值缓存）：保存注意力层已计算的 Key/Value，
3313 让后续 token 的计算复用历史上下文。
3314 - FPM（Forward Pass Metrics，前向计算指标）：记录批次耗时和请求统计，
3315 本方法保存调度起始时间，供后续指标上报使用。
3316 - tip dLLM / DLLM（Diffusion Large Language Model，扩散式大语言模型）：
3317 通过多轮去噪逐步确定一块 token，本方法使用专门的管理器和组批路径调度。
3318 - HiSparse（Hierarchical Sparse Attention，分层稀疏注意力）：将完整 KV
3319 存在 CPU 侧、GPU 按需缓存和读取热点 KV，本方法收集准备好进入 decode 的请求。
3320 - DP Attention（Data Parallel Attention，数据并行注意力）：不同注意力副本
3321 处理不同请求，同时在需要协同的模型计算阶段协调各副本的批次信息。
3322 - MLP Sync（Multi-Layer Perceptron Synchronization，多层感知机计算同步）：
3323 为后续前馈层协同计算对齐各副本的 token 数和前向模式等信息，必要时补空批。
3324 - Spec（Speculative Decoding，推测解码）：先提出候选 token，再由目标模型
3325 批量验证，本方法结合其配置协调 DP Attention 下的 prefill/decode 模式。
3326 """
3327 self.process_pending_chunked_abort()
3328
3329 if self.enable_fpm:
3330 self._fpm_batch_t0 = time.monotonic()
3331 self._abort_on_waiting_timeout()
3332 self._abort_on_running_timeout(running_batch)
3333 if self.dllm_config is not None:
3334 self.dllm_manager.filter_finished_reqs()
3335
3336 chunked_req_to_exclude = set()
3337
3338 if self.dllm_config is not None and self.dllm_manager.any_staging_reqs():
3339 chunked_req_to_exclude.update(self.dllm_manager.staging_queue)
3340 for req in self.dllm_manager.staging_queue:
3341 if self.dllm_config.first_done_first_out_mode:
3342 if not req.dllm_incomplete_ids:
3343 self.stash_chunked_request(req)
3344 self.req_to_token_pool.free(req)
3345 # Otherwise, keep req slot/KV for reuse.
3346 else:
3347 self.stash_chunked_request(req)
3348
3349 # tips https://lmsysorg.mintlify.app/docs/advanced_features/pipeline_parallelism#chunked-prefill-size-and-smoothing-factor
3350 # 中文：user_guide_zh/1.7 长上下文流水线并行(Pipeline Parallelism for Long Context).md 的「分块预填充大小与平滑因子」
3351 # 说明：分块预填充(chunked prefill)把很长的提示词按 --chunked-prefill-size 切成几块、每轮只算一块，避免一次 prefill 跑太久卡住正在 decode 的请求或撑爆显存；
3352 # self.chunked_req 是还没切完的那个请求，这里先把它已算完那几块的 KV 存进前缀缓存，下一轮再接着算下一块
3353 if self.chunked_req is not None:
3354 chunked_req_to_exclude.add(self.chunked_req)
3355
3356 # Stash (cache) the previous chunk only when it produced new KV
3357 # beyond what is already cached. A parked chunk (add_chunked_req
3358 # hybrid-SWA early-return) leaves extend_range.end ==
3359 # len(prefix_indices), so there is nothing new to cache and
3360 # stashing would be a no-op.
3361 if self.chunked_req.extend_range.end > len(self.chunked_req.prefix_indices):
3362 self.stash_chunked_request(self.chunked_req)
3363
3364 # tip https://lmsysorg.mintlify.app/docs/advanced_features/hisparse_guide
3365 # 中文：user_guide_zh/2.2 分层稀疏注意力(Hierarchical Sparse Attention).md
3366 # 说明：分层稀疏注意力(HiSparse)用于 DeepSeek-V3.2 这类自带稀疏注意力的模型，decode 时每个请求在 GPU 上只保留一块固定大小的热点 KV 缓冲区，
3367 # 完整 KV 放在 CPU 锁页内存，按 Top-k 选中的 token 按需换入，从而降低长上下文的显存占用、提高 decode 并发
3368 # HiSparse has its own prefill-to-decode transition; skip last_batch merge.
3369 if self.enable_hisparse:
3370 ready_reqs = self.hisparse_coordinator.collect_ready_reqs()
3371 if len(ready_reqs) > 0:
3372 new_batch = self._build_hisparse_decode_batch(ready_reqs)
3373 if running_batch.is_empty():
3374 running_batch = new_batch
3375 else:
3376 running_batch.merge_batch(new_batch)
3377 running_batch.hisparse_coordinator = self.hisparse_coordinator
3378 # Reset batch_is_full so the scheduler can schedule more prefills.
3379 running_batch.batch_is_full = False
3380
3381 if (
3382 not self.enable_hisparse
3383 and last_batch
3384 and last_batch.forward_mode.is_extend()
3385 ):
3386 if last_batch.chunked_req is not None:
3387 # In the context pipeline parallelism, after the last chunk, the current microbatch still track outdated chunked_req.
3388 # We need to discard it.
3389 chunked_req_to_exclude.add(last_batch.chunked_req)
3390
3391 if self.dllm_config is not None and last_batch.reqs:
3392 chunked_req_to_exclude.update(last_batch.reqs)
3393
3394 # 去掉已结束的请求，以及上面明确排除的请求。
3395 last_bs = last_batch.batch_size()
3396 last_batch.filter_batch(chunked_req_to_exclude=list(chunked_req_to_exclude))
3397 if last_batch.batch_size() < last_bs:
3398 running_batch.batch_is_full = False
3399
3400 # 剩下的请求可以继续生成：运行批为空就接管，否则合并到已有运行批。
3401 if not last_batch.is_empty():
3402 if running_batch.is_empty():
3403 running_batch = last_batch
3404 else:
3405 # 将上一轮预填充完成的请求加入已有运行批。
3406 running_batch.merge_batch(last_batch)
3407
3408 # For prefill-only batch, filter out finished requests since they
3409 # won't go through the decode step. This keeps running_batch accurate
3410 # for load reporting (num_running_reqs via /v1/loads).
3411 # Runs outside the last_batch block so stale requests are cleaned
3412 # even when no new batches arrive (e.g. traffic stops).
3413 if running_batch.is_prefill_only:
3414 running_batch.filter_batch()
3415 if running_batch.is_empty():
3416 running_batch.batch_is_full = False
3417 if self.dllm_config is not None:
3418 new_batch = self.get_new_batch_dllm(running_batch)
3419 elif self._should_defer_prefill():
3420 new_batch = None
3421 else:
3422 # NOTE 普通调度路径通常先尝试 get_new_batch_prefill，获取可运行的 prefill 批。
3423 # 获取不到才会继续 decode 任务
3424 prefill_plan = self.get_new_batch_prefill(running_batch)
3425 new_batch = prefill_plan.batch_to_run
3426 running_batch = prefill_plan.running_batch
3427
3428 need_mlp_sync = self.require_mlp_sync
3429 if (
3430 need_mlp_sync
3431 and not self.spec_algorithm.is_none()
3432 and not get_spec().speculative_skip_dp_mlp_sync
3433 ):
3434 # NOTE: This branch makes sure prefill and decode batches will not be mixed when spec and dp-attn is enabled.
3435 # Before merging the new batch into running batch:
3436 # 1. All new batches are none -> need_mlp_sync remains true (sync is needed for decode batch).
3437 # 2. All new batches are some (prefill / idle) -> we do not need prepare mlp sync one more time.
3438 new_batch = self.dp_attn_adapter.maybe_prepare_mlp_sync_batch(new_batch)
3439 need_mlp_sync = new_batch is None
3440
3441 # NOTE 这个 if-else 和里边的 running_batch 赋值给 ret（ret 又赋值给 batch_to_run 很有意思）
3442 # 一定程度说明了 running_batch 保存了 prefill完成、要进行 decode的请求，如果没有prefill任务，则继续 decode
3443 if new_batch is not None:
3444 # tips 优先 prefill，所以如果有prefill则优先执行prefill，就是这个链路
3445 ret = new_batch
3446 else:
3447 # NOTE decode 链路
3448 if not running_batch.is_empty() and not running_batch.is_prefill_only:
3449 # tip 跑 decode 任务： update_running_batch -> prepare_for_decode()
3450 # running_batch 标识正在跑的 decode/完成 prefill的推理任务
3451 running_batch = self.update_running_batch(running_batch)
3452 # NOTE decode 链路的 running_batch 会赋值给 batch_to_run、用于本轮计算执行
3453 ret = running_batch if not running_batch.is_empty() else None
3454 else:
3455 ret = None
3456
3457 # Handle DP attention and log stats
3458 ret = self.dp_attn_adapter.maybe_prepare_mlp_sync_batch(
3459 ret, need_sync=need_mlp_sync
3460 )
3461 # Decode->extend conversion keeps a heterogeneous dp step replayable.
3462 converted = self.dp_attn_adapter.maybe_convert_decode_to_extend(ret)
3463 if converted is running_batch and converted.forward_mode.is_extend():
3464 # The converted batch re-enters via the last_batch extend-merge
3465 # next iteration; empty running_batch or it merges with itself.
3466 running_batch = ScheduleBatch(
3467 reqs=[], batch_is_full=running_batch.batch_is_full
3468 )
3469 ret = converted
3470 self._arm_prefill_decode_interval(ret)
3471
3472 # Handle ngram embedding
3473 ret = self.ngram_embedding_manager.prepare_for_forward(
3474 ret, chunked_req=self.chunked_req
3475 )
3476
3477 if ret:
3478 set_schedule_time_batch(ret)
3479 if self.enable_fpm:
3480 ret.fpm_start_time = self._fpm_batch_t0
3481 return NextBatchPlan(batch_to_run=ret, running_batch=running_batch)

3503def get_new_batch_prefill(self, running_batch: ScheduleBatch) -> NextBatchPlan:
3504 prefill_delayer_single_pass = None
3505 if self.prefill_delayer:
3506 # Get max usage across all pools for prefill delay decision
3507 max_pool_usage = (
3508 self.pool_stats_observer.get_pool_stats().get_max_pool_usage()
3509 )
3510 prefill_delayer_single_pass = PrefillDelayerSinglePassExecutor(
3511 self.prefill_delayer, token_usage=max_pool_usage
3512 )
3513 # NOTE 获取 prefill 任务数据，ret 和 running batch都是 ScheduleBatch
3514 # get_new_batch_prefill() -> _get_new_batch_prefill_raw()
3515 ret, running_batch = self._get_new_batch_prefill_raw(
3516 prefill_delayer_single_pass=prefill_delayer_single_pass,
3517 running_batch=running_batch,
3518 )
3519
3520 if self.prefill_delayer:
3521 # tip --enable-prefill-delayer 时走到这个链路
3522 observed_prefill_bs = prefill_delayer_single_pass.finalize(
3523 actual_prefill_bs=ret.batch_size() if ret is not None else 0
3524 )
3525 if observed_prefill_bs > 0: # bs batch_sizesssssssssssss
3526 self.max_prefill_bs = self.prefill_bs_tracker.observe_attempt(
3527 observed_prefill_bs
3528 )
3529
3530 return NextBatchPlan(
3531 batch_to_run=ret, # tip 执行的推理任务
3532 running_batch=running_batch, # tip 上一轮的推理请求
3533 )

3535def _get_new_batch_prefill_raw(
3536 self,
3537 prefill_delayer_single_pass: Optional[PrefillDelayerSinglePassExecutor],
3538 running_batch: ScheduleBatch,
3539) -> Tuple[Optional[ScheduleBatch], ScheduleBatch]:
3540 """
3541 NOTE 获取 prefill 任务数据，ret 和 running batch都是 ScheduleBatch
3542 """
3543 # Check if the grammar is ready in the grammar queue
3544 if self.grammar_manager.has_waiting_grammars():
3545 ready_grammar_requests = self.grammar_manager.get_ready_grammar_requests()
3546 for req in ready_grammar_requests:
3547 self._add_request_to_queue(req)
3548
3549 if self.enable_hierarchical_cache or get_memory().enable_flexkv:
3550 self.tree_cache.check_hicache_events()
3551
3552 if self.enable_priority_preemption or self.is_hybrid_swa:
3553 # Reset batch_is_full to try preemption with a prefill adder.
3554 running_batch.batch_is_full = False
3555
3556 # NOTE
3557 # （waiting_queue 为空 或 running_batch 已满） 且没有要续算的分块请求
3558 # 也没有未完成的 chunked_req
3559 #
3560 # tip
3561 # running_batch is full：槽位、max_running_requests 等资源被 running_batch 占满了
3562 # chunked_req：提示词太长的时候，按照 --chunked-prefill-size 分成多块做多轮 prefill
3563 # chunked_req 是在在前的chunk处理时已经锁定了槽位资源
3564 if (
3565 running_batch.batch_is_full or len(self.waiting_queue) == 0
3566 ) and self.chunked_req is None:
3567 return None, running_batch
3568
3569 running_bs = len(running_batch.reqs)
3570 # Skipped during a chunked prefill: that pass must proceed regardless.
3571 if (
3572 self.min_free_slots_delayer is not None
3573 and self.chunked_req is None
3574 and self.min_free_slots_delayer.should_delay(
3575 running_bs=running_bs,
3576 num_allocatable_reqs=self.get_num_allocatable_reqs(
3577 running_bs, running_batch=running_batch
3578 ),
3579 )
3580 ):
3581 return None, running_batch
3582
3583 # Ignore the check if self.chunked_req is not None.
3584 # In the non-PP case, when self.chunked_req is not None, num_allocatable_reqs should always be greater than 0,
3585 # as the space for the chunked requests has just been released.
3586 # In PP case, chunked requests (or dllm requests) can start in one microbatch and end in another microbatch, so the max_running_requests per microbatch should not be strict.
3587 # Instead, we should always allow chunked requests to be added, otherwise, there will be a memory leak.
3588 if (
3589 self.get_num_allocatable_reqs(running_bs, running_batch=running_batch) <= 0
3590 and self.chunked_req is None
3591 and not self.enable_priority_preemption
3592 ):
3593 running_batch.batch_is_full = True
3594 return None, running_batch
3595
3596 # Get priority queue
3597 # NOTE 按 --schedule-policy（默认 fcfs）给 waiting_queue 排序
3598 self.policy.calc_priority(self.waiting_queue, running_batch)
3599
3600 if TEST_RETRACT and running_bs > TEST_RETRACT_NO_PREFILL_BS:
3601 # If we are testing retraction and the running batch size exceeds
3602 # TEST_RETRACT_NO_PREFILL_BS, we skip the prefill to keep the requests
3603 # in the waiting queue.
3604 return None, running_batch
3605
3606 # NOTE 计算每次 prefill 可计算的 token 数量，以 chunked_prefill_size 最终为 4096 示例
3607 #
3608 # 请求 A：需要 prefill 1024 个 token
3609 # 请求 B：需要 prefill 4096 个 token
3610 #
3611 # 本轮：A 算 1024 + B 算 3072 = 4096
3612 # 后续：B 剩下的 1024 个 token 继续做 prefill
3613 # Determine chunked_prefill_size for this batch
3614 chunked_prefill_size = self.chunked_prefill_size
3615 if self.chunked_req is not None and self.enable_dynamic_chunking:
3616 history_len = len(
3617 self.chunked_req.prefix_indices
3618 ) # 入参是这个 req 已经缓存的kv的数量
3619 # tip 动态 prefill size：获取本次的 prefill size，即要处理多少个 token
3620 dynamic_size = self.predict_next_chunk_size(history_len)
3621 if dynamic_size is not None:
3622 chunked_prefill_size = dynamic_size
3623
3624 # Prefill policy
3625 # Get BLOCK_M from the backend for tile-budget admission logic
3626 attn_backend = self.tp_worker.model_runner.attn_backend
3627 if hasattr(attn_backend, "extend_attention_block_m"):
3628 prefill_tile_block_m = attn_backend.extend_attention_block_m
3629 else:
3630 prefill_tile_block_m = 64 # Fallback for non-Triton backends
3631
3632 # NOTE 建本轮预算：剩余 KV 编号、最多 prefill token 数、分块大小、最多请求数
3633 # PrefillAdder 每一轮新建一个对象
3634 adder = PrefillAdder(
3635 page_size=self.page_size,
3636 tree_cache=self.tree_cache, # tree_cache 就是 前缀匹配，就是 RadixCache 实现的那套
3637 token_to_kv_pool_allocator=self.token_to_kv_pool_allocator,
3638 running_batch=running_batch, # 正在 decode 的请求：要给它们后续生成的 token 预留 KV 编号
3639 new_token_ratio=self.new_token_ratio_tracker.current, # 预留比例：running 请求剩余最大生成数 × 这个比例 = 给它预留的 KV 编号
3640 rem_input_tokens=self.max_prefill_tokens, # 本轮 prefill 最多处理多少个输入 token
3641 # NOTE 这是本次组批 prefill 的 token上限
3642 # 超过 rem_chunk_tokens 则Req 就会被切分，并将留下来的待处理数据保存到 Scheduler.chunked_req 中
3643 rem_chunk_tokens=chunked_prefill_size,
3644 # 混合批时给拼进来的 decode 请求预留 token，不开混合批为 0——就当是0吧
3645 num_mixed_decode_tokens=running_bs if self.is_mixed_chunk else 0,
3646 priority_scheduling_preemption_threshold=self.priority_scheduling_preemption_threshold,
3647 max_prefill_bs=int(self.max_prefill_bs), # 本轮 prefill 批最多放几个请求
3648 max_running_requests=self.max_running_requests, # 同时在跑的请求数上限，也就是槽位上限
3649 prefill_max_requests=get_schedule().prefill_max_requests,
3650 prefill_delayer_single_pass=prefill_delayer_single_pass,
3651 dllm_config=self.dllm_config,
3652 waiting_queue_len=len(self.waiting_queue),
3653 prefill_tile_block_m=prefill_tile_block_m,
3654 )
3655
3656 if self.chunked_req is not None:
3657 # NOTE 如果有未完成的 chunked_req，则直接调用 add_chunked_req 放到批处理中
3658 # 【重要】
3659 self.chunked_req.init_next_round_input()
3660 self.chunked_req = adder.add_chunked_req(self.chunked_req)
3661
3662 if self.enable_lora:
3663 running_loras = {
3664 req.lora_id for req in running_batch.reqs if not req.finished()
3665 }
3666 # Account for LoRAs that are already loaded in the adder, such as chunked requests
3667 running_loras.update(req.lora_id for req in adder.can_run_list)
3668
3669 if self.lora_drainer:
3670 self.lora_drainer.update_draining_state(
3671 self.waiting_queue,
3672 running_batch.reqs,
3673 )
3674
3675 mamba_allocator = getattr(self.req_to_token_pool, "mamba_allocator", None)
3676 if mamba_allocator is not None:
3677 mamba_allocator.alloc_group_begin(len(self.waiting_queue))
3678 # Get requests from the waiting queue to a new prefill batch
3679 # NOTE 按排好的顺序遍历 waiting_queue，逐个判断能不能进本批
3680 for req in self.waiting_queue:
3681 if self.enable_lora and not self._can_schedule_lora_req(req, running_loras):
3682 continue
3683
3684 running_bs = len(running_batch.reqs)
3685 candidate_beam_width = (
3686 req.beam_group.beam_width if req.beam_group is not None else None
3687 )
3688 # tag 1
3689 if len(adder.can_run_list) >= self.get_num_allocatable_reqs(
3690 running_bs,
3691 candidate_beam_width,
3692 running_batch=running_batch,
3693 ):
3694 running_batch.batch_is_full = True
3695
3696 # tag 2
3697 if self.disaggregation_mode == DisaggregationMode.PREFILL:
3698 # In prefill mode, prealloc queue and transfer queue can also take memory,
3699 # so we need to check if the available size for the actual available size.
3700 if len(adder.can_run_list) >= self.req_to_token_pool.available_size():
3701 running_batch.batch_is_full = True
3702
3703 # tip batch_is_full 时尝试优先级抢占；未启用抢占或抢占失败才 break，保留此前已选中的请求。
3704 if running_batch.batch_is_full:
3705 if (
3706 not self.enable_priority_preemption
3707 or not adder.preempt_to_schedule(req, self.server_args)
3708 ):
3709 break
3710
3711 # tip 分层缓存逻辑：GPU -> CPU -> 外部存储
3712 if self.enable_hicache_storage:
3713 # tip 判断已经获取到了 分层缓存
3714 prefetch_done = self.tree_cache.check_prefetch_progress(req.rid)
3715 if not prefetch_done:
3716 # skip staging requests that are ongoing prefetch
3717 # tip 还没获取到分层缓存则跳过 waiting queue 中当前req的处理
3718 continue
3719 # Pop the number of tokens loaded from storage (L3 hits)
3720 # NOTE 获取缓存的长度，是指前n个缓存
3721 loaded_tokens = self.tree_cache.pop_prefetch_loaded_tokens(req.rid)
3722 if loaded_tokens > 0:
3723 req.storage_hit_length = loaded_tokens # NOTE 字段更新
3724
3725 req.init_next_round_input(self.tree_cache)
3726 if (
3727 self.enable_hicache_storage
3728 and self.server_args.hicache_host_memory_mode == "buffer_only"
3729 ):
3730 # Buffer mode: surface a staged prefetch as the request's host
3731 # hit (consumed through init_load_back) plus its SWA window,
3732 # which consumption allocates and the request lock pins —
3733 # uncharged, the batch alloc can OOM. Set AFTER
3734 # init_next_round_input (which recomputes host_hit). Mamba
3735 # (fenced in init_hicache) will need the same charge via
3736 # mamba_host_hit_length.
3737 held_tokens = self.tree_cache.staged_prefetch_tokens(req.rid)
3738 if held_tokens > 0:
3739 req.host_hit_length = held_tokens
3740 req.swa_host_hit_length = (
3741 self.tree_cache.staged_prefetch_swa_tokens(req.rid)
3742 )
3743 # NOTE 尝试把请求加进本批，预算够就放进 adder.can_run_list 并扣预算
3744 res = adder.add_one_req(
3745 req,
3746 has_chunked_req=(self.chunked_req is not None),
3747 truncation_align_size=self.truncation_align_size,
3748 )
3749
3750 if self.enable_lora:
3751 running_loras.add(req.lora_id)
3752
3753 # NOTE
3754 # CONTINUE = auto() # Continue to add requests
3755 # NO_TOKEN = auto() # No token left
3756 # OTHER = auto() # Other reasons to stop adding requests
3757 if res != AddReqResult.CONTINUE:
3758 if res == AddReqResult.NO_TOKEN:
3759 if self.enable_hierarchical_cache:
3760 # Set batch_is_full after making sure there are requests that can be served
3761 running_batch.batch_is_full = len(adder.can_run_list) > 0 or (
3762 not running_batch.is_empty()
3763 )
3764 else:
3765 running_batch.batch_is_full = True
3766 # revert matched mamba idx to avoid memory leak, if req is not added.
3767 # Only free if the slot was freshly allocated in this batch (not
3768 # pre-existing from a session). Session-held slots have their own
3769 # lifecycle and freeing them here causes double-free.
3770 added = len(adder.can_run_list) > 0 and req is adder.can_run_list[-1]
3771 if not added:
3772 # init_next_round_input() may stage deferred Mamba COW/clear
3773 # metadata before add_one_req() rejects the request.
3774 req.mamba_cow_src_index = None
3775 req.mamba_needs_clear = False
3776 if req.mamba_pool_idx is not None and not getattr(
3777 req, "session", None
3778 ):
3779 self.tree_cache.req_to_token_pool.mamba_allocator.free(
3780 req.mamba_pool_idx.unsqueeze(-1)
3781 )
3782 req.mamba_pool_idx = None
3783 break
3784
3785 if mamba_allocator is not None:
3786 mamba_allocator.alloc_group_end()
3787
3788 # Update waiting queue
3789 can_run_list: List[Req] = adder.can_run_list # NOTE 获取本批次执行的请求
3790 if len(can_run_list) == 0:
3791 return None, running_batch
3792
3793 # NOTE 选中的请求移出 waiting_queue，没选中的留在队里等下一轮
3794 can_run_set = set(can_run_list)
3795 self.waiting_queue = [x for x in self.waiting_queue if x not in can_run_set]
3796 if adder.preempt_list:
3797 for req in adder.preempt_list:
3798 self._add_request_to_queue(req)
3799
3800 if adder.new_chunked_req is not None:
3801 # Update chunked prefill
3802 assert self.chunked_req is None
3803 self.chunked_req = adder.new_chunked_req
3804
3805 if self.chunked_req is not None:
3806 self.chunked_req.inflight_middle_chunks += 1
3807
3808 set_time_batch(can_run_list, "set_forward_entry_time")
3809
3810 # Create a new batch
3811 # NOTE 用选中的请求建 prefill 批（只记下 reqs 和各个池的引用）
3812 new_batch = ScheduleBatch.init_new(
3813 can_run_list, # NOTE 重点参数，本批次
3814 self.req_to_token_pool, # NOTE Scheduler 的 ReqToTokenPool
3815 self.token_to_kv_pool_allocator,
3816 self.tree_cache,
3817 self.model_config,
3818 self.enable_overlap,
3819 self.spec_algorithm,
3820 chunked_req=self.chunked_req,
3821 )
3822
3823 # 【本批是否包含某个请求的最后一块】，分两种情况：
3824 # chunked_req is None 且 len(can_run_list) 为1的时候：是最后一个请求或者正好包含一个完整的请求
3825 # len(can_run_list)>1：肯定包含一个请求的末尾
3826 new_batch.contains_last_prefill_chunk = (
3827 self.chunked_req is None or len(can_run_list) != 1
3828 )
3829
3830 # tip 是否支持分层缓存
3831 if self.enable_hierarchical_cache:
3832 # todo (zhiqiang): disable cuda graph execution if hicache loading triggered
3833 new_batch.hicache_consumer_index = (
3834 self.tree_cache.ready_to_load_host_cache()
3835 )
3836
3837 # NOTE 【重要】/TODO 1）分配槽位和 KV 编号；2）写 req_to_token；3）暂存提示词 token，forward_mode 设为 EXTEND（即Prefill）
3838 new_batch.prepare_for_extend()
3839
3840 if self.tp_worker.model_runner.prefill_aware_swa:
3841 for req in can_run_list:
3842 req.swa_evict_floor = req.extend_range.end
3843
3844 # Record prefill stats for logging after forward.
3845 new_batch.prefill_stats = PrefillStats.from_adder(
3846 adder,
3847 running_batch.reqs,
3848 self.enable_priority_scheduling,
3849 num_pending_tokens=self.load_inquirer._get_num_pending_tokens(
3850 chunk_deduct=(
3851 self.chunked_req.extend_range.length
3852 if self.chunked_req is not None
3853 else 0
3854 ),
3855 ),
3856 )
3857
3858 # Mixed-style chunked prefill
3859 if (
3860 self.is_mixed_chunk
3861 and not running_batch.is_empty()
3862 and not (new_batch.return_logprob or running_batch.return_logprob)
3863 # mix_with_running cats input_ids but not input_embeds — shapes would mismatch
3864 and new_batch.input_embeds is None
3865 # Beam member rows are not supported inside a mixed extend batch.
3866 and all(r.beam_group is None for r in running_batch.reqs)
3867 ):
3868 # TODO (lianmin): support return_logprob + mixed chunked prefill
3869 running_batch.filter_batch()
3870 if not running_batch.is_empty():
3871 running_batch.prepare_for_decode()
3872 new_batch.mix_with_running(running_batch)
3873 new_batch.decoding_reqs = running_batch.reqs
3874 running_batch = ScheduleBatch(
3875 reqs=[], batch_is_full=running_batch.batch_is_full
3876 )
3877 else:
3878 new_batch.decoding_reqs = None
3879
3880 return new_batch, running_batch

3882def _can_schedule_lora_req(
3883 self, req: Req, running_loras: set[Optional[str]]
3884) -> bool:
3885 """
3886 Check if a LoRA request can be scheduled.
3887 判断 LoRA 请求是否可以被调度
3888
3889 This method checks two conditions:
3890 1. The drainer allows scheduling (based on draining state)
3891 2. The LoRA adapter can be loaded (either already running or can be added)
3892 """
3893 if self.lora_drainer and not self.lora_drainer.can_schedule(req):
3894 return False
3895
3896 if req.lora_id in running_loras:
3897 return True
3898
3899 if self.enable_lora_overlap_loading:
3900 # For overlapping loading of LoRA weights with computation, we will load each
3901 # adapter one at a time, as opposed to loading them in one batch
3902 return self.lora_overlap_loader.try_overlap_load_lora(
3903 req.lora_id, running_loras
3904 )
3905 else:
3906 new_lora_set = {req.lora_id} | running_loras
3907 return self.tp_worker.model_runner.lora_manager.validate_lora_batch(
3908 new_lora_set
3909 )

3911def update_running_batch(self, batch: ScheduleBatch) -> Optional[ScheduleBatch]:
3912 """Update the current running decoding batch.
3913 每步给每个请求分配 1 个 KV 槽位；显存不够时把部分请求退回等待队列（retract）
3914 """
3915 initial_bs = batch.batch_size()
3916
3917 batch.filter_batch()
3918 if batch.is_empty():
3919 batch.batch_is_full = False
3920 return batch
3921
3922 # Check if decode out of memory
3923 if (kv_full_retract_flag := not batch.check_decode_mem()) or (
3924 TEST_RETRACT and self.forward_ct % TEST_RETRACT_INTERVAL == 0
3925 ):
3926 old_available_tokens = self.token_to_kv_pool_allocator.available_size()
3927 old_ratio = self.new_token_ratio_tracker.current
3928 mamba_allocator = getattr(
3929 self.tree_cache.req_to_token_pool, "mamba_allocator", None
3930 )
3931 old_mamba_available = (
3932 mamba_allocator.available_size()
3933 if mamba_allocator is not None
3934 else None
3935 )
3936 retracted_reqs, new_token_ratio, reqs_to_abort = batch.retract_decode()
3937 new_available_tokens = self.token_to_kv_pool_allocator.available_size()
3938 new_token_gained = new_available_tokens - old_available_tokens
3939 mamba_num_gained = (
3940 mamba_allocator.available_size() - old_mamba_available
3941 if mamba_allocator is not None
3942 else None
3943 )
3944
3945 self.metrics_reporter.num_retracted_reqs = len(retracted_reqs)
3946 if self.metrics_reporter.enable_metrics and len(retracted_reqs) > 0:
3947 self.metrics_reporter.metrics_collector.increment_retracted_reqs(
3948 num_retracted_reqs=len(retracted_reqs),
3949 num_retracted_input_tokens=sum(
3950 len(r.origin_input_ids) for r in retracted_reqs
3951 ),
3952 num_retracted_output_tokens=sum(
3953 len(r.output_ids) for r in retracted_reqs
3954 ),
3955 )
3956 self.new_token_ratio_tracker.current = new_token_ratio
3957 for req in reqs_to_abort:
3958 abort_reason: FINISH_ABORT = req.to_finish
3959 self.ipc_channels.send_to_tokenizer.send_output(
3960 _make_abort_req(req, finished_reason=abort_reason.to_json()),
3961 req,
3962 )
3963 for req in reqs_to_abort:
3964 # Member rows were freed inside retract_decode; the group only
3965 # has to leave the live set.
3966 self.beam_coordinator.retire_group(req)
3967
3968 msg_prefix = (
3969 "KV cache pool is full. Retract requests. "
3970 if kv_full_retract_flag
3971 else "Testing retraction. "
3972 )
3973 msg_details = f"#retracted_reqs: {len(retracted_reqs)}, #new_tokens_gained: {new_token_gained}"
3974 if mamba_num_gained is not None:
3975 msg_details += f", #mamba_num_gained: {mamba_num_gained}"
3976 if kv_full_retract_flag:
3977 msg_details += (
3978 f", #new_token_ratio: {old_ratio:.4f} -> {new_token_ratio:.4f}"
3979 )
3980 logger.warning(msg_prefix + msg_details)
3981
3982 for req in retracted_reqs:
3983 self._add_request_to_queue(req, is_retracted=True)
3984 else:
3985 self.new_token_ratio_tracker.decay_step()
3986
3987 if batch.batch_size() < initial_bs:
3988 batch.batch_is_full = False
3989
3990 if batch.is_empty():
3991 return batch
3992
3993 # NOTE 准备执行 decode 任务
3994 # Update batch tensors
3995 batch.prepare_for_decode()
3996 return batch

4062) -> Union[GenerationBatchResult, EmbeddingBatchResult]:

4099 self._confidence_budget_prepare(batch, self.future_map)

4101 # with 语法
4102 # 进入时自动调用 forward_stream_ctx 的 __enter__() 方法
4103 # 退出时自动调用 forward_stream_ctx 的 __exit__() 方法
4104 # forward_stream_ctx 是 StreamContext 类型
4105 with self.forward_stream_ctx:
4106 # TIP: forward_stream 等 schedule_stream
4107 self.forward_stream.wait_stream(self.schedule_stream)
4108
4109 # resolve consumes SB staging (prefill_input_ids_cpu /
4110 # mix_running_indices). Run OUTSIDE isolation so the
4111 # snapshot captures the post-consume state — restoring
4112 # post-forward must not un-consume staging.
4113 # tip 给 batch.input_ids 赋值
4114 resolve_forward_inputs(batch, self.future_map)
4115
4116 with self._forward_isolation(batch, overlap=True):
4117 future_indices = batch.req_pool_indices
4118
4119 # Spec_v2 fires on_publish mid-worker (between verify and
4120 # draft_extend) so schedule prep can overlap with draft_extend.
4121 # Non-spec has no later work — scheduler publishes after return.
4122 fwd_kwargs = {}
4123 if not batch.spec_algorithm.is_none():
4124 fwd_kwargs["on_publish"] = partial(
4125 self.future_map.publish, future_indices
4126 )
4127 # Grammar-overlap-capable workers advance the grammar FSM
4128 # inside verify() before building the bitmask; hand them the
4129 # barrier that resolves the previous batch's committed
4130 # tokens (overlapping the target forward).
4131 if batch.spec_algorithm.supports_grammar_overlap():
4132 fwd_kwargs["grammar_barrier"] = (
4133 self._advance_pending_grammar
4134 )
4135
4136 # FIXME: pp is not compatible with overlap
4137 # NOTE forward 的核心方法，进行推理并获取 logits、也就是结果位置每个token的分数
4138 # 链路：
4139 # run_batch()
4140 # -> TpWorker#forward_batch_generation()
4141 # -> ModelRunner#forward() -> _forward_raw()
4142 # 结果类型 GenerationBatchResult，logits_output 保存了每个 token 的分数
4143 batch_result = self.model_worker.forward_batch_generation(
4144 batch, **fwd_kwargs
4145 )
4146 if batch.spec_algorithm.is_none():
4147 self.future_map.publish(future_indices, batch.seq_lens + 1)
4148 # Park any refs the worker wants kept alive 2 iters
4149 # (cross-stream tensor lifetime; pinned in the same
4150 # ring slot as the SB attr snapshot).
4151 if batch_result.extra_keep_alive_refs:
4152 self.batch_record_buf[self.batch_record_ct].extend(
4153 batch_result.extra_keep_alive_refs
4154 )
4155 if self.enable_unified_memory:
4156 # Record a `forward_done` event after the forward (before
4157 # copy_to_cpu); lazy-compaction `_flush` gates src reuse on
4158 # it. Only the unified pool's allocator exposes these hooks.
4159 allocator = self.token_to_kv_pool_allocator
4160 forward_done = self.device_module.Event()
4161 forward_done.record(stream=self.forward_stream)
4162 allocator.set_latest_forward_done_event(forward_done)
4163 # Write-set classification: hand the allocator this
4164 # forward's virtual out_cache_loc as a tensor ref (no GPU work).
4165 allocator.set_inflight_forward(
4166 forward_done,
4167 batch.out_cache_loc,
4168 )
4169 # FIXME(lsyin): maybe move this to forward_batch_generation
4170 batch_result.copy_done = self.device_module.Event()
4171 if batch_result.delay_sample_func is None:
4172 self._relay_forward_payload(
4173 batch, future_indices, batch_result
4174 )
4175 if _is_hip:
4176 # Cross-stream sync costs more than the tiny D2H it
4177 # overlaps.
4178 batch_result.copy_to_cpu(
4179 return_logprob=batch.return_logprob,
4180 return_hidden_states=batch.return_hidden_states,
4181 )
4182 else:
4183 # Result D2H on copy_stream overlaps the next forward
4184 # instead of serializing on forward_stream; it's a leaf
4185 # gated by copy_done, so nothing on forward_stream waits.
4186 self.copy_stream.wait_stream(self.forward_stream)
4187 with self.copy_stream_ctx:
4188 batch_result.copy_to_cpu(
4189 return_logprob=batch.return_logprob,
4190 return_hidden_states=batch.return_hidden_states,
4191 )
4192 else:
4193 batch_result.future_indices = future_indices
4194
4195 # Next-iter input_ids relayed via future_map.
4196 batch.input_ids = None
4197
4198 if not batch.spec_algorithm.is_none():
4199 batch.spec_info = batch_result.next_draft_input
4200 batch.spec_info.future_dsa_topk_indices_available = (
4201 batch.spec_info.dsa_topk_indices is not None
4202 )
4203 batch.spec_info.future_indices = future_indices
4204 elif self.enable_pdmux and batch.forward_mode.is_split_prefill():
4205 resolve_forward_inputs(batch, self.future_map)
4206 batch_result = self.tp_worker.forward_batch_split_prefill(batch)
4207 self._relay_forward_payload(batch, batch.req_pool_indices, batch_result)
4208 batch.input_ids = None
4209 self._copy_auxiliary_output_to_cpu(batch, batch_result)
4210 elif not batch.spec_algorithm.is_none():
4211 # Non-overlap: drive the V2 worker synchronously (no
4212 # future_map relay / on_publish).
4213 resolve_forward_inputs(batch, self.future_map)
4214 with self._forward_isolation(batch, overlap=False):
4215 batch_result = self.model_worker.forward_batch_generation(batch)
4216 # The isolation restore reverted the worker's in-forward SB edits;
4217 # re-apply what must carry to the next iter.
4218 batch.spec_info = batch_result.next_draft_input
4219 if batch_result.new_seq_lens is not None:
4220 batch.seq_lens = batch_result.new_seq_lens
4221 if batch.seq_lens_cpu is not None:
4222 batch.seq_lens_cpu = batch_result.new_seq_lens.to("cpu")
4223 batch.seq_lens_sum = int(batch.seq_lens_cpu.sum())
4224 batch.input_ids = None # rebuilt next iter from draft_token
4225 self.update_cache_from_scheduler(batch, batch_result)
4226 # Sync D2H so the result processor can read CPU tensors.
4227 batch_result.copy_done = self.device_module.Event()
4228 batch_result.copy_to_cpu(
4229 return_logprob=batch.return_logprob,
4230 return_hidden_states=batch.return_hidden_states,
4231 )
4232 else:
4233 kwargs = (
4234 {"pp_proxy_tensors": pp_proxy_tensors}
4235 if self.spec_algorithm.is_none()
4236 else {}
4237 )
4238 # NOTE 组装本轮 input_ids：prefill 取待计算片段，普通 decode 按 req slot 从 FutureMap 取上轮 token。
4239 resolve_forward_inputs(batch, self.future_map)
4240
4241 # NOTE 【推理入口】forward + sample
4242 batch_result = self.model_worker.forward_batch_generation(
4243 batch, **kwargs
4244 )
4245 if batch_result.has_sampled_token_ids:
4246 # Non-spec: relay via future_map, gathered next iter.
4247 # NOTE 【核心 3】将本轮生成的 token 存入 future_map，供下一轮 decode 取用。
4248 self._relay_forward_payload(
4249 batch, batch.req_pool_indices, batch_result
4250 )
4251 # 清除本轮输入，下轮再由 resolve_forward_inputs 按新批次组装。
4252 batch.input_ids = None
4253 # 缓存更新扩展钩子：当前 Scheduler 默认实现为 pass，可由扩展实现具体行为。
4254 self.update_cache_from_scheduler(batch, batch_result)
4255 # 必要时将附加输出从设备复制到 CPU，供后续结果处理使用。
4256 self._copy_auxiliary_output_to_cpu(batch, batch_result)
4257
4258 # These 2 values are needed for processing the output, but the values can be
4259 # modified by overlap schedule. So we have to copy them here so that
4260 # we can use the correct values in output processing.
4261 # 以下是各生成分支的公共收尾：保存本轮长度等元数据，供后续解析 logprob/隐藏状态输出。
4262 if batch.return_logprob or batch.return_hidden_states:
4263 batch_result.extend_input_len_per_req = [
4264 req.extend_range.length if req.extend_range is not None else 0
4265 for req in batch.reqs
4266 ]
4267 else:
4268 batch_result.extend_input_len_per_req = None
4269
4270 if batch.return_logprob:
4271 batch_result.extend_logprob_start_len_per_req = (
4272 batch.extend_logprob_start_lens
4273 )
4274 else:
4275 batch_result.extend_logprob_start_len_per_req = None
4276
4277 # 保存本次生成结果，由 run_batch 末尾返回给事件循环处理。
4278 ret = batch_result
4279 else: # embedding or reward model
4280 if self.enable_overlap:
4281 self.record_batch_in_overlap(batch)
4282 with self.forward_stream_ctx:
4283 self.forward_stream.wait_stream(self.schedule_stream)
4284 resolve_forward_inputs(batch, self.future_map)
4285 pooler_output, can_run_cuda_graph = (
4286 self.tp_worker.forward_batch_embedding(batch)
4287 )
4288 ret = EmbeddingBatchResult(
4289 embeddings=pooler_output.embeddings,
4290 pooled_hidden_states=pooler_output.pooled_hidden_states,
4291 can_run_cuda_graph=can_run_cuda_graph,
4292 )
4293 ret.copy_to_cpu()
4294 else:
4295 resolve_forward_inputs(batch, self.future_map)
4296 pooler_output, can_run_cuda_graph = (
4297 self.tp_worker.forward_batch_embedding(batch)
4298 )
4299 ret = EmbeddingBatchResult(
4300 embeddings=pooler_output.embeddings,
4301 pooled_hidden_states=pooler_output.pooled_hidden_states,
4302 can_run_cuda_graph=can_run_cuda_graph,
4303 )
4304
4305 self._maybe_report_active_ranks()
4306
4307 return ret

2.1.2.1 dispatch_event_loop()

注释已读 · 原始行号 5499–5543
5499def dispatch_event_loop(scheduler: Scheduler):
5500 """
5501 根据 PD 分离模式决定该节点启动哪种 loop()
5502 """
5503 # The live PP property asserts before torch.distributed init (MLX stub).
5504 disaggregation_mode: DisaggregationMode = scheduler.disaggregation_mode
5505 if disaggregation_mode == DisaggregationMode.NULL:
5506 # tip 不做 PD 分离走的路径
5507 if scheduler.enable_pdmux:
5508 scheduler.event_loop_pdmux()
5509 elif get_parallel().pp_size > 1:
5510 # 流水线并行走这里，将模型切到多张卡上
5511 scheduler.event_loop_pp()
5512 elif scheduler.enable_overlap_mlx:
5513 # 兼容 Apple 芯片
5514 scheduler.event_loop_overlap_mlx()
5515 elif scheduler.enable_overlap:
5516 # NOTE
5517 # CPU 调度和 GPU 计算重叠执行
5518 # 含义解读：GPU 算这一批的时候，CPU 同时去处理上一批的结果、准备下一批，两边都不空等
5519 # CPU: [组批1][组批2][处理结果1][组批3][处理结果2]
5520 # GPU: [计算1] [计算2] [计算3]
5521 scheduler.event_loop_overlap()
5522 else:
5523 # 串行执行
5524 # CPU: [组批1] [处理结果1][组批2] [处理结果2]
5525 # GPU: [计算1] [计算2]
5526 # ↑ GPU 空闲 ↑
5527 scheduler.event_loop_normal()
5528 elif disaggregation_mode == DisaggregationMode.PREFILL:
5529 # tip PD 分离模式下的 Prefill 实例
5530 if get_parallel().pp_size > 1:
5531 scheduler.event_loop_pp_disagg_prefill()
5532 elif scheduler.enable_overlap:
5533 scheduler.event_loop_overlap_disagg_prefill()
5534 else:
5535 scheduler.event_loop_normal_disagg_prefill()
5536 elif disaggregation_mode == DisaggregationMode.DECODE:
5537 # tip PD 分离模式下的 Decode 模式
5538 if get_parallel().pp_size > 1:
5539 scheduler.event_loop_pp_disagg_decode()
5540 elif scheduler.enable_overlap:
5541 scheduler.event_loop_overlap_disagg_decode()
5542 else:
5543 scheduler.event_loop_normal_disagg_decode()

注释已读 · 原始行号 5614–5711
5614def run_scheduler_process(
5615 server_args: ServerArgs,
5616 port_args: PortArgs,
5617 gpu_id: int,
5618 tp_rank: int,
5619 attn_cp_rank: int,
5620 moe_dp_rank: int,
5621 moe_ep_rank: int,
5622 pp_rank: int,
5623 dp_rank: Optional[int],
5624 pipe_writer,
5625 display_tp_rank: Optional[int] = None,
5626 display_dp_rank: Optional[int] = None,
5627 display_moe_ep_rank: Optional[int] = None,
5628):
5629 """
5630 NOTE 启动 Scheduler 子进程
5631 """
5632 # Load plugins so hooks can override Scheduler and its dependencies.
5633 load_plugins()
5634 # Publish before anything in this process reads configuration.
5635 # tip 将推理参数放到进程上下文中方便随时读取，代码在 sglang.srt.runtime_context
5636 publish(server_args, role="scheduler")
5637
5638 dp_rank = configure_scheduler_process(
5639 server_args,
5640 # 这个 scheduler 的 gpu 节点及其编码
5641 gpu_id,
5642 tp_rank,
5643 attn_cp_rank,
5644 moe_dp_rank,
5645 moe_ep_rank,
5646 pp_rank,
5647 dp_rank,
5648 display_tp_rank=display_tp_rank,
5649 display_dp_rank=display_dp_rank,
5650 display_moe_ep_rank=display_moe_ep_rank,
5651 )
5652 parent_process = psutil.Process().parent()
5653
5654 # Set up tracing
5655 if get_observability().enable_trace:
5656 process_tracing_init(
5657 get_observability().otlp_traces_endpoint,
5658 "sglang",
5659 trace_modules=get_observability().trace_modules,
5660 )
5661 thread_label = "Scheduler"
5662 if get_disagg().disaggregation_mode == "prefill":
5663 thread_label = "Prefill Scheduler"
5664 elif get_disagg().disaggregation_mode == "decode":
5665 thread_label = "Decode Scheduler"
5666 trace_set_thread_info(thread_label, tp_rank, dp_rank, pp_rank)
5667
5668 # Create a scheduler and run the event loop
5669 scheduler = None
5670 try:
5671 # NOTE Engine 创建 Scheduler 对象路径：
5672 # Engine._launch_subprocesses -> Engine._launch_subprocesses()-> Scheduler.run_scheduler_process
5673 scheduler = Scheduler(
5674 server_args,
5675 port_args,
5676 gpu_id,
5677 tp_rank,
5678 moe_ep_rank,
5679 pp_rank,
5680 attn_cp_rank,
5681 moe_dp_rank,
5682 dp_rank,
5683 )
5684
5685 # Send initialization info back to the parent process
5686 pipe_writer.send(scheduler.get_init_info())
5687
5688 # NOTE 启动 scheduler 进程
5689 # Run the event loop (blocks until a ShutdownReq sets gracefully_exit)
5690 scheduler.run_event_loop()
5691
5692 except Exception:
5693 traceback = get_exception_traceback()
5694 logger.error(f"Scheduler hit an exception: {traceback}")
5695 parent_process.send_signal(signal.SIGQUIT)
5696 # Opt-in: SIGKILL the pgroup so sibling ranks don't spew thousands
5697 # of NCCL/TCPStore tracebacks before they finally die.
5698 if envs.SGLANG_KILLPG_ON_SCHEDULER_EXCEPTION.get():
5699 try:
5700 os.killpg(os.getpgrp(), signal.SIGKILL)
5701 except Exception:
5702 pass
5703 finally:
5704 if scheduler is not None:
5705 # FPM has a background ZMQ publisher thread that needs explicit
5706 # teardown to flush queued metrics and close the socket cleanly.
5707 scheduler.metrics_reporter._shutdown_fpm()
5708 # Graceful path only: on the exception path the GPU may be wedged
5709 # and the synchronize() in destroy() could itself hang.
5710 if scheduler.gracefully_exit:
5711 scheduler.release_host_resources()

2.2.1.1 calc_priority()

注释已读 · 原始行号 242–298
242def calc_priority(
243 self, waiting_queue: List[Req], running_batch: Optional[ScheduleBatch] = None
244) -> None:
245 """NOTE 按照调度策略给 waiting_queue 排序"""
246 # tip 按照什么顺序从 waiting queue 获取数据
247 policy = self._determine_active_policy(waiting_queue)
248
249 # Populate req.num_matched_prefix_tokens at schedule time. Cache-aware policies
250 # set it in _compute_prefix_matches; do the same full match for
251 # cache-agnostic policies when the radix supports it, so the load
252 # snapshot has it. Skip on decode (never prefills).
253 if (
254 not isinstance(
255 policy, CacheAwarePolicy
256 ) # 不是考虑 tree cache 的调度策略 // 对应 prefix cache
257 and self.tree_cache.supports_fast_match_prefix()
258 and get_disagg().disaggregation_mode != "decode"
259 ):
260 # NOTE 计算waiting queue中每个请求匹配到的前缀长度并且更新到 req.num_matched_prefix_tokens
261 for r in waiting_queue:
262 match_prefix_for_req(self.tree_cache, r, include_req=True)
263
264 if self.policy == CacheAgnosticPolicy.FCFS:
265 if self.enable_priority_scheduling:
266 SchedulePolicy._sort_by_priority_and_fcfs(
267 waiting_queue, self.priority_sign
268 )
269 return
270
271 if isinstance(policy, CacheAwarePolicy):
272 temporary_deprioritized = self._compute_prefix_matches(
273 waiting_queue, policy
274 )
275 if policy == CacheAwarePolicy.LPM:
276 SchedulePolicy._sort_by_longest_prefix(
277 waiting_queue, temporary_deprioritized
278 )
279 elif policy == CacheAwarePolicy.DFS_WEIGHT:
280 SchedulePolicy._sort_by_dfs_weight(waiting_queue, self.tree_cache)
281 else:
282 raise ValueError(f"Unknown CacheAware Policy: {policy=}")
283 else:
284 if policy == CacheAgnosticPolicy.FCFS:
285 pass
286 elif policy == CacheAgnosticPolicy.LOF:
287 SchedulePolicy._sort_by_longest_output(
288 waiting_queue,
289 self.enable_priority_scheduling,
290 self.priority_sign,
291 )
292 elif policy == CacheAgnosticPolicy.RANDOM:
293 SchedulePolicy._sort_randomly(waiting_queue)
294 elif policy == CacheAgnosticPolicy.ROUTING_KEY:
295 if running_batch is not None:
296 SchedulePolicy._sort_by_routing_key(waiting_queue, running_batch)
297 else:
298 raise ValueError(f"Unknown CacheAgnostic Policy: {policy=}")

632 self.rem_mamba_slots += self.tree_cache.mamba_evictable_size()

635 priority_scheduling_preemption_threshold
636 )

888def _update_prefill_budget(
889 self,
890 prefix_len: int,
891 extend_input_len: int, # 参考 input_tokens, # 本轮没有命中 kv cache、要新算的 token 数
892 max_new_tokens: int, # max tokens
893 retracted_stain: bool,
894 mamba_gap_reserve: int = 0,
895 host_hit_len: int = 0,
896 storage_hit_len: int = 0,
897):
898 """把一个已选入本批的请求计入 PrefillAdder 的各项预算"""
899 # TODO(lsyin): check this workaround logic, which only ensures the prefill will not out of memory, and may be too conservative
900 extend_input_len = self.ceil_paged_tokens(extend_input_len)
901
902 # alloc_extend reserves an extra page_size per request to make sure the budget doesn't over-commit
903 page_overhead = self.page_size
904 # `mamba_gap_reserve` (shared Mamba pool only; 0 otherwise) charges the new
905 # mamba state's shared-gap cost to BOTH full budgets: the slot is allocated
906 # immediately (counts against `cur_rem`) and held for the request lifetime
907 # (counts against `rem_total`). See `_mamba_gap_budget_for_req`.
908 # NOTE rem_total_token_offset 从 0 开始
909 # 表示PrefillAdder 的总预算，核心是本轮 prefill + 将来 decode 要用的 KV
910 self.rem_total_token_offset += (
911 extend_input_len # input_tokens, # 本轮没有命中 kv cache 的输入、要新算的输入 token 数
912 + max_new_tokens # max tokens，仅仅是输出
913 + page_overhead # 分配缓存的 kv index 数量的最小单元，buffer
914 + mamba_gap_reserve
915 )
916 # NOTE cur_rem_token_offset 从0开始
917 # # 本轮预算：只算这轮 prefill 马上要分配的 KV
918 self.cur_rem_token_offset += (
919 extend_input_len + page_overhead + mamba_gap_reserve
920 )
921 # The new mamba slot also consumes one mamba-recoverable slot (gated
922 # separately so full_evictable can't cover it — see __init__).
923 if mamba_gap_reserve and self.rem_mamba_slots is not None:
924 self.rem_mamba_slots -= 1
925 self.rem_input_tokens -= extend_input_len
926
927 if self.is_hybrid_swa:
928 self.rem_swa_token_offset += self._swa_budget_for_req(
929 extend_input_len, max_new_tokens
930 )
931
932 if self.dllm_config is not None:
933 self.rem_dllm_tokens -= extend_input_len
934 elif self.rem_chunk_tokens is not None:
935 # NOTE 【重要】分块 prefill 额度扣掉本请求
936 self.rem_chunk_tokens -= extend_input_len
937
938 # reprocessed_log_* is a subset of log_*; metrics_reporter subtracts it
939 # when computing the first-attempt prefix cache hit rate.
940 self.log_hit_tokens += prefix_len
941 self.log_input_tokens += extend_input_len
942 if retracted_stain:
943 self.reprocessed_log_hit_tokens += prefix_len
944 self.reprocessed_log_input_tokens += extend_input_len
945 elif prefix_len > 0:
946 device_hit, host_hit, storage_hit = split_cached_prefix_by_tier(
947 prefix_len=prefix_len,
948 host_hit_len=host_hit_len,
949 storage_hit_len=storage_hit_len,
950 )
951 self.log_device_hit_tokens += device_hit
952 self.log_host_hit_tokens += host_hit
953 self.log_storage_hit_tokens += storage_hit

1038def add_chunked_req(self, req: Req):
1039 # tip dllm -> diffution llm
1040 if self.dllm_config is not None:
1041 _rem_tokens = self._get_dllm_remain_tokens()
1042 else:
1043 _rem_tokens = min(self.rem_chunk_tokens, int(self.rem_total_tokens))
1044 if self.is_hybrid_swa:
1045 # alloc_extend needs extend_num_tokens + page_size per request,
1046 # so reserve one page here to avoid OOM
1047 _rem_tokens = min(
1048 _rem_tokens, int(self.rem_swa_tokens) - self.page_size
1049 )
1050 # The chunked_req must be added to the list; otherwise, it will cause a memory leak.
1051 # Therefore, in certain cases where _rem_tokens <= 0, it should be replaced with rem_chunk_tokens.
1052 if _rem_tokens <= 0:
1053 if self.is_hybrid_swa:
1054 return req
1055 _rem_tokens = self.rem_chunk_tokens
1056
1057 # A mid-chunk rank prefills this pass regardless of the delayer
1058 # verdict, so report prefillable=True and ignore the result.
1059 if self.prefill_delayer_single_pass is not None:
1060 self.prefill_delayer_single_pass.negotiate_should_allow_prefill(
1061 local_prefillable=True,
1062 running_batch=self.running_batch.batch_size(),
1063 max_prefill_bs=self.max_prefill_bs,
1064 max_running_requests=self.max_running_requests,
1065 waiting_queue_len=self.waiting_queue_len,
1066 )
1067
1068 cand_extend_input_len = len(req.full_untruncated_fill_ids) - len(
1069 req.prefix_indices
1070 )
1071 truncated = cand_extend_input_len > _rem_tokens
1072 new_len = min(cand_extend_input_len, _rem_tokens)
1073 req.set_extend_range(len(req.prefix_indices), len(req.prefix_indices) + new_len)
1074 # NOTE 将 chunked_req 添加到 batch 中后也得更新 PrefillAdder 状态
1075 self.can_run_list.append(req)
1076 self._update_prefill_budget(
1077 0,
1078 req.extend_range.length,
1079 (
1080 min(req.sampling_params.max_new_tokens, CLIP_MAX_NEW_TOKENS)
1081 if not truncated
1082 else 0
1083 ),
1084 req.retracted_stain,
1085 mamba_gap_reserve=self._mamba_gap_budget_for_req(req),
1086 )
1087
1088 # Return if chunked prefill not finished
1089 return req if truncated else None

2.2.2.6 _lock_node()

注释已读 · 原始行号 1091–1108
1091@contextmanager # tip yield及其之前的代码对应加上 __enter__，yield 之后的代码对应 __exit__
1092def _lock_node(self, last_node: TreeNode):
1093 dec_lock_params = None
1094 try:
1095 # NOTE 设置 last_node 的加锁状态，result中保存了新增锁住的 kv index 数量
1096 result = self.tree_cache.inc_lock_ref(last_node)
1097 if self.tree_cache.is_tree_cache():
1098 # init_load_back may revive SWA/Mamba tombstones while this
1099 # temporary admission lock is held. Release must mirror the
1100 # exact nodes skipped at acquire time.
1101 dec_lock_params = result.to_dec_params()
1102 yield None
1103 finally:
1104 # note 解锁，在 try yield 后执行
1105 if dec_lock_params is not None:
1106 self.tree_cache.dec_lock_ref(last_node, dec_lock_params)
1107 else:
1108 self.tree_cache.dec_lock_ref(last_node)

1246def add_one_req(
1247 self, req: Req, has_chunked_req: bool, truncation_align_size: Optional[int]
1248):
1249 """
1250 NOTE req 是正在遍历的请求（waiting queue 中）
1251 """
1252 # TODO support cp with multiple requests
1253 # Enabling context parallelism currently presents precision issues;
1254 # therefore, the prefill-batch setting is temporarily set to 1.
1255 if (self.dsa_prefill_cp_in_seq_split) and len(self.can_run_list) >= 1:
1256 return AddReqResult.OTHER
1257
1258 if (x := self.prefill_max_requests) is not None and len(self.can_run_list) >= x:
1259 return AddReqResult.OTHER
1260
1261 if req.sampling_params.ignore_eos and getattr(self.tree_cache, "disable", True):
1262 return self.add_one_req_ignore_eos(req)
1263
1264 # Reserve page_size for page-alignment overhead: the paged allocator may
1265 # consume one extra page per request (see alloc_extend), which
1266 # _update_prefill_budget also deducts.
1267 max_new = min(
1268 max(req.sampling_params.max_new_tokens - len(req.output_ids), 0),
1269 CLIP_MAX_NEW_TOKENS,
1270 )
1271 # NOTE 估算这个请求要占多少 KV 编号：要算的输入 token（扣掉前缀缓存命中的部分）+ 之后最多生成的 token + page_size(一页对齐余量)。
1272 # 结果不要求是 page size 的整数、因为用来估算，分配 KV Index 的时候才会按照整数倍对齐
1273 #
1274 # 示例(page size = 4)
1275 # 上一轮请求 今天天气 -> 阴天，占用 6个 token，缓存了 prefill 4 个token、即 今天天气
1276 # 本轮请求：今天天气 -> 阴天，明天呢 ->(max_new = min(max_new_tokens - len(output_ids), CLIP_MAX_NEW_TOKENS)// 不知道输出什么，所以按照最大长度算)
1277 # 计算结果：9_输入token - 4_cache_for_prefill + max_new = 5+max_new
1278 #
1279 # 逻辑和代码对应关系：
1280 # cand_extend_input_len = 9_(今天天气 -> 阴天，明天呢) - 4_(cached_今天天气) = 5
1281 #
1282 cand_extend_input_len = len(req.full_untruncated_fill_ids) - len(
1283 req.prefix_indices
1284 )
1285 # NOTE max_new 是预期最多输出长度

1294 # 这个 Req 用到的前缀缓存的 KV index 编号列表
1295 prefix_len = len(req.prefix_indices)
1296
1297 # NOTE 剩余 KV 编号不够放下这个请求：返回 NO_TOKEN，调用方停止挑选
1298 if total_tokens >= self.rem_total_tokens:

1301 # tips 本轮 prefill 剩余额度

1308 real_input_tokens,

1311 )

1485 ) is not None:
1486 return tile_stop
1487
1488 # Chunked prefill
1489 # NOTE 设置参与计算的req token位置
1490 req.set_extend_range(
1491 len(req.prefix_indices), len(req.prefix_indices) + trunc_len
1492 )
1493
1494 self.can_run_list.append(req)
1495 self.new_chunked_req = req
1496
1497 self._req_inc_lock_ref(req)
1498 self._update_prefill_budget(
1499 prefix_len,
1500 trunc_len,
1501 0,
1502 req.retracted_stain,
1503 mamba_gap_reserve=self._mamba_gap_budget_for_req(req),
1504 host_hit_len=req.host_hit_length,
1505 storage_hit_len=req.storage_hit_length,
1506 )
1507
1508 # NOTE 【核心 6】按扣完后的剩余预算返回：编号用完 NO_TOKEN，token 或分块额度用完 OTHER，否则 CONTINUE 继续挑下一个
1509 return self.budget_state()

193def get_batch_return_hidden_states_mode(reqs: List[Req]) -> CaptureHiddenMode:
194 """
195 返回所有 req 中规格最高的 CaptureHiddenMode
196 # Do not capture anything.
197 NULL = 0
198 # Capture a hidden state of the last token.
199 LAST = 1
200 # Capture hidden states of all tokens.
201 FULL = 2
202 """
203 mode = CaptureHiddenMode.NULL
204 for req in reqs:
205 mode = max(mode, req.return_hidden_states_mode)
206 return mode

2303 token_to_kv_pool_allocator=token_to_kv_pool_allocator, # kv index -> kv value

2314 return_hidden_states_mode=return_hidden_states_mode, # FULL -> LAST -> NULL
2315 is_prefill_only=all(req.is_prefill_only for req in reqs),

2465def prepare_for_extend(self):
2466 """为 prefill（EXTEND）批准备输入，并分配槽位和 KV 编号。

2468 分析文档：schedule_batch.py.prepare_for_extend.md（同目录）

2470 self.forward_mode = ForwardMode.EXTEND # Prefill
2471

2473 # For DLLM, we use a separate forward mode
2474 self.forward_mode = ForwardMode.DLLM_EXTEND
2475
2476 # Init tensors
2477 # NOTE 按请求算本轮输入：input_ids 只取命中前缀之后的 token，extend_num_tokens 是要分配的 KV 编号数
2478 reqs = self.reqs
2479 # input ids 是个列表，里边每个列表是要计算的token、没有被前缀匹配缓存的 token
2480 input_ids = [r.get_fill_ids()[len(r.prefix_indices) :] for r in reqs]
2481 # input ids 对应的 token 总数
2482 extend_num_tokens = sum(len(ids) for ids in input_ids)
2483 # 每个请求截至本轮末尾的总序列长度，包含命中缓存的前缀和本轮待计算 token。

2487 # 被前缀缓存缓存的 token 长度序列
2488 prefix_lens = [len(r.prefix_indices) for r in reqs]
2489 # 各请求本轮待计算 token 的数量；对应 input_ids 中各段的长度。
2490 extend_lens = [r.extend_range.length for r in reqs]
2491
2492 # tip extend 的理解，比如 今天天气-> 阴天，
2493 # 今天 已经 prefill 了，在对 天气进行 prefill 就是 extend

2495 compute_extend_logprob_start_len(
2496 logprob_start_len=r.logprob_start_len,
2497 prefix_len=prefix_lens[i],
2498 extend_len=extend_lens[i],
2499 full_untruncated_fill_len=len(r.full_untruncated_fill_ids),
2500 )
2501 for i, r in enumerate(reqs)
2502 ]
2503
2504 _pin = is_pin_memory_available(self.device)
2505 # Stay on pinned CPU; H2D is deferred to forward stream via
2506 # resolve_forward_inputs.
2507 pinned_input_ids = flatten_arrays_to_pinned_cpu(input_ids, _pin)
2508 seq_lens_tensor = torch.tensor(seq_lens, dtype=torch.int64, pin_memory=_pin).to(
2509 self.device, non_blocking=True
2510 )
2511 seq_lens_cpu = torch.tensor(seq_lens, dtype=torch.int64)
2512 orig_seq_lens_tensor = torch.tensor(
2513 orig_seq_lens, dtype=torch.int32, pin_memory=_pin
2514 ).to(self.device, non_blocking=True)

2516 # Set batch fields needed by alloc_for_extend

2518 self.extend_lens = extend_lens
2519 self.seq_lens = seq_lens_tensor
2520 self.seq_lens_cpu = seq_lens_cpu

2522

2525 (
2526 out_cache_loc,
2527 req_pool_indices_tensor,
2528 req_pool_indices_cpu,
2529 ) = alloc_for_extend(self)
2530
2531 # Set fields

2533 all_replace_embeds: List[torch.Tensor] = []
2534 all_replace_positions: List[int] = []
2535 has_replace_embeds = False

2538 extend_input_logprob_token_ids = []

2540 mamba_track_mask_cpu = []

3521def maybe_evict_swa(self):
3522 # tip 反正 RadixCache 不支持 Slide Window Attention的KV淘汰策略，所以这里什么也不做
3523 if self.tree_cache.supports_swa():
3524 sliding_window_size = self.tree_cache.sliding_window_size
3525
3526 release_leaf_lock = (
3527 envs.SGLANG_OPT_SWA_RELEASE_LEAF_LOCK_AFTER_WINDOW.get()
3528 and hasattr(self.tree_cache, "dec_swa_lock_only")
3529 )
3530
3531 eviction_interval = max(1, envs.SGLANG_SWA_EVICTION_INTERVAL.get())
3532 self.token_to_kv_pool_allocator.free_group_begin()
3533 for idx, req in enumerate(self.reqs):
3534 if self.forward_mode.is_decode():
3535 # We set evict_swa condition here with two reasons:
3536 # 1. In overlap scheduler, we cannot evict swa when req.decode_batch_idx == 0 since the prev extend batch is still running.
3537 # 2. Evict only once >= eviction_interval tokens have slid
3538 # out of the window, amortizing eviction work while keeping
3539 # each request's overshoot within the interval the pool
3540 # budget reserves. Gating on accumulated tokens (rather
3541 # than an iteration-counter phase) cannot starve because
3542 # seqlen progress is monotonic per KV handle.
3543 if (
3544 req.decode_batch_idx >= 1
3545 and req.kv is not None
3546 and req.seqlen - 1 - sliding_window_size
3547 >= req.kv.swa_evicted_seqlen + eviction_interval
3548 ):
3549 self._evict_swa(req, req.seqlen - 1)
3550
3551 # Once the decode position has moved past the sliding window,
3552 # the SWA portion of the prefill-time tree lock is no longer
3553 # needed by this request. Convert it from protected to
3554 # evictable so SWA LRU can reclaim it under pressure.
3555 if (
3556 release_leaf_lock
3557 and not req.swa_prefix_lock_released
3558 and req.swa_uuid_for_lock is not None
3559 and req.last_node is not None
3560 and req.decode_batch_idx >= sliding_window_size
3561 ):
3562 self.tree_cache.dec_swa_lock_only(
3563 req.last_node,
3564 req.swa_uuid_for_lock,
3565 skip_lock_node_ids=req.skip_lock_node_ids,
3566 )
3567 req.swa_prefix_lock_released = True
3568 elif self.forward_mode.is_extend() and self.tree_cache.is_chunk_cache():
3569 pre_len = self.prefix_lens[idx]
3570 if self.enable_overlap:
3571 # In chunked prefill case, when the second extend batch is scheduling, the first extend batch is still running, so we cannot evict swa tokens
3572 if req.extend_batch_idx < 2:
3573 continue
3574 else:
3575 pre_len = (
3576 pre_len - get_schedule().chunked_prefill_size
3577 if get_schedule().chunked_prefill_size > 0
3578 else pre_len
3579 )
3580 self._evict_swa(req, pre_len)
3581 else:
3582 self._evict_swa(req, pre_len)
3583 self.token_to_kv_pool_allocator.free_group_end()

603def forward_batch_generation(
604 self,
605 batch: Optional[ScheduleBatch], # NOTE 任务
606 forward_batch: Optional[ForwardBatch] = None,
607 pp_proxy_tensors: Optional[PPProxyTensors] = None,
608 is_verify: bool = False,
609 skip_attn_backend_init: Optional[bool] = None, # deprecated
610 *,
611 capture_hidden_mode: Optional[CaptureHiddenMode] = None,
612) -> GenerationBatchResult:
613 """
614 NOTE 推理的核心方法：输入类型转换；
615 """
616 # Get forward batch from schedule batch
617 if batch is not None:
618 # update the consumer index of hicache to the running batch
619 self.set_hicache_consumer(batch.hicache_consumer_index)
620
621 # NOTE step 1 : 把 ScheduleBatch 转成模型要用的 GPU Tensor
622 forward_batch = ForwardBatch.init_new(
623 batch, # ScheduleBatch 类型
624 self.model_runner,
625 capture_hidden_mode=capture_hidden_mode,
626 return_hidden_states_before_norm=False,
627 )
628 else:
629 # FIXME(lsyin): unify the interface of forward_batch
630 assert forward_batch is not None
631 assert (
632 capture_hidden_mode is None
633 ), "capture_hidden_mode override requires a ScheduleBatch input"
634
635 # Deprecated kwarg: pre-planners mark the batch themselves now.
636 forward_batch.apply_deprecated_skip_attn_backend_init(skip_attn_backend_init)
637
638 if self.is_dllm():
639 return self._forward_batch_generation_dllm(forward_batch, batch)
640
641 if self.pp_group.is_last_rank:
642 # NOTE Step 2 【核心方法】，ModelRunner进行推理，内部选择 EAGER 或者 CUDA Graph 方法
643 out = self.model_runner.forward(
644 forward_batch,
645 pp_proxy_tensors=pp_proxy_tensors, # 一般路径为 None
646 )
647 # TODO
648 logits_output, can_run_cuda_graph = out.logits_output, out.can_run_graph
649 batch_result = GenerationBatchResult(
650 logits_output=logits_output,
651 can_run_cuda_graph=can_run_cuda_graph,
652 expert_distribution_metrics=out.expert_distribution_metrics,
653 routed_experts_output=out.routed_experts_output,
654 indexer_topk_output=out.indexer_topk_output,
655 )
656
657 capture_pre_sample_logits(batch, forward_batch, logits_output)
658
659 if is_verify:
660 # Skip sampling; spec_v2 worker fires its own publish post-verify.
661 return batch_result
662
663 # 【Step 3】采样：按温度、top-k、top-p 选出下一个 token；部分情况推迟到 Scheduler 下一轮再采
664 # Delay sampling only for normal generation requests.
665 # Keep the existing grammar behavior unchanged.
666 if (
667 self.enable_overlap
668 and not self.enable_spec
669 and (
670 forward_batch.sampling_info.grammars is not None
671 or (
672 envs.SGLANG_ENABLE_DELAY_SAMPLE.get()
673 and not forward_batch.is_prefill_only
674 )
675 )
676 ):
677
678 def sample_batch_func():
679 batch_result.next_token_ids = self.model_runner.sample(
680 logits_output, forward_batch
681 )
682 return batch_result
683
684 batch_result.delay_sample_func = sample_batch_func
685 return batch_result
686
687 if not forward_batch.is_prefill_only:
688 # NOTE 已经有了每个token的分数，这里 sample 出下一个 token
689 # For normal requests, sample the next token ids.
690 batch_result.next_token_ids = self.model_runner.sample(
691 logits_output, forward_batch # 前者含 logits，后者提供批次与采样参数。
692 )
693 else:
694 # For prefill-only requests, create dummy token IDs on CPU
695 # The size should match the batch size (number of sequences), not total tokens
696 batch_result.next_token_ids = torch.zeros(
697 len(forward_batch.seq_lens),
698 dtype=torch.long,
699 device=forward_batch.input_ids.device,
700 )
701 if (
702 forward_batch.return_logprob
703 and logits_output.next_token_logits is not None
704 ):
705 # NOTE: Compute logprobs without full sampling
706 self.model_runner.compute_logprobs_only(
707 logits_output, forward_batch
708 )
709
710 return batch_result
711 else:
712 out = self.model_runner.forward(
713 forward_batch,
714 pp_proxy_tensors=pp_proxy_tensors,
715 )
716 pp_proxy_tensors, can_run_cuda_graph = out.logits_output, out.can_run_graph
717 return GenerationBatchResult(
718 pp_hidden_states_proxy_tensors=pp_proxy_tensors,
719 can_run_cuda_graph=can_run_cuda_graph,
720 expert_distribution_metrics=out.expert_distribution_metrics,
721 )

1133def init_torch_distributed(self):
1134 """初始化多卡通信，多卡通信负责：
1135 1. 建立 tp_rank / pp_rank 等并行上下文，供后续加载器选择本卡的权重切片，
1136 常规文件加载路径由各进程读权重；远程加载等路径另有数据传输。
1137 2. 支持并行计算：
1138 - TP（Tensor Parallelism）：按层与实现执行 all-reduce 等通信，合并各卡的部分计算结果
1139 - PP（Pipeline Parallelism）：相邻两段之间 send/recv 隐藏向量
1140 - EP（Expert Parallelism）：all-to-all，把 token 发到专家所在的卡再收回
1141 - rank 0 用 broadcast_pyobj 把请求广播给其他卡
1142 GPU 张量走 NCCL（NVIDIA Collective Communications Library），CPU 上的 Python 对象走 gloo
1143 """
1144 result = bootstrap.init_torch_distributed(
1145 server_args=self.server_args,
1146 model_config=self.model_config,
1147 device=self.device,
1148 ps=self.ps,
1149 dist_port=self.dist_port,
1150 is_draft_worker=self.is_draft_worker,
1151 local_omp_cpuid=self.local_omp_cpuid if self.device == "cpu" else None,
1152 )
1153 self.tp_group = result.tp_group # tensor parallel
1154 self.pp_group = result.pp_group # pipeline parallel
1155 # attention tensor parallel，和 tp_group 区别是：只用于 attention 层的 TP 组，
1156 # 不开 DP（Data Parallelism）attention 和 CP（Context Parallelism）时，attention_tp_group 和 tp_group 相同
1157 self.attention_tp_group = result.attention_tp_group
1158 self.pre_model_load_memory = result.pre_model_load_memory

1645def forward(

1652) -> ModelRunnerOutput:
1653 """NOTE 使用已加载的权重执行 forward。
1654
1655 普通 eager 执行链路（未走 CUDA Graph；prefill/decode 均调用模型 forward）：
1656
1657 ModelRunner.forward()
1658 ↓
1659 ModelRunner._forward_raw()
1660 ↓
1661 EagerRunner.execute()
1662 ├─ prefill → _execute_extend()
1663 └─ decode → _execute_decode()
1664 ↓
1665 model_runner.model.forward(...)
1666
1667 Qwen 3.5 dense 原生模型的调用关系：
1668
1669 ModelRunner.model
1670 = Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration 对象
1671 ↓ forward() 继承自父类
1672 Qwen3VLForConditionalGeneration.forward()
1673 ↓ 直接或经输入处理辅助函数调用内部文本模型
1674 Qwen3_5ForCausalLM.forward()
1675 ↓
1676 token embedding → 逐层计算 → 最终归一化

1679
1680 加载时机：服务启动初始化 ModelRunner 时，load_model() 根据模型配置选择
1681 Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration、创建实例并加载权重，然后保存到 self.model 供各轮 forward() 复用。
1682 """

1685

1698 step_span_ctx = profile_range(build_step_span_name(forward_batch))
1699
1700 canary_ctx = (
1701 context_tuple(
1702 c.with_ops_outside_graph(
1703 single_forward_indices=[0],
1704 maybe_inaccurate_forward_batch=forward_batch,
1705 ),

1820def _forward_raw(
1821 self,
1822 forward_batch: ForwardBatch, # 推理任务
1823 pp_proxy_tensors: Optional[PPProxyTensors],
1824 reinit_attn_backend: bool = False,
1825 split_forward_count: int = 1,
1826) -> ModelRunnerOutput:
1827 """
1828 NOTE 执行模型推理的地方
1829 """
1830 if has_forward_context():
1831 ctx_mgr = contextlib.nullcontext()
1832 else:
1833 ctx_mgr = forward_context(ForwardContext(attn_backend=self.attn_backend))
1834 with ctx_mgr:
1835 # tip
1836 mode_check = (
1837 forward_batch.forward_mode.is_cpu_graph
1838 if self.device == "cpu"
1839 else forward_batch.forward_mode.is_cuda_graph
1840 )
1841 # TODO 也是核心，判断能否进行 CUDA Graph 执行优化
1842 can_run_graph = bool(
1843 mode_check()
1844 and self.decode_cuda_graph_runner
1845 and self.decode_cuda_graph_runner.can_run_graph(forward_batch)
1846 )
1847
1848 if (
1849 forward_batch.forward_mode.is_decode()
1850 and self.hisparse_coordinator is not None
1851 ):
1852 forward_batch.hisparse_coordinator = self.hisparse_coordinator
1853 self.hisparse_coordinator.wait_for_pending_backup()
1854 self.hisparse_coordinator.num_real_reqs.fill_(forward_batch.batch_size)
1855
1856 # Replay cuda graph if applicable
1857 if can_run_graph:
1858 # TODO 看下 CUDA Graph 链路
1859 ret = self.decode_cuda_graph_runner.execute(
1860 forward_batch,
1861 pp_proxy_tensors=pp_proxy_tensors,
1862 )
1863 return ModelRunnerOutput(logits_output=ret, can_run_graph=can_run_graph)
1864
1865 # DP / MLP-sync padding + attn-tp normalization. Only the decode
1866 # cuda-graph path above pre-pads its static buffers and returns
1867 # early; split prefill, the prefill cuda graph, and the eager
1868 # forward all run the live batch and need this first — it sets
1869 # global_dp_buffer_len / padded token counts that graph eligibility
1870 # and the collectives depend on.
1871 self._prepare_eager_forward_batch(forward_batch)
1872
1873 # Deferred mamba COW/clear on the forward stream, before the extend
1874 # dispatch below reads the pool.
1875 self._maybe_execute_deferred_mamba_cow_and_clear(forward_batch)
1876
1877 dwdp_mgr = get_global_dwdp_manager()
1878 if dwdp_mgr is not None:
1879 dwdp_mgr.prefetch_first_layers()
1880
1881 if forward_batch.forward_mode.is_split_prefill():
1882 # Layer-split mode; stays on ModelRunner, not the eager runner.
1883 ret = self.forward_split_prefill(
1884 forward_batch,
1885 reinit_attn_backend=reinit_attn_backend,
1886 forward_count=split_forward_count,
1887 )
1888 elif (
1889 forward_batch.forward_mode.is_extend(include_draft_extend_v2=True)
1890 and not isinstance(self.prefill_cuda_graph_runner, EagerRunner)
1891 and self.prefill_cuda_graph_runner is not None
1892 and self.prefill_cuda_graph_runner.can_run_graph(forward_batch)
1893 and _prefill_cuda_graph_allows_context_parallel(
1894 self.prefill_cuda_graph_runner, forward_batch
1895 )
1896 ):
1897 # Prefill cuda graph (piecewise).
1898 kwargs = self._extend_forward_kwargs(forward_batch, pp_proxy_tensors)
1899 category = (
1900 "target_verify"
1901 if forward_batch.forward_mode.is_target_verify()
1902 else "extend"
1903 )
1904 # TODO: the timing here is too broad -- it also includes
1905 # load_batch time. Move it into the prefill cuda graph runner
1906 # to capture only the model.forward part.
1907 with device_timer_ctx(self.device_timer, category):
1908 ret = self.prefill_cuda_graph_runner.execute(
1909 forward_batch, **kwargs
1910 )
1911 can_run_graph = True
1912 else:
1913 # Eager: decode / extend / idle dispatched inside the runner.
1914 # NOTE 普通 eager 前向链路：得到 logits，采样在后续单独执行。
1915 ret = self.eager_runner.execute(
1916 forward_batch, pp_proxy_tensors=pp_proxy_tensors
1917 )
1918
1919 if (
1920 forward_batch.global_num_tokens_cpu is not None
1921 and self.pp_group.is_last_rank
1922 ):
1923 forward_batch.post_forward_mlp_sync_batch(ret)

1925 return ModelRunnerOutput(logits_output=ret, can_run_graph=can_run_graph)

1955def sample(
1956 self,
1957 logits_output: LogitsProcessorOutput,
1958 forward_batch: ForwardBatch,
1959) -> torch.Tensor:
1960 """Sample and compute logprobs and update logits_output.
1961
1962 Args:
1963 logits_output: The logits output from the model forward
1964 forward_batch: The forward batch that generates logits_output
1965
1966 Returns:
1967 A list of next_token_ids
1968 """
1969 # LogitsProcessorOutput is normally invocation-scoped, but CUDA graph
1970 # runners may reuse backing objects. Never leak an auxiliary result from
1971 # a previous replay into a request with no observer state.
1972 logits_output.auxiliary_device_output = None
1973 observer = self.sampling_observer
1974 # Preserve two-argument overrides when observation is inactive.
1975 if observer is not None and observer.is_active(forward_batch.sampling_info):
1976 observer_state = self._preprocess_logits(
1977 logits_output,
1978 forward_batch.sampling_info,
1979 observer=observer,
1980 )
1981 else:
1982 observer_state = self._preprocess_logits(
1983 logits_output, forward_batch.sampling_info
1984 )
1985
1986 # Sample the next tokens
1987 next_token_ids = self.sampler(
1988 logits_output,
1989 forward_batch.sampling_info,
1990 forward_batch.return_logprob,
1991 forward_batch.top_logprobs_nums,
1992 forward_batch.token_ids_logprobs,
1993 # For prefill, we only use the position of the last token.
1994 (
1995 forward_batch.positions
1996 if forward_batch.forward_mode.is_decode()
1997 else forward_batch.seq_lens - 1
1998 ),
1999 )
2000 if observer_state is not None:
2001 logits_output.auxiliary_device_output = observer.after_sample(
2002 observer_state,
2003 next_token_ids,
2004 )
2005 self.ngram_embedding_manager.update_after_decode(
2006 next_token_ids=next_token_ids,
2007 forward_batch=forward_batch,
2008 )
2009 return next_token_ids

886 num_tokens = len(batch.input_ids) if batch.input_ids is not None else 0
887 if enable_num_token_non_padded():
888 ret.num_token_non_padded = torch.tensor(
889 num_tokens,
890 dtype=torch.int32,
891 pin_memory=is_pin_memory_available(device),
892 ).to(device, non_blocking=True)
893 ret.num_token_non_padded_cpu = num_tokens
894
895 ret.init_mlp_sync_metadata(batch, device)
896
897 if ret.forward_mode.is_idle():
898 ret.positions = torch.empty((0,), dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
899 if model_runner.lora_manager is not None:
900 model_runner.lora_manager.reset_lora_batch()
901 return ret
902
903 # Override the positions with diffusion LLM or spec_info
904 if batch.dllm_config is not None:
905 block_size = batch.dllm_config.block_size
906 # Use int64 for AMD rotary embedding kernel compatibility
907 positions_dtype = torch.int64 if is_hip() or _is_npu else torch.int32
908 ret.positions = torch.tensor(
909 [
910 i
911 for block_offset in (req.dllm_block_offset for req in batch.reqs)
912 for i in range(block_offset, block_offset + block_size)
913 ],
914 dtype=positions_dtype,
915 ).to(device, non_blocking=True)
916 elif (
917 ret.spec_info is not None
918 and getattr(ret.spec_info, "positions", None) is not None
919 ):
920 ret.positions = ret.spec_info.positions
921
922 # Init position information
923 if ret.forward_mode.is_decode() or ret.forward_mode.is_target_verify():
924 if ret.positions is None:
925 ret.positions = clamp_position(batch.seq_lens)
926 else:
927 if isinstance(extend_seq_lens, list):
928 # Main path: H2D from host lists; populate *_cpu mirrors.
929 assert isinstance(extend_prefix_lens, list)
930 pin_memory = is_pin_memory_available(device)
931 ret.extend_seq_lens = torch.tensor(
932 extend_seq_lens, dtype=torch.int32, pin_memory=pin_memory
933 ).to(device, non_blocking=True)
934 ret.extend_prefix_lens = torch.tensor(
935 extend_prefix_lens, dtype=torch.int32, pin_memory=pin_memory
936 ).to(device, non_blocking=True)
937 ret.extend_prefix_lens_cpu = extend_prefix_lens
938 ret.extend_seq_lens_cpu = extend_seq_lens
939 else:
940 # gpu_only: device tensors handed in directly; leave *_cpu unset.
941 assert isinstance(extend_seq_lens, torch.Tensor)
942 ret.extend_seq_lens = extend_seq_lens
943 ret.extend_prefix_lens = extend_prefix_lens
944 ret.extend_num_tokens = batch.extend_num_tokens
945 positions, ret.extend_start_loc = compute_position(
946 model_runner.prefill_attention_backend_str,
947 ret.extend_prefix_lens,
948 ret.extend_seq_lens,
949 ret.extend_num_tokens,
950 )
951 if ret.positions is None:
952 ret.positions = positions
953 ret.extend_logprob_start_lens_cpu = extend_logprob_start_lens
954
955 if model_runner.ngram_embedding_manager.enabled:
956 ret._init_ngram_embedding_info(batch, device)
957
958 if model_runner.model_config.model_is_mrope:
959 if (
960 ret.spec_info is not None
961 and getattr(ret.spec_info, "positions", None) is not None
962 ):
963 ret.compute_spec_mrope_positions(model_runner, batch)
964 elif ret.forward_mode.is_draft_extend_v2():
965 # Draft-extend tokens are uniform text continuation; reuse the
966 # spec mrope path with the input-consistent `ret.positions` rather
967 # than the per-request rebuild (which mis-sizes mm requests).
968 ret.compute_spec_mrope_positions(
969 model_runner, batch, seq_positions=ret.positions
970 )
971 else:
972 ret._compute_mrope_positions(model_runner, batch)
973
974 # Init lora information (None on a draft runner: it is unadapted)
975 if model_runner.lora_manager is not None:
976 # In the non-LoRA overlap loading case, we fetch LoRA adapters into the memory pool
977 # as a batch, right before running the batch
978 if not get_lora().enable_lora_overlap_loading:
979 model_runner.lora_manager.fetch_new_loras(set(ret.lora_ids))
980
981 model_runner.lora_manager.prepare_lora_batch(ret)
982
983 if (
984 model_runner.ps.attn_dcp_size > 1
985 and ret.out_cache_loc is not None
986 and is_hip()
987 ):
988 ret.dcp_kv_mask = (
989 ret.positions % model_runner.ps.attn_dcp_size
990 == model_runner.ps.attn_dcp_rank
991 )
992
993 return ret

2.7.1.1 execute()

推定已读 · 链路补全 · 原始行号 216–234
216def execute(
217 self, forward_batch: ForwardBatch, pp_proxy_tensors=None, **kwargs
218) -> Any:
219 mode = forward_batch.forward_mode
220 if mode.is_mixed() and not is_npu() and get_cp_strategy() is None:
221 # A mixed batch is extend-shaped (decode tails are 1-token
222 # extends); run it as EXTEND. NPU keeps MIXED for its dedicated
223 # kernel; CP keeps it to skip the zigzag split.
224 forward_batch.forward_mode = ForwardMode.EXTEND
225 mode = ForwardMode.EXTEND
226 if mode.is_decode():
227 # NOTE Decode
228 return self._execute_decode(forward_batch, pp_proxy_tensors)
229 if mode.is_idle():
230 return self._execute_idle(forward_batch, pp_proxy_tensors)
231 if mode.is_extend(include_draft_extend_v2=True):
232 # NOTE Prefill
233 return self._execute_extend(forward_batch, pp_proxy_tensors)
234 raise ValueError(f"Invalid forward mode for eager runner: {mode}")

2.7.1.2 _execute_decode()

注释已读 · 原始行号 249–288
249def _execute_decode(
250 self,
251 forward_batch: ForwardBatch,
252 pp_proxy_tensors=None,
253) -> Union[LogitsProcessorOutput, PPProxyTensors]:
254 """
255 NOTE 执行一次 forward
256 返回结果：
257 不开 Pipeline Parallelism 或者是 Pipeline Parallelism 的最后一段 返回 LogitsProcessorOutput，
258 LogitsProcessorOutput#next_token_logits基本数据结构是 [请求数, vocab_size]：
259 1）请求数量是指forward可以同时处理多个推理请求；
260 2）vocab_size 是词汇表大小、也就是token总体数量，每个位置都记录了对应token的分数，后边归一化等处理后得到这个token被选中的概率
261 PP 的中间段：返回 PPProxyTensors，是要传给下一段卡的隐藏向量
262 """
263 model_runner = self.model_runner
264 enable_pdmux = self.enable_pdmux
265 attn_backend, pdmux_ctx = self._resolve_decode_pdmux()
266 if not enable_pdmux:
267 forward_batch = self.load_batch(forward_batch, pp_proxy_tensors)
268 if forward_batch.needs_forward_metadata_init():
269 if hasattr(model_runner.model, "prepare_forward_batch"):
270 # Prepare model-specific attention metadata before planning,
271 # e.g. Moss-VL's prefill cross-attention custom mask.
272 model_runner.model.prepare_forward_batch(forward_batch)
273 attn_backend.init_forward_metadata(forward_batch)
274 # FIXME: add pp_proxy_tensors arg to all models
275 kwargs = model_runner._pp_kwargs(pp_proxy_tensors)
276
277 ctx = device_timer_ctx(model_runner.device_timer, "decode")
278
279 with ctx, pdmux_ctx:
280 # NOTE 进行一次 forward 计算
281 # model 是什么类型完全由模型卡的 config.json#architectures决定
282 # qwen3.8-27B 可以参考 Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration(Qwen3VLForConditionalGeneration)#forward()方法
283 return model_runner.model.forward(
284 forward_batch.input_ids, # 之前序列的 token id 列表
285 forward_batch.positions,
286 forward_batch,
287 **kwargs,
288 )

2.7.1.3 _execute_extend()

注释已读 · 原始行号 290–403
290def _execute_extend(
291 self,
292 forward_batch: ForwardBatch, # 推理入参
293 pp_proxy_tensors=None,
294) -> Union[LogitsProcessorOutput, PPProxyTensors, EmbeddingPoolerOutput]:
295 """
296 NOTE Prefill 推理链路
297 """
298 model_runner = self.model_runner
299 kwargs = model_runner._extend_forward_kwargs(forward_batch, pp_proxy_tensors)
300
301 if not self.enable_pdmux:
302 forward_batch = self.load_batch(forward_batch, pp_proxy_tensors)
303 cp_v2_active = is_cp_v2_active(forward_batch)
304 if cp_v2_active:
305 prepare_cp_forward(forward_batch)
306
307 # Target verify can arrive with ``forward_metadata_ready`` set by an
308 # upstream/speculative planning step. That mark does not initialize
309 # the final target hybrid backend, and unlike a graph replay eager has
310 # no static metadata load to fill the gap. Re-plan target verify from
311 # the final batch every time; eager metadata is intentionally derived
312 # directly from the live ``spec_info`` tensors.
313 if (
314 forward_batch.needs_forward_metadata_init()
315 or cp_v2_active
316 or forward_batch.forward_mode.is_target_verify()
317 ):
318 if model_runner.ps.attn_dcp_size > 1 and hasattr(
319 model_runner.model, "prepare_context_parallel_metadata_for_dcp"
320 ):
321 # prepare kv cache buffer for dcp to gather kv cache
322 forward_batch.attn_dcp_metadata = (
323 model_runner.model.prepare_context_parallel_metadata_for_dcp(
324 forward_batch.seq_lens,
325 forward_batch.extend_prefix_lens,
326 forward_batch.extend_prefix_lens_cpu,
327 forward_batch.extend_seq_lens,
328 forward_batch.req_pool_indices,
329 get_req_to_token_pool().req_to_token,
330 forward_batch.seq_lens_sum,
331 get_token_to_kv_pool().get_kv_buffer_shape()[0],
332 model_runner.kv_cache_dtype,
333 model_runner.device,
334 create_chunked_prefix_cache_kv_indices,
335 )
336 )
337 if hasattr(model_runner.model, "prepare_forward_batch"):
338 # Prepare model-specific attention metadata before planning,
339 # e.g. Moss-VL's prefill cross-attention custom mask.
340 model_runner.model.prepare_forward_batch(forward_batch)
341 model_runner.attn_backend.init_forward_metadata(forward_batch)
342 model_runner.attn_backend.prepare_prefill_shared_read_snapshot(
343 forward_batch,
344 num_qo_tokens=len(forward_batch.input_ids),
345 )
346 maybe_publish_prefill_shared_read_done(
347 model_runner,
348 forward_batch,
349 torch.get_device_module(model_runner.device),
350 )
351
352 if not cp_v2_active:
353 forward_batch.attn_cp_metadata = None
354
355 category = (
356 "target_verify"
357 if forward_batch.forward_mode.is_target_verify()
358 else "extend"
359 )
360 with device_timer_ctx(model_runner.device_timer, category):
361 pcg_runner = model_runner.prefill_cuda_graph_runner
362 if (
363 _is_hip
364 and pcg_runner is not None
365 and not isinstance(pcg_runner, EagerRunner)
366 and not cp_v2_active
367 ):
368 # HIP PCG eager fallback: enter the PCG context so Dynamo guards
369 # and PCG-specific MoE/attention paths stay consistent.
370 with (
371 enable_tc_piecewise_cuda_graph(),
372 set_tc_piecewise_forward_context(
373 forward_batch,
374 model_runner.attention_layers,
375 getattr(model_runner.model, "quant_config", None),
376 model_runner.moe_layers,
377 model_runner.moe_fusions,
378 dsa_indexers=model_runner.dsa_indexers,
379 mha_companion_layers=model_runner.mha_companion_layers,
380 ),
381 ):
382 ret = model_runner.model.forward(
383 forward_batch.input_ids,
384 forward_batch.positions,
385 forward_batch,
386 **kwargs,
387 )
388 elif cp_v2_active:
389 # TODO 后边看下 context parallelism
390 ret = self._execute_extend_cp_v2(forward_batch, kwargs)
391 else:
392 # NOTE qwen 3.5 架构模型看 Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration
393 # 对应模型卡 config.json 配置：
394 # "architectures": [
395 # "Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration"
396 # ]
397 ret = model_runner.model.forward(
398 forward_batch.input_ids,
399 forward_batch.positions,
400 forward_batch,
401 **kwargs,
402 )
403 return ret
