3.1.1.2 forward()

注释已读 · 原始行号 1446–1532
1446@torch.no_grad()
1447def forward(
1448 self,
1449 input_ids: torch.Tensor, # tip 本轮参与计算的 token ID 拼接成一维；普通 decode 通常每请求一个，prefill 可以多个
1450 positions: torch.Tensor,
1451 forward_batch: ForwardBatch, # tip 请求参数
1452 get_embedding: bool = False,
1453 pp_proxy_tensors: Optional[PPProxyTensors] = None,
1454):
1455 """Run forward pass for Qwen3-VL.
1456 NOTE 重点 qwen3.8-27B 的 forward实现
1457
1458 Args:
1459 input_ids: Flattened (concatenated) input_ids corresponding to a
1460 batch.
1461 positions: Flattened (concatenated) position ids corresponding to a
1462 batch.
1463 **NOTE**: If mrope is enabled (default setting for Qwen2-VL
1464 opensource models), the shape will be `(3, seq_len)`,
1465 otherwise it will be `(seq_len,).
1466 (Use input_metadata.mrope_positions to replace it)
1467 """
1468 if self.is_mrope_enabled:
1469 positions = forward_batch.mrope_positions
1470
1471 if self.language_model_only:
1472 # NOTE 第一部分：embedding -> transformer layer -> Norm // Qwen3_5ForCausalLM
1473 # 备注：模型初始化加载了哪几层 transformer layer 就用哪几层计算 // 重点
1474 #
1475 # 返回结果说明
1476 # 最后一个 PP stage 的 hidden_states 为 [num_tokens, hidden_size]；中间 stage 返回 PPProxyTensors
1477 # num_tokens：prefill 为各请求本轮实际计算的 token 数之和；普通 decode 通常等于本轮请求数量
1478 # hidden_size：表示输入 token 向量长度
1479 hidden_states = self.model(
1480 input_ids=input_ids,
1481 forward_batch=forward_batch,
1482 positions=positions,
1483 pp_proxy_tensors=pp_proxy_tensors,
1484 )
1485 else:
1486 if not (
1487 forward_batch.forward_mode.is_decode()
1488 or not forward_batch.contains_image_inputs()
1489 ):
1490 if self.is_mrope_enabled:
1491 assert positions.ndim == 2 and positions.size(0) == 3, (
1492 "multimodal section rotary embedding requires "
1493 f"(3, seq_len) positions, but got {positions.size()}"
1494 )
1495 hidden_states = general_mm_embed_routine(
1496 input_ids=input_ids,
1497 forward_batch=forward_batch,
1498 language_model=self.model,
1499 multimodal_model=self,
1500 positions=positions,
1501 use_deepstack=self.use_deepstack,
1502 pp_proxy_tensors=pp_proxy_tensors,
1503 )
1504
1505 aux_hidden_states = None
1506 if self.capture_aux_hidden_states:
1507 hidden_states, aux_hidden_states = hidden_states
1508
1509 if self.pp_group.is_last_rank:
1510 if not get_embedding:
1511 # NOTE 第二部分：lm_head -> logits -> x
1512 #
1513 # hidden_states -> LogitsProcessorOutput
1514 # 调用链：LogitsProcessor 继承了 nn.Module，所以调用的是forward()
1515 # PyTorch 里，参与前向计算的组件习惯都继承 nn.Module
1516 #
1517 # 调用链路 self.logits_processor()
1518 # -> LogitsProcessor.forward()
1519 # -> _get_pruned_states()
1520 # -> _get_logits()
1521 # -> _compute_lm_head()：代码是 torch.matmul(hidden_states, lm_head.weight.T)
1522 return self.logits_processor(
1523 input_ids,
1524 hidden_states,
1525 self.lm_head, # NOTE lm_head 计算是在 logits_processor 中计算的
1526 forward_batch,
1527 aux_hidden_states,
1528 )
1529 else:
1530 return self.pooler(hidden_states, forward_batch)
1531 else:
1532 return hidden_states

330 prefix=add_prefix("in_proj_ba", prefix),
331 tp_rank=self.attn_tp_rank,
332 tp_size=self.attn_tp_size,
333 )
334
335 # Override weight loaders for packed checkpoint format.
336 # Important: for FP8, this must cover not only `.weight` but also
337 # `weight_scale_inv` / `weight_scale` / `input_scale` if present.
338 self._bind_packed_weight_loaders(self.in_proj_qkvz)
339 self._bind_packed_weight_loaders(self.in_proj_ba)
340 self._fused_input_proj_cpu_enabled = LazyValue(
341 lambda: (
342 _is_cpu
343 and self.in_proj_qkvz.weight.dtype == torch.bfloat16
344 and self.in_proj_ba.weight.dtype == torch.bfloat16
345 and self.in_proj_qkvz.bias is None
346 and self.in_proj_ba.bias is None
347 and use_intel_amx_backend(self.in_proj_qkvz)
348 and use_intel_amx_backend(self.in_proj_ba)
349 and (
350 self.in_proj_qkvz.weight.size(0) % 32 == 0
351 and self.in_proj_ba.weight.size(0) % 32 == 0
352 )
353 )
354 )
355
356 # Conv1d weight loader setup
357 query_key_settings = (self.key_dim, 0, False)
358 value_settings = (self.value_dim, 0, False)
359
360 self._override_weight_loader(
361 self.conv1d.weight,
362 mamba_v2_sharded_weight_loader(
363 [
364 query_key_settings,
365 query_key_settings,
366 value_settings,
367 ],
368 self.attn_tp_size,
369 self.attn_tp_rank,
370 ),
371 )
372
373 # State parameters
374 self.dt_bias = nn.Parameter(
375 torch.ones(self.num_v_heads // self.attn_tp_size),
376 )
377 self.A_log = nn.Parameter(
378 torch.empty(self.num_v_heads // self.attn_tp_size, dtype=torch.float32),
379 )
380
381 set_weight_attrs(self.A_log, {"weight_loader": sharded_weight_loader(0)})
382 set_weight_attrs(self.dt_bias, {"weight_loader": sharded_weight_loader(0)})
383
384 conv_weights = self.conv1d.weight.view(
385 self.conv1d.weight.size(0), self.conv1d.weight.size(2)
386 )
387
388 # NOTE
389 # 读写卷积状态 conv_states 与递推状态 ssm_states
390 # 执行因果卷积，准备 Q/K/V
391 # 根据 a、b 等参数进行门控递推，不使用 softmax
392 # 更新历史状态并计算本轮输出
393 self.attn = RadixLinearAttention(
394 layer_id=layer_id,
395 num_q_heads=self.num_k_heads // self.attn_tp_size,
396 num_k_heads=self.num_k_heads // self.attn_tp_size,
397 num_v_heads=self.num_v_heads // self.attn_tp_size,
398 head_q_dim=self.head_k_dim,
399 head_k_dim=self.head_k_dim,
400 head_v_dim=self.head_v_dim,
401 conv_weights=conv_weights,
402 bias=self.conv1d.bias,
403 activation=self.activation,
404 A_log=self.A_log,
405 dt_bias=self.dt_bias,
406 )
407
408 self.norm = RMSNormGated(
409 self.head_v_dim,
410 eps=self.layer_norm_epsilon,
411 group_size=None,
412 norm_before_gate=True,
413 device=torch.get_device_module().current_device(),
414 dtype=torch.get_default_dtype(),
415 **(
416 {"activation": self.output_gate_type}
417 if self.output_gate_type is not None
418 else {}
419 ),
420 )
421
422 self.out_proj = RowParallelLinear(
423 self.value_dim,
424 self.hidden_size,
425 bias=False,
426 input_is_parallel=True,
427 reduce_results=False,
428 quant_config=quant_config,
429 tp_rank=self.attn_tp_rank,
430 tp_size=self.attn_tp_size,
431 prefix=add_prefix("out_proj", prefix),
432 )

3.2.1.2 forward()

推定已读 · 链路补全 · 原始行号 714–795
714def forward(
715 self,
716 hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
717 forward_batch: ForwardBatch,
718):
719 """
720 Forward pass with three parts:
721 1. Input projection
722 2. Core attention (custom op)
723 3. Output projection
724 """
725 projected_states_qkvz, projected_states_ba = self._forward_input_proj(
726 hidden_states
727 )
728
729 if _is_xpu and get_exec().mamba.linear_attn_backend == "intel_xpu":
731
732 backend = get_attn_backend()
733 backend = getattr(backend, "linear_attn_backend", backend)
734 if backend.supports_fused_gdn(self.attn, forward_batch):
735 return self._forward_xpu(
736 backend, projected_states_qkvz, projected_states_ba, forward_batch
737 )
738
739 if (
740 self.num_v_heads // self.num_k_heads in _GDN_FUSED_QKVZBA_RATIOS
741 and not _is_npu
742 ):
743 if _is_cpu:
744 num_k_heads_tp = self.num_k_heads // self.attn_tp_size
745 num_v_heads_tp = self.num_v_heads // self.attn_tp_size
746 else:
747 num_k_heads_tp = triton.cdiv(self.num_k_heads, self.attn_tp_size)
748 num_v_heads_tp = triton.cdiv(self.num_v_heads, self.attn_tp_size)
749 mixed_qkv, z, b, a = fused_qkvzba_split_reshape_cat_contiguous(
750 projected_states_qkvz,
751 projected_states_ba,
752 num_k_heads_tp,
753 num_v_heads_tp,
754 self.head_k_dim,
755 self.head_v_dim,
756 )
757 else:
758 query, key, value, z, b, a = self.fix_query_key_value_ordering(
759 projected_states_qkvz, projected_states_ba
760 )
761 b = b.contiguous()
762 a = a.contiguous()
763
764 query, key, value = map(
765 lambda x: x.reshape(x.shape[0], -1), (query, key, value)
766 )
767 mixed_qkv = torch.cat((query, key, value), dim=-1)
768
769 core_attn_out = self.attn(
770 forward_batch,
771 mixed_qkv=mixed_qkv,
772 a=a,
773 b=b,
774 )
775
776 z_shape_og = z.shape
777 # reshape input data into 2D tensor
778 core_attn_out = core_attn_out.reshape(-1, core_attn_out.shape[-1])
779 z = z.reshape(-1, z.shape[-1])
780
781 # Add padding for DP-Attn
782 if core_attn_out.shape != z.shape:
783 core_attn_out_pad = torch.zeros_like(z)
784 core_attn_out_pad[: core_attn_out.shape[0], :] = core_attn_out
785 core_attn_out = core_attn_out_pad
786
787 core_attn_out = self.norm(core_attn_out, z)
788 core_attn_out = core_attn_out.reshape(z_shape_og)
789 core_attn_out = core_attn_out.reshape(
790 *core_attn_out.shape[:-2],
791 core_attn_out.shape[-2] * core_attn_out.shape[-1],
792 )
793
794 output, _ = self.out_proj(core_attn_out)
795 return output

3.2.2.2 forward()

推定已读 · 链路补全 · 原始行号 881–938
881def forward(
882 self,
883 hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
884 residual: Optional[torch.Tensor],
885 **kwargs,
886):
887 forward_batch = kwargs.get("forward_batch", None)
888
889 hidden_states, residual = (
890 self.layer_communicator.prepare_attn_and_capture_last_layer_outputs(
891 hidden_states,
892 residual,
893 forward_batch,
894 captured_last_layer_outputs=kwargs.get(
895 "captured_last_layer_outputs", None
896 ),
897 )
898 )
899
900 if not forward_batch.forward_mode.is_idle() and hidden_states.shape[0] > 0:
901 hidden_states = self.linear_attn(
902 hidden_states,
903 forward_batch,
904 )
905
906 # Fully Connected
907 hidden_states, residual = self.layer_communicator.prepare_mlp(
908 hidden_states, residual, forward_batch
909 )
910
911 mlp_reduce_scatter = self.layer_communicator.should_use_reduce_scatter(
912 forward_batch
913 )
914
915 fuse_mlp_allreduce = (
916 self.layer_communicator.should_fuse_mlp_allreduce_with_next_layer(
917 forward_batch
918 )
919 )
920 with get_forward().scoped(
921 fuse_mlp_allreduce=fuse_mlp_allreduce,
922 mlp_reduce_scatter=mlp_reduce_scatter,
923 ):
924 if isinstance(self.mlp, Qwen2MoeSparseMoeBlock):
925 hidden_states = self.mlp(
926 hidden_states,
927 forward_batch,
928 )
929 else:
930 hidden_states = self.mlp(hidden_states)
931 if fuse_mlp_allreduce:
932 hidden_states._sglang_needs_allreduce_fusion = True
933 else:
934 hidden_states, residual = self.layer_communicator.postprocess_layer(
935 hidden_states, residual, forward_batch
936 )
937
938 return hidden_states, residual

3.2.3.2 _apply_qk_norm()

注释已读 · 原始行号 1114–1167
1114def _apply_qk_norm(
1115 self,
1116 q: torch.Tensor,
1117 k: torch.Tensor
1118) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
1119 """Apply Q/K normalization with optional alt_stream overlap.
1120
1121 NOTE 对 Q、K 进行归一化，目的是控制 Q @ K.T 的结果尺度（我之前一直以为是在计算之后控制的）
1122 Q 放大 10 倍，K 也放大 10 倍
1123 → Q @ K.T 就会放大 100 倍
1124 q.shape = [num_tokens, self.q_size]
1125 = [num_tokens, self.num_heads * self.head_dim]
1126
1127 k.shape = [num_tokens, self.kv_size]
1128 = [num_tokens, self.num_kv_heads * self.head_dim]
1129 num_tokens：本轮传入的 token 数
1130 """
1131 if (
1132 self.alt_stream is not None
1133 and get_is_capture_mode()
1134 and _qknorm_use_alt_stream
1135 ):
1136 current_stream = torch.cuda.current_stream()
1137 self.alt_stream.wait_stream(current_stream)
1138 q_by_head = q.reshape(-1, self.head_dim)
1139 q_by_head = self.q_norm(q_by_head)
1140 with torch.cuda.stream(self.alt_stream):
1141 k_by_head = k.reshape(-1, self.head_dim)
1142 k_by_head = self.k_norm(k_by_head)
1143 current_stream.wait_stream(self.alt_stream)
1144 elif _is_hip or _is_xpu or _is_cpu:
1145 q_by_head, k_by_head = fused_qk_gemma_rmsnorm(
1146 q,
1147 k,
1148 self.q_norm.weight.data,
1149 self.k_norm.weight.data,
1150 self.q_norm.variance_epsilon,
1151 self.head_dim,
1152 )
1153 else:
1154 # NOTE 对 q、k 分别尽心归一化
1155
1156 # 将 tensor_q 搞成 [x, head_dim] 维度的tensor，【每个head是一行】
1157 q_by_head = q.reshape(-1, self.head_dim)
1158 # 每个元素：res_i = x_i / sqrt(mean(x_all ** 2) + eps) * (1 + weight_i)
1159 # x_all：当前 token、当前 Q 头的完整输入向量；x_i 是其中第 i 个元素。
1160 # mean(x_all ** 2)：先逐个平方，再求平均，即 sum(x_all ** 2) / head_dim。
1161 # weight_i：模型学习的第 i 维参数；res_i：归一化并缩放后的第 i 个元素。
1162 q_by_head = self.q_norm(q_by_head)
1163 k_by_head = k.reshape(-1, self.head_dim)
1164 k_by_head = self.k_norm(k_by_head)
1165 q = q_by_head.view(q.shape)
1166 k = k_by_head.view(k.shape)
1167 return q, k

1198 def forward_prepare_native(self, positions, hidden_states):
1199 """
1200 NOTE 计算qkv 并 norm(q,k) 来控制数据尺度
1201 """
1202 if _use_aiter and isinstance(hidden_states, tuple):
1203 hidden_states = _select_fused_ar_input_for_linear(
1204 hidden_states, self.qkv_proj
1205 )
1206 # NOTE 第一部分
1207 #
1208 # 计算输入向量的 qkv：
1209 # 1)输入向量有多个；2)每个输入向量分别和3个 q_weight/k_weight/v_weight 计算后得到每个token对应的 qkv
1210 #
1211 # 调用链路： QKVParallelLinear 对象调用 -> 继承的 ColumnParallelLinear.forward() -> quant_method.apply()；未量化时为 UnquantizedLinearMethod.apply()
1212 qkv, _ = self.qkv_proj(hidden_states)
1213
1215 if self.attn_output_gate:
1216 q_gate, k, v = qkv.split(
1217 [self.q_size * 2, self.kv_size, self.kv_size], dim=-1
1218 )
1219 orig_shape = q_gate.shape[:-1]
1220 q_gate = q_gate.view(*orig_shape, self.num_heads, -1)
1221 q, gate = torch.chunk(q_gate, 2, dim=-1)
1222 q = q.reshape(*orig_shape, -1)
1223 # gate stays as 3D strided view; fused_sigmoid_mul handles it directly
1224 else:
1225 #
1226 # NOTE 第二部分
1227 #
1228 # qkv 是 [num_tokens, output_size_per_partition]
1229 # split(size_list, dim) 沿着 dim 维度，将一个 tensor 拆分成多个 tensor，拆分规则按照 size_list 来
1230 #
1231 # Qwen3_5AttentionDecoderLayer.__init__() 时：
1232 # self.q_size = self.num_heads * self.head_dim // q_head数量 * q_dim
1233 # self.kv_size = self.num_kv_heads * self.head_dim // kv_head * kv_dim
1234 q, k, v = qkv.split([self.q_size, self.kv_size, self.kv_size], dim=-1)
1235 gate = None
1236
1237 # NOTE 第三部分
1238 #
1239 # 目的是控制 Q @ K.T 的结果尺度（我之前一直以为是在计算之后控制的）
1240 # Q 放大 10 倍，K 也放大 10 倍
1241 # → Q @ K.T 就会放大 100 倍
1242 # 对 qk 进行归一化，控制向量数值的尺度
1243 q, k = self._apply_qk_norm(q, k)
1244
1245# tag all_reduce 为啥 是元素相加
1246# o_proj 前：
1247# 两卡的数据表示不同的头 → 逻辑上应该拼接
1248
1249# o_proj 后：
1250# 两卡的数据表示对同一组最终输出维度的贡献 → 应该相加
1251 q, k = self.rotary_emb(positions, q, k)
1252 return q, k, v, gate

注释已读 · 原始行号 1305–1351
1305def self_attention(
1306 self,
1307 positions: torch.Tensor,
1308 hidden_states: torch.Tensor, # 本轮 token 在当前层的 hidden_states（已经过输入归一化）
1309 forward_batch: ForwardBatch,
1310) -> torch.Tensor:
1311 """Full attention forward pass.
1312 NOTE TODO: QKV 投影、Q/K 归一化与 RoPE、KV 缓存读写、可选门控和输出投影 ——核心逻辑
1313 """
1314 if _is_cuda and self.attn_output_gate:
1315 q, k, v, gate = self.forward_prepare_cuda_fused(
1316 positions=positions,
1317 hidden_states=hidden_states,
1318 )
1319 elif (_is_hip or _is_xpu or _is_cpu) and self.attn_output_gate:
1320 q, k, v, gate = self.forward_prepare_fused_gate(
1321 positions=positions,
1322 hidden_states=hidden_states,
1323 )
1324 elif (
1325 not _is_npu
1326 or forward_batch.forward_mode.is_extend_or_draft_extend_or_mixed()
1327 or not self.attn_output_gate
1328 ):
1329 # NOTE 默认链路
1330 q, k, v, gate = self.forward_prepare_native(
1331 positions=positions,
1332 hidden_states=hidden_states,
1333 )
1334 else:
1335 q, k, v, gate = self.forward_prepare_npu(
1336 positions=positions,
1337 hidden_states=hidden_states,
1338 forward_batch=forward_batch,
1339 )
1340
1341 attn_output = self.attn(q, k, v, forward_batch)
1342
1343 if self.attn_output_gate:
1344 if not _is_npu:
1345 attn_output = fused_sigmoid_mul(attn_output, gate, inplace=True)
1346 else:
1347 gate_val = gate.reshape(gate.shape[0], -1) if gate.ndim == 3 else gate
1348 attn_output.mul_(torch.sigmoid(gate_val))
1349
1350 output, _ = self.o_proj(attn_output)
1351 return output

1395 )

1399 ):
1400 # NOTE 4. 执行前馈网络：Dense 使用普通 MLP，MoE 使用专家网络。
1401 if isinstance(self.mlp, Qwen2MoeSparseMoeBlock):
1402 hidden_states = self.mlp(

1410 hidden_states._sglang_needs_allreduce_fusion = True
1411 else:
1412 hidden_states, residual = self.layer_communicator.postprocess_layer(

3.2.4.2 forward()

注释已读 · 原始行号 1601–1679
1601@torch.no_grad()
1602def forward(
1603 self,
1604 input_ids: torch.Tensor,
1605 positions: torch.Tensor,
1606 forward_batch: ForwardBatch,
1607 input_embeds: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
1608 pp_proxy_tensors: Optional[PPProxyTensors] = None,
1609 input_deepstack_embeds: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
1610) -> Union[torch.Tensor, PPProxyTensors]:
1611 """这里执行 embedding、当前 PP stage 的 transformer 层计算；最后一个 stage 再执行最终 norm"""
1612
1613 # NOTE 第一步
1614 # embedding 在第一个 PP stage、进入 transformer 层之前计算；若已有 input_embeds 则直接使用
1615 # Initialize hidden states
1616 if self.pp_group.is_first_rank:
1617 if input_embeds is None:
1618 # NOTE
1619 hidden_states = self.embed_tokens(input_ids)
1620 else:
1621 hidden_states = input_embeds
1622 residual = None
1623 else:
1624 assert pp_proxy_tensors is not None
1625 hidden_states = pp_proxy_tensors["hidden_states"]
1626 residual = pp_proxy_tensors["residual"]
1627
1628 aux_hidden_states = []
1629 # Pass through decoder layers
1630 for layer_idx in range(self.start_layer, self.end_layer):
1631 # NOTE 遍历当前 PP stage 负责的每一层 transformer layer，layer 也是 nn.Module 的实现，是 Qwen3_5AttentionDecoderLayer 或者是 Qwen3_5LinearDecoderLayer
1632 layer = self.layers[layer_idx]
1633 with get_global_expert_distribution_recorder().with_current_layer(
1634 layer_idx
1635 ):
1636 # todo 调用 Qwen3_5AttentionDecoderLayer 或 Qwen3_5LinearDecoderLayer的 forward()
1637 hidden_states, residual = layer(
1638 positions=positions,
1639 hidden_states=hidden_states,
1640 residual=residual,
1641 forward_batch=forward_batch,
1642 captured_last_layer_outputs=(
1643 aux_hidden_states
1644 if getattr(layer, "_is_layer_to_capture", False)
1645 else None
1646 ),
1647 )
1648
1649 # Process deepstack embeddings if provided
1650 if (
1651 input_deepstack_embeds is not None
1652 and input_deepstack_embeds.numel() > 0
1653 and layer_idx < 3
1654 ):
1655 sep = self.hidden_size * layer_idx
1656 hidden_states.add_(
1657 input_deepstack_embeds[:, sep : sep + self.hidden_size]
1658 )
1659
1660 # Return intermediate tensors for pipeline parallelism
1661 if not self.pp_group.is_last_rank:
1662 return PPProxyTensors(
1663 {
1664 "hidden_states": hidden_states,
1665 "residual": residual,
1666 }
1667 )
1668
1669 # Apply final normalization
1670 if hidden_states.shape[0] != 0:
1671 if residual is None:
1672 hidden_states = self.norm(hidden_states)
1673 else:
1674 hidden_states, _ = self.norm(hidden_states, residual)
1675
1676 if len(aux_hidden_states) == 0:
1677 return hidden_states
1678
1679 return hidden_states, aux_hidden_states

2040def load_weights(self, weights: Iterable[Tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]):
2041 weights = QWEN3_5_KV_SCALE_MAPPER.apply(weights)
2042 stacked_params_mapping = [
2043 # (param_name, shard_name, shard_id)
2044 ("qkv_proj", "q_proj", "q"),
2045 ("qkv_proj", "k_proj", "k"),
2046 ("qkv_proj", "v_proj", "v"),
2047 ("gate_up_proj", "gate_proj", 0),
2048 ("gate_up_proj", "up_proj", 1),
2049 # GDN fused projections
2050 ("in_proj_qkvz.", "in_proj_qkv.", (0, 1, 2)),
2051 ("in_proj_qkvz.", "in_proj_z.", 3),
2052 ("in_proj_ba.", "in_proj_b.", 0),
2053 ("in_proj_ba.", "in_proj_a.", 1),
2054 ]
2055
2056 loaded_params: Set[str] = set()
2057 params_dict = dict(self.named_parameters(remove_duplicate=False))
2058 for name, loaded_weight in weights:
2059 if "rotary_emb.inv_freq" in name:
2060 continue
2061 if "mtp" in name:
2062 continue
2063 if "language_model" in name:
2064 name = name.replace(r"model.language_model.", r"model.")
2065 if ".self_attn." in name:
2066 name = name.replace(".self_attn", "")
2067 if (
2068 self.config.tie_word_embeddings
2069 and self.pp_group.is_last_rank
2070 and "model.embed_tokens.weight" in name
2071 ):
2072 if "lm_head.weight" in params_dict:
2073 lm_head_param = params_dict["lm_head.weight"]
2074 weight_loader = getattr(
2075 lm_head_param, "weight_loader", default_weight_loader
2076 )
2077 weight_loader(lm_head_param, loaded_weight)
2078 layer_id = get_layer_id(name)
2079 if (
2080 layer_id is not None
2081 and hasattr(self, "start_layer")
2082 and (layer_id < self.start_layer or layer_id >= self.end_layer)
2083 ):
2084 continue
2085
2086 for param_name, weight_name, shard_id in stacked_params_mapping:
2087 if weight_name not in name:
2088 continue
2089
2090 if "visual" in name or "mlp.experts" in name:
2091 continue
2092
2093 name = name.replace(weight_name, param_name)
2094 # Skip loading extra bias for GPTQ models.
2095 if name.endswith(".bias") and name not in params_dict:
2096 continue
2097 # Skip layers on other devices.
2098 # if is_pp_missing_parameter(name, self):
2099 # continue
2100 if name not in params_dict:
2101 continue
2102 param = params_dict[name]
2103 weight_loader = getattr(param, "weight_loader")
2104 weight_loader(param, loaded_weight, shard_id)
2105 break
2106 else:
2107 if "visual" in name:
2108 # adapt to VisionAttention
2109 name = name.replace(r"attn.qkv.", r"attn.qkv_proj.")
2110 name = name.replace(r"model.visual.", r"visual.")
2111
2112 # print(name, loaded_weight.shape)
2113 # Skip loading extra bias for GPTQ models.
2114 if name.endswith(".bias") and name not in params_dict:
2115 continue
2116 if name not in params_dict:
2117 logger.warning(f"Parameter {name} not found in params_dict")
2118 continue
2119 param = params_dict[name]
2120
2121 weight_loader = getattr(param, "weight_loader", default_weight_loader)
2122 weight_loader(param, loaded_weight)
2123 if (
2124 self.config.tie_word_embeddings
2125 and name == "model.embed_tokens.weight"
2126 and (_is_cpu and _is_amx_available)
2127 ):
2128 param_lm_head = params_dict["lm_head.weight"]
2129 weight_loader = getattr(
2130 param_lm_head, "weight_loader", default_weight_loader
2131 )
2132 weight_loader(param_lm_head, loaded_weight)
2133 loaded_params.add(name)
2134 return loaded_params

3.3.1.2 _embed_local_shard()

注释已读 · 原始行号 528–566
528def _embed_local_shard(self, input_: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
529 """Embed against the local vocab shard; out-of-shard rows are zero
530 (identity when tp_size == 1).
531
532 The output must be allocated inside the symmetric-memory context so
533 the caller's all-reduce can use it; the mask temporaries and the
534 in-place fill deliberately stay outside the pool.
535 """
536 symm_alloc = use_symmetric_memory(
537 get_tp_group(), disabled=not is_allocation_symmetric()
538 )
539 if self.tp_size == 1:
540 with symm_alloc:
541 # NOTE token -> embedding，未量化时调用 UnquantizedEmbeddingMethod.embedding()
542 return self.quant_method.embedding(self, input_.long())
543 if self._use_triton_embedding(input_):
544 with symm_alloc:
545 return fused_vocab_parallel_embedding(
546 input_,
547 self.weight,
548 self.shard_indices.org_vocab_start_index,
549 self.shard_indices.org_vocab_end_index,
550 self.shard_indices.num_org_vocab_padding,
551 self.shard_indices.added_vocab_start_index,
552 self.shard_indices.added_vocab_end_index,
553 )
554 # Map out-of-shard ids to index 0, gather, then zero those rows.
555 masked_input, input_mask = get_masked_input_and_mask(
556 input_,
557 self.shard_indices.org_vocab_start_index,
558 self.shard_indices.org_vocab_end_index,
559 self.shard_indices.num_org_vocab_padding,
560 self.shard_indices.added_vocab_start_index,
561 self.shard_indices.added_vocab_end_index,
562 )
563 with symm_alloc:
564 output_parallel = self.quant_method.embedding(self, masked_input.long())
565 output_parallel.masked_fill_(input_mask.unsqueeze(-1), 0)
566 return output_parallel

3.3.1.3 forward()

注释已读 · 原始行号 568–585
568def forward(self, input_):
569 """
570 NOTE：将输入 token 进行向量化
571 """
572 # Surface a bad token id (>= vocab_size, or a negative / unmasked sentinel) as a
573 # located async assert instead of a silent OOB embedding gather (tp=1 does not mask).
574 maybe_detect_oob(
575 input_, 0, self.num_embeddings, "VocabParallelEmbedding input id"
576 )
577 # NOTE 将输入token进行向量
578 output_parallel = self._embed_local_shard(input_)
579 if self.tp_size > 1 and not get_attn_tp_context().input_scattered:
580 if self.use_attn_tp_group:
581 output_parallel = attn_tp_all_reduce(output_parallel)
582 else:
583 # Reduce across all the model parallel GPUs.
584 output_parallel = tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce(output_parallel)
585 return output_parallel

3.4.2.2 forward()

注释已读 · 原始行号 493–516
493def forward(self, input_):
494 bias = self.bias if not self.skip_bias_add else None
495
496 # Matrix multiply.
497 assert self.quant_method is not None
498 # NOTE 虽然名称是量化方法，但是可能是非量化版本
499 #
500 # 【输入输出说明】
501 # input_ @ weight.T
502 # [num_tokens, hidden_size] × [hidden_size, output_size_per_partition]
503 # ↓
504 # [num_tokens, output_size_per_partition]
505 #
506 # num_tokens 表示本轮实际参与计算的 token 总数：
507 # - Prefill：各请求本轮计算的 token 数之和，不包含直接复用缓存的部分。
508 # - 普通 Decode：通常每个请求计算一个 token，因此等于本轮请求数
509 output_parallel = self.quant_method.apply(self, input_, bias)
510 if self.gather_output:
511 # All-gather across the partitions.
512 output = tensor_model_parallel_all_gather(output_parallel)
513 else:
514 output = output_parallel
515 output_bias = self.bias if self.skip_bias_add else None
516 return output, output_bias

注释已读 · 原始行号 256–312
256def apply(
257 self,
258 layer: torch.nn.Module,
259 x: torch.Tensor,
260 bias: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
261) -> torch.Tensor:
262 """
263 NTOE 参数说明 layer 是线性层（此处为 qkv_proj），x 是输入 hidden_states，bias 是可选偏置
264 """
265 if use_intel_amx_backend(layer):
266 x_shapes = x.shape
267 if len(x_shapes) == 3:
268 x = x.view(-1, x.shape[-1])
269 output = torch.ops.sgl_kernel.weight_packed_linear(
270 x,
271 layer.weight,
272 bias,
273 True, # is_vnni
274 )
275 if len(x_shapes) == 3:
276 output = output.view(x_shapes[0], x_shapes[1], -1)
277 return output
278
279 elif _use_aiter and type(layer.weight.data) is torch.Tensor:
280 return tgemm.mm(x, layer.weight, bias, otype=x.dtype)
281
282 elif (
283 get_bf16_gemm_backend().is_cutedsl()
284 and x.is_cuda
285 and x.dtype == torch.bfloat16
286 and layer.weight.dtype == torch.bfloat16
287 and (bias is None or bias.dtype == torch.bfloat16)
288 and not layer.weight.requires_grad
289 and (bias is None or not bias.requires_grad)
290 ):
291 if torch.compiler.is_compiling():
292 # The m-dependent kernel heuristic would guard on the symbolic
293 # token dim under Dynamo and recompile per shape bucket; the
294 # opaque op resolves it at runtime with concrete shapes,
295 # keeping the per-shape kernel choice.
296 return bf16_gemm_dispatch(x, layer.weight, bias)
297 if _use_cutedsl_bf16_gemm(
298 x.numel() // x.shape[-1],
299 layer.weight.shape[0],
300 layer.weight.shape[1],
301 ):
302 x_shapes = x.shape
303 output = _cutedsl_bf16_gemm(
304 x.view(-1, x_shapes[-1]), layer.weight, bias
305 )
306 return output.view(*x_shapes[:-1], -1)
307 return F.linear(x, layer.weight, bias)
308
309 # NOTE F -> torch.nn.functional
310 # 通用核心：F.linear 即 x @ layer.weight.T + bias；bias=None 时不加偏置
311 #
312 return F.linear(x, layer.weight, bias)

3.6.1 GemmaRMSNorm

class GemmaRMSNorm(BaseFusedOp)
1059"""Gemma 风格的 RMS 归一化，先控制向量尺度，再逐维缩放。
1060
1061RMS = Root Mean Square（均方根）：逐个平方 -> 求平均 -> 开平方。
1062 x = [3, 4]
1063 RMS(x) = sqrt((3² + 4²) / 2) = sqrt(12.5) ≈ 3.536
1064
1065GemmaRMSNorm 的核心公式：
1066 y = x / sqrt(mean(x**2) + eps) * (1 + weight)
1067mean 只沿 x 的最后一维计算；除法和乘法均为逐元素运算。
1068同一个向量的所有元素共用一个分母，不同向量独立计算分母。
1069
1070参数来源：
1071 eps：预先设置的极小正数，默认 1e-6，不参与训练学习；
1072 用于数值稳定，避免输入全零时除零，通常来自 config.rms_norm_eps。
1073 weight：训练学到的逐维参数，推理时从模型权重文件加载。
1074 对于 x.shape = [..., D]，weight.shape = [D]，与 x 最后一维长度相同；
1075 前面的维度通过广播共享这组参数。Q/K 按头归一化时 D = head_dim。
1076 构造时先初始化为 0，再加载实际权重；Gemma 的实际缩放系数是
1077 1 + weight，因此某一维 weight=0 时，该维的缩放系数为 1。
1078
1079计算示例：假设 x = [3, 4]，weight = [0.5, -0.5]，eps = 1e-6。
1080 1. 计算分母：sqrt((3² + 4²) / 2 + eps) ≈ 3.536。
1081 2. 每个元素除以分母：x_norm ≈ [0.849, 1.131]。
1082 3. 计算逐维缩放系数：1 + weight = [1.5, 0.5]。
1083 4. 逐元素相乘：y = x_norm * [1.5, 0.5] ≈ [1.273, 0.566]。
1084输出形状与输入相同；归一化控制整体尺度，weight 提供模型学到的逐维调整。
1085
1086若传入 residual，则先合并残差，再对合并后的向量执行上述归一化。
1087"""

4. 注意力与缓存

161def forward(
162 self,
163 q,
164 k,
165 v,
166 forward_batch: ForwardBatch,
167 save_kv_cache: bool = True, # NOTE 是否把本批新算的 K/V 写入 KV 池
168 key_value_num_tokens: Optional[int] = None,
169 **kwargs,
170):
171 if k is not None:
172 # For cross-layer sharing, kv can be None
173 assert v is not None
174 if "k_rope" not in kwargs:
175 # NOTE 整理成 [token 数, KV 头数, head_dim]，与 KV 池每一格的形状一致
176 k = k.view(-1, self.tp_k_head_num, self.qk_head_dim)
177 v = v.view(-1, self.tp_v_head_num, self.v_head_dim)
178 else:
179 k = k.view(-1, self.tp_k_head_num, self.v_head_dim)
180
181 context = get_tc_piecewise_forward_context()
182 # NOTE prefill 走分段 CUDA Graph（torch.compile）时，把注意力包成自定义算子调用，内部仍交给注意力后端
183 if (
184 forward_batch.forward_mode.is_extend()
185 and context is not None
186 # ``_force_eager_attn`` is only set inside Inkling's eager
187 # norm+attn+sconv region, never during tc-piecewise capture. Reading
188 # the ContextVar under the fullgraph torch.compile trace is
189 # untraceable ("Unsupported method call: ContextVar.get"), so
190 # short-circuit it while compiling -- force-eager is always off there.
191 and (torch.compiler.is_compiling() or not _force_eager_attn.get())
192 ):
193 if kwargs.get("idx_q") is not None:
194 if is_in_breakable_cuda_graph():
195 return get_attn_backend().forward(
196 q, k, v, self, forward_batch, save_kv_cache, **kwargs
197 )
198 idx_q = kwargs["idx_q"]
199 idx_k = kwargs["idx_k"]
200 idx_v = kwargs.get("idx_v")
201 attn_out = q.new_empty(
202 (q.shape[0], self.tp_q_head_num * self.v_head_dim)
203 )
204 idx_out = q.new_empty((q.shape[0], idx_q.shape[1] * idx_q.shape[2]))
205 unified_sparse_attention_with_output(
206 q,
207 k,
208 v,
209 attn_out,
210 idx_out,
211 idx_q,
212 idx_k,
213 save_kv_cache,
214 self.layer_id,
215 idx_v=idx_v,
216 )
217 return idx_out, attn_out
218 # Output dtype follows v (the model dtype) when available: qk-norm
219 # may emit q in a different dtype without changing the dtype the
220 # backend writes. FP8 q/v (e.g. mxfp8 KV-cache attention) still
221 # produce a bf16 attention output; sizing the buffer off an fp8
222 # dtype would silently cast-copy the result to fp8.
223 out_dtype = v.dtype if v is not None else q.dtype
224 if out_dtype in (torch.float8_e4m3fn, torch.float8_e5m2):
225 out_dtype = torch.bfloat16
226 if self.qk_head_dim != self.v_head_dim:
227 output = q.new_empty(
228 (q.shape[0], self.tp_q_head_num * self.v_head_dim),
229 dtype=out_dtype,
230 )
231 else:
232 output = torch.empty_like(q, dtype=out_dtype)
233 if any(
234 key in kwargs
235 for key in (
236 "score_mod",
237 "aux_tensors",
238 "rel_bias",
239 "q_descale",
240 "k_descale",
241 "v_descale",
242 )
243 ):
244 # A score_mod callable, aux_tensors, rel_bias, or mxfp8 descale
245 # tensors can't cross the unified_attention_with_output custom-op
246 # schema; route this backend's extend attention through the plain
247 # eager path.
248 if is_in_breakable_cuda_graph():
249 breakable_attention_with_output_extra_kwargs(
250 q, k, v, output, save_kv_cache, self.layer_id, kwargs
251 )
252 else:
253 attention_with_output_extra_kwargs(
254 q, k, v, output, save_kv_cache, self.layer_id, kwargs
255 )
256 return output
257 # Chunked-prefix MHA needs LSE to merge independently normalized
258 # suffix and cached-prefix attention states.
259 return_lse = bool(forward_batch.mha_return_lse)
260 mha_companion_layers = context.mha_companion_layers
261 use_mha_companion = (
262 mha_companion_layers is not None
263 and mha_companion_layers[self.layer_id] is self
264 )
265 if is_in_breakable_cuda_graph():
266 op = (
267 breakable_unified_attention_with_output_and_lse
268 if return_lse
269 else breakable_unified_attention_with_output
270 )
271 else:
272 op = (
273 unified_attention_with_output_and_lse
274 if return_lse
275 else unified_attention_with_output
276 )
277 lse = op(
278 q,
279 k,
280 v,
281 output,
282 save_kv_cache,
283 self.layer_id,
284 use_mha_companion=use_mha_companion,
285 key_value_num_tokens=key_value_num_tokens,
286 **kwargs,
287 )
288 if return_lse:
289 return output.view(-1, self.tp_q_head_num, self.v_head_dim), lse
290 return output
291 else:
292 # NOTE 默认路径：交给注意力后端（FlashInfer / FA3 / Triton 等），先把本批 K/V 写到 out_cache_loc，再按 req_to_token 读历史 KV 算注意力
293 return get_attn_backend().forward(
294 q,
295 k,
296 v,
297 self,
298 forward_batch,
299 save_kv_cache,
300 **kwargs,
301 )

4.3.1 ReqToTokenPool

class ReqToTokenPool(object)
257"""A memory pool that maps a request to its token locations.
258
259NOTE req_to_token 保存请求槽位到 KV 编号的映射；实际 K/V 向量保存在 token_to_kv_pool。
260 示例：size=3（最多 3 个请求同时跑，_alloc_size=4 行）、max_context_len=6 的 req_to_token
261
262 每行是一个槽位，每列是一个 token 位置：
263 槽位 0：[ 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0] 预留行，不分配给请求；CUDA Graph 补齐的假请求读写这里
264 槽位 1：[ 7, 8, 9, 0, 0, 0] 请求 A「你好啊」，刚做完 prefill、还没生成回答，长度 3，后 3 列还没用
265 槽位 2：[ 7, 8, 9, 31, 32, 33] 请求 B「你好啊，在吗」，前 3 个复用 A 已缓存的「你好啊」的 KV 编号
266 槽位 3：[ 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0] 空闲槽位（在 free_slots 中），内容无意义
267
268 - free_slots = [3]：槽位 1、2 已被占用，槽位 0 永远不在里面
269 - 每行的有效长度由请求的 seq_len 决定，后面的列不读；KV 编号 0 也是保留的，不会分配给 token
270"""

4.3.1.1 __init__()

注释已读 · 原始行号 274–309
274def __init__(
275 self,
276 size: int, # 最大并行请求数量
277 max_context_len: int, # 每个请求预留的 token 数量
278 device: str,
279 enable_memory_saver: bool,
280):
281 """
282 NOTE req_to_token 形状为 [_alloc_size, max_context_len]，保存请求槽位、token 位置到 KV 编号的映射。
283 NOTE _alloc_size = size + 1；size 个真实请求槽位之外，编号 0 留给补齐的假请求。
284 """
285 memory_saver_adapter = TorchMemorySaverAdapter.create(
286 enable=enable_memory_saver
287 )
288
289 self.size = size
290 # +1 padding row at index 0: cuda-graph padded batches default
291 # req_pool_indices to 0, so dummy reads/writes land here harmlessly.
292 # NOTE size 个真实请求槽位，加上编号 0 的保留行。
293 self._alloc_size = size + 1
294 self.max_context_len = max_context_len
295 self.device = device
296 with memory_saver_adapter.region(GPU_MEMORY_TYPE_KV_CACHE):
297 # NOTE req_to_token 保存了 req slot 到 KV Index的映射
298 self.req_to_token = torch.zeros(
299 # NOTE 形状是 [_alloc_size, max_context_len]；_alloc_size 已包含编号 0 的保留行。
300 (self._alloc_size, max_context_len),
301 dtype=torch.int32,
302 device=device,
303 )
304
305 # NOTE 空闲 req slot 编号为 1 到 _alloc_size - 1，即 1 到 size。
306 self.free_slots = list(range(1, self._alloc_size))
307
308 self.req_generation = torch.zeros(self._alloc_size, dtype=torch.int64)
309 self._aux_cache: Any = None

4.3.1.2 alloc()

注释已读 · 原始行号 317–345
317def alloc(self, reqs: list[Req]) -> Optional[List[int]]:
318 """
319 NOTE 给 list[Req] 分配或复用 req slot，并保存到 req_pool_idx；这不是客户端 rid。
320 """
321 # Indices of reqs that already have a req_pool_idx and will reuse
322 # their existing slot (e.g. chunked prefill continuing across chunks).
323 reusing = [i for i, r in enumerate(reqs) if r.req_pool_idx is not None]
324 # NOTE: this check is relaxed temporarily
325 # https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/20476
326 # if not any(r.is_dllm() for r in reqs):
327 # assert (
328 # sum(1 for i in reusing if reqs[i].inflight_middle_chunks > 0) <= 1
329 # ), "only one chunked request may reuse req_pool_idx in a batch"
330 assert all(
331 reqs[i].inflight_middle_chunks > 0 or reqs[i].kv_committed_len > 0
332 for i in reusing
333 ), "reusing request must be chunked or have committed KV"
334
335 # NOTE
336 select_index = self.alloc_rows(len(reqs) - len(reusing))
337 if select_index is None:
338 return None
339 offset = 0
340 for r in reqs:
341 # NOTE 分配 req slot
342 if r.req_pool_idx is None:
343 r.req_pool_idx = select_index[offset]
344 offset += 1
345 return [r.req_pool_idx for r in reqs]

1899 swa_v_head_dim

1905 # HND folds (page, head) into one paged index for per-kv-head sparse page tables
1906 # (paged backends like trtllm_mha consume directly). vectorized_5d SHUFFLE 5D:
1907 # K: (num_blocks, H, D_k // X, page, X) V: (num_blocks, H, page // X, D_v, X),
1908 # X = 16 / dtype_bytes — AITER-only (ignored elsewhere, no consumer kernel).

2494 cache_k.stride(1),
2495 cache_v.stride(0),
2496 cache_v.stride(1),
2497 )
2498 return
2499
2500 if self.use_hnd:
2501 # A slot is [page, :, off, :] (not a contiguous row), so scatter by (page, off).
2502 k_buf = self.k_buffer[layer_id - self.start_layer]
2503 v_buf = self.v_buffer[layer_id - self.start_layer]
2504 pages = loc // self.page_size
2505 offs = loc % self.page_size
2506 k_buf[pages, :, offs, :] = cache_k
2507 v_buf[pages, :, offs, :] = cache_v
2508 return
2509
2510 self._store_kv_layer(layer_id - self.start_layer, loc, cache_k, cache_v)

4.4.3.2 inc_lock_ref()

注释已读 · 原始行号 637–659
637def inc_lock_ref(self, node: TreeNode) -> IncLockRefResult:
638 if self.disable: # 如果禁用了缓存
639 return IncLockRefResult(delta=0)
640
641 delta = 0
642 while node != self.root_node: # 如果当前节点不等于 root node
643 if node.lock_ref == 0: # NOTE 如果还没有被锁住
644 # NOTE
645 # len(node.key) 表示当前节点缓存的token数量，可能是多个
646 #
647 # 注意：
648 # 在普通前缀缓存路径中，KV 编号可按分配状态粗分为：
649 # 1. 空闲的；
650 # 2. 已分配但尚未纳入前缀树的：可已写入 K/V，也可正在等待本轮写入；
651 # 3. 进入缓存、在 RadixCache 前缀缓存中，总数是 evictable_size_ 和 protected_size_
652 # Scheduler.RadixCache 中可释放的 KV Index 减少 len(node.key)，被保护的 KV Index 相应增加
653 self.evictable_size_ -= len(node.key)
654 self.protected_size_ += len(node.key)
655 delta -= len(node.key) # tip 当前节点到父节点的 token 统计：仅仅统计 0 变 1 的 token 数量
656 node.lock_ref += 1 # 锁住 node 节点
657 self._update_leaf_status(node) # 将该节点从可被淘汰的叶子节点集合中移除
658 node = node.parent
659 return IncLockRefResult(delta=delta)

4.4.3.3 _update_leaf_status()

注释已读 · 原始行号 844–857
844def _update_leaf_status(self, node: TreeNode):
845 if node.evicted or node.lock_ref > 0: # tip inc_lock_ref 调用过来的时候 node.lock_ref > 0 为true
846 if node in self.evictable_leaves: # 如果入参 node 在 RadixCache 中可被淘汰的叶子节点中，则移除
847 self.evictable_leaves.remove(node)
848 return
849
850 for child in node.children.values():
851 if not child.evicted:
852 if node in self.evictable_leaves:
853 self.evictable_leaves.remove(node)
854 return
855
856 if node not in self.evictable_leaves:
857 self.evictable_leaves.add(node)

343def forward(
344 self,
345 input_ids,
346 hidden_states, # NOTE hidden_states * lm_head 也是在这个方法计算
347 lm_head: VocabParallelEmbedding,
348 logits_metadata: Union[LogitsMetadata, ForwardBatch],
349 aux_hidden_states: Optional[AuxHiddenStates] = None,
350 hidden_states_before_norm: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
351) -> LogitsProcessorOutput:
352 """
353 # 【重点】hidden_states 和 lm_head.weight（[vocab_size, hidden_size]）的转置矩阵相乘
354 # 先每个请求只取最后一个 token：[num_tokens, hidden_size] -> [请求数, hidden_size]
355 # [请求数, hidden_size] * [hidden_size, vocab_size] = [请求数, vocab_size] 获取每个请求对词表里所有 token 的分数
356 # 调用链路 self.logits_processor()
357 # -> LogitsProcessor.forward()
358 # -> _get_pruned_states()
359 # -> _get_logits()
360 # -> _compute_lm_head()：代码是 torch.matmul(hidden_states, lm_head.weight.T)
361 #
362 """
363 # Extract MIS indices before ForwardBatch → LogitsMetadata conversion
364 multi_item_delimiter_indices = None
365 if isinstance(logits_metadata, ForwardBatch):
366 multi_item_delimiter_indices = logits_metadata.multi_item_delimiter_indices
367 logits_metadata = LogitsMetadata.from_forward_batch(logits_metadata)
368
369 # Autotune dummy run discards this output. `is False` not `not`: None
370 # means no autotune pass, which must not skip. Placed before the MIS /
371 # DLLM / common dispatch so all three LM-head paths are skipped.
372 if _autotune_run_lm_head is False:
373 return LogitsProcessorOutput(next_token_logits=None)
374
375 # Multi-item scoring only for prefill-only requests with pre-computed indices.
376 if multi_item_delimiter_indices is not None and logits_metadata.is_prefill_only:
377 return self.compute_logprobs_for_multi_item_scoring(
378 input_ids,
379 hidden_states,
380 lm_head,
381 logits_metadata,
382 multi_item_delimiter_indices,
383 )
384
385 # Diffusion LLM only.
386 if logits_metadata.forward_mode.is_dllm_extend():
387 return self._get_dllm_logits(hidden_states, lm_head, logits_metadata)
388
389 # Get the last hidden states and last logits for the next token prediction
390 (
391 pruned_states,
392 pruned_states_before_norm,
393 aux_pruned_states,
394 sample_indices,
395 input_logprob_indices,
396 token_to_seq_idx,
397 ) = self._get_pruned_states(
398 hidden_states,
399 hidden_states_before_norm,
400 aux_hidden_states,
401 logits_metadata,
402 )
403
404 hidden_states_to_store = self._get_hidden_states_to_store(
405 hidden_states,
406 hidden_states_before_norm,
407 aux_hidden_states,
408 pruned_states,
409 pruned_states_before_norm,
410 aux_pruned_states,
411 sample_indices,
412 logits_metadata,
413 )
414 del hidden_states
415
416 if not logits_metadata.extend_return_logprob:
417 # Compute logits for both input and sampled tokens.
418 logits = self._get_logits(pruned_states, lm_head, logits_metadata)
419 sampled_logits = (
420 logits[sample_indices] if sample_indices is not None else logits
421 )
422
423 # Decode mode or extend mode without return_logprob.
424 return LogitsProcessorOutput(
425 next_token_logits=sampled_logits,
426 hidden_states=hidden_states_to_store,
427 mm_input_embeds=logits_metadata.mm_input_embeds,
428 )
429
430 logprobs_result, sampled_logits = self.input_logprob_processor.forward(
431 pruned_states=pruned_states,
432 sample_indices=sample_indices,
433 input_logprob_indices=input_logprob_indices,
434 token_to_seq_idx=token_to_seq_idx,
435 lm_head=lm_head,
436 get_logits_fn=self._get_logits,
437 logits_metadata=logits_metadata,
438 skip_chunking_for_dp_attn=self.do_tensor_parallel_all_gather_dp_attn,
439 )
440
441 logits_output = LogitsProcessorOutput(
442 next_token_logits=sampled_logits,
443 hidden_states=hidden_states_to_store,
444 mm_input_embeds=logits_metadata.mm_input_embeds,
445 )
446 logprobs_result.write_input_to(logits_output)
447 return logits_output

class Sampler(nn.Module)

5.2.1.1 forward()

注释已读 · 原始行号 98–249
98def forward(
99 self,
100 logits_output: LogitsProcessorOutput,
101 sampling_info: SamplingBatchInfo,
102 return_logprob: bool,
103 top_logprobs_nums: List[int],
104 token_ids_logprobs: List[List[int]],
105 positions: torch.Tensor,
106):
107 """Run a sampler & compute logprobs and update logits_output accordingly.
108 执行采样
109
110 Args:
111 logits_output: The logits from the model forward
112 sampling_info: Metadata for sampling
113 return_logprob: If set, store the output logprob information to
114 logits_output
115 top_logprobs_nums: Number of top lobprobs per sequence in a batch
116 token_ids_logprobs: Per-sequence list of specific token IDs to retrieve
117 logprobs for. Each element is a list of token IDs (or None) for one
118 sequence in the batch. This is used in speculative decoding.
119 positions: The positions of the tokens in the sequence. Used for deterministic sampling
120 to get the unique seed for each position.
121 """
122 logits = logits_output.next_token_logits
123
124 if _is_hip and logits.shape[0] == 0:
125 return torch.empty((0,), dtype=torch.int64, device=logits.device)
126
127 # Preprocess logits (custom processors and NaN handling)
128 logits = self._preprocess_logits(logits, sampling_info)
129 return_sampling_mask = any(sampling_info.return_sampling_masks or [])
130
131 if sampling_info.is_all_greedy:
132 if _use_aiter and not _disable_aiter_greedy_sample:
133 batch_next_token_ids = torch.empty(
134 logits.shape[0], device=logits.device, dtype=torch.int32
135 )
136 _aiter_greedy_sample(batch_next_token_ids, logits)
137 else:
138 batch_next_token_ids = torch.argmax(logits, -1)
139 if return_sampling_mask:
140 self._attach_greedy_sampling_mask_to_output(
141 logits_output, sampling_info, batch_next_token_ids
142 )
143 if return_logprob:
144 original_logprobs = logprobs = torch.nn.functional.log_softmax(
145 logits, dim=-1
146 )
147 else:
148 simple_sampling_case = (
149 not sampling_info.need_top_p_sampling
150 and not sampling_info.need_top_k_sampling
151 and not sampling_info.need_min_p_sampling
152 )
153
154 # If requested, cache original logprobs before temperature scaling.
155 if return_logprob and SGLANG_RETURN_ORIGINAL_LOGPROB:
156 original_logprobs = torch.log_softmax(logits, dim=-1)
157
158 # In RL on-policy mode, we use log_softmax to compute logprobs to match the trainer.
159 logprobs_via_logsoftmax_kernel = None
160 if self.rl_on_policy_target is not None:
161 # TODO: use more inplace ops to save memory
162 logits_div_temperature = (
163 logits.bfloat16().div(sampling_info.temperatures).bfloat16()
164 )
165 logprobs_via_logsoftmax_kernel = torch.log_softmax(
166 logits_div_temperature, dim=-1
167 )
168 del logits_div_temperature
169
170 if self.use_ascend_backend:
171 # Ascend backend: sample from logits directly.
172 batch_next_token_ids, logprobs = self._forward_ascend_backend(
173 logits,
174 sampling_info,
175 simple_sampling_case,
176 return_logprob,
177 positions,
178 )
179 elif (
180 self.use_log_softmax_logprob
181 and self.enable_deterministic
182 and simple_sampling_case
183 ):
184 # RL on-policy path: sample from logprobs to match the trainer.
185 batch_next_token_ids = self._sample_from_logprobs(
186 logprobs_via_logsoftmax_kernel,
187 sampling_info,
188 positions,
189 )
190 if return_logprob and not SGLANG_RETURN_ORIGINAL_LOGPROB:
191 logprobs = logprobs_via_logsoftmax_kernel
192 else:
193 # Standard path: do softmax and sample from probs.
194 logits.div_(sampling_info.temperatures)
195
196 # Deterministic inference must derive the returned logprobs
197 # from F.log_softmax — the same kernel prefill rescoring uses —
198 # not log(softmax(x)) below: the two disagree at ~1e-6 despite
199 # being mathematically equivalent, which breaks bitwise
200 # prefill/decode logprob alignment.
201 if (
202 return_logprob
203 and self.enable_deterministic
204 and logprobs_via_logsoftmax_kernel is None
205 and not SGLANG_RETURN_ORIGINAL_LOGPROB
206 ):
207 logprobs_via_logsoftmax_kernel = torch.nn.functional.log_softmax(
208 logits, dim=-1
209 )
210
211 # In-place op to save memory
212 logits[:] = torch.softmax(logits, dim=-1)
213 probs = logits
214
215 batch_next_token_ids = self._sample_from_probs(
216 probs, sampling_info, positions, simple_sampling_case
217 )
218 if return_sampling_mask:
219 sampling_mask_data = self._compute_sampling_mask_from_probs(
220 probs, sampling_info
221 )
222 self._attach_sampling_mask_to_output(
223 logits_output,
224 sampling_info,
225 batch_next_token_ids,
226 sampling_mask_data,
227 )
228 if return_logprob and not SGLANG_RETURN_ORIGINAL_LOGPROB:
229 logprobs = (
230 logprobs_via_logsoftmax_kernel
231 if logprobs_via_logsoftmax_kernel is not None
232 else torch.log(probs)
233 )
234 del probs
235
236 if return_logprob:
237 if SGLANG_RETURN_ORIGINAL_LOGPROB:
238 logprobs = original_logprobs
239 logprob_result = self.output_logprob_processor.compute_logprobs(
240 logprobs,
241 top_logprobs_nums,
242 token_ids_logprobs,
243 batch_next_token_ids,
244 )
245 logprob_result.write_output_to(logits_output)
246
247 self._sync_token_ids_across_tp(batch_next_token_ids, sampling_info)
248
249 return batch_next_token_ids

230def trim_matched_stop(
231 self, output: Union[str, List[int]], finished_reason: Dict, no_stop_trim: bool
232):
233 if not finished_reason:
234 return output
235
236 matched = finished_reason.get("matched", None)
237 if not matched:
238 return output
239
240 # TODO(lmzheng): handle the case where multiple stop strs are hit
241
242 # Trim stop str.
243 if isinstance(matched, str) and isinstance(output, str):
244 pos = output.find(matched)
245 if pos == -1:
246 return output
247 end = pos + len(matched)
248 return output[:end] if no_stop_trim else output[:pos]
249
250 # Trim stop token.
251 if isinstance(matched, int) and isinstance(output, list):
252 if no_stop_trim:
253 return output
254 # 200012 <|call|> is the tool call token and one of eos tokens for gpt-oss model
255 if output[-1] == 200012 and self.is_tool_call_parser_gpt_oss:
256 return output
257 assert len(output) > 0
258 # NOTE: We can always assume the last token is the matched stop token
259 return output[:-1]
260 return output

5.3.1.9 _clamp_decode_ids()

注释已读 · 原始行号 267–280
267@staticmethod
268def _clamp_decode_ids(ids: List[int], vocab_size: Optional[int]) -> List[int]:
269 """Map out-of-range token ids to 0 so the tokenizer can decode them.
270 把不在词表范围内的 token ID（负数，或者大于等于词表大小的）换成 0，免得分词器解码时报错
271
272 Multimodal placeholder ids (e.g. Inkling's negative -101/-102, or radix-cache
273 pad-value hashes) are not real vocab tokens; tiktoken-style backends raise
274 OverflowError on negative / out-of-range ids. These only appear in the
275 surrogate-context prefix (before read_offset) and carry no text, and the clamp
276 is applied identically to surr_ids and read_ids, so the incremental
277 (read-minus-surr) output text is unchanged.
278 """
279 hi = vocab_size if vocab_size else None
280 return [t if (0 <= t and (hi is None or t < hi)) else 0 for t in ids]

5.3.1.10 _grouped_batch_decode()

注释已读 · 原始行号 282–358
282def _grouped_batch_decode(
283 self,
284 ids_list: List[List[int]],
285 skip_list: List[bool],
286 space_list: List[bool],
287) -> List[str]:
288 """Batch decode with grouping by (skip_special_tokens, spaces_between_special_tokens).
289 """
290 n = len(ids_list)
291 if n == 0:
292 return []
293 logger.info(
294 f"[detok-debug] 输入 n={n} ids_list={ids_list} skip={skip_list} space={space_list}"
295 )
296
297 # Empty token spans decode to "" but tokenizer.batch_decode (and the
298 # slow per-row decode_without_hf_kwargs path) still pays per-row
299 # overhead; under high-concurrency streaming this adds up. Filter
300 # empties out, decode the rest, then scatter back.
301 keep_idx: Optional[List[int]] = None
302 if not all(ids_list):
303 keep_idx = [i for i, ids in enumerate(ids_list) if ids]
304 if not keep_idx:
305 logger.info(f"[detok-debug] 全部为空，直接返回 {n} 个空串")
306 return [""] * n
307 ids_list = [ids_list[i] for i in keep_idx]
308 skip_list = [skip_list[i] for i in keep_idx]
309 space_list = [space_list[i] for i in keep_idx]
310 logger.info(f"[detok-debug] keep_idx={keep_idx}（None 表示没有空列表）")
311
312 if not getattr(self.tokenizer, "is_fast", False):
313 logger.info("[detok-debug] 分支：slow tokenizer，逐条 decode_without_hf_kwargs")
314 decoded = [
315 decode_without_hf_kwargs(self.tokenizer, ids, skip)
316 for ids, skip in zip(ids_list, skip_list)
317 ]
318 else:
319 # fast path: all rows share the same (skip, space) flags. NOTE 走这里
320 first_skip, first_space = skip_list[0], space_list[0]
321 if all(
322 s == first_skip and sp == first_space
323 for s, sp in zip(skip_list, space_list)
324 ):
325 # NOTE NOTE NOTE 结果 tokenID -> 输出文本
326 logger.info(
327 f"[detok-debug] 分支：fast，选项相同，一次 batch_decode（skip={first_skip}, space={first_space}）"
328 )
329 decoded = self.tokenizer.batch_decode(
330 ids_list,
331 skip_special_tokens=first_skip,
332 spaces_between_special_tokens=first_space,
333 )
334 else:
335 # Group indices by (skip, space) tuple and decode each group.
336 groups: Dict[Tuple[bool, bool], List[int]] = defaultdict(list)
337 for idx, (skip, space) in enumerate(zip(skip_list, space_list)):
338 groups[(skip, space)].append(idx)
339 logger.info(f"[detok-debug] 分支：fast，选项不同，按组 batch_decode groups={dict(groups)}")
340
341 decoded = [""] * len(ids_list)
342 for (skip, space), indices in groups.items():
343 group_decoded = self.tokenizer.batch_decode(
344 [ids_list[idx] for idx in indices],
345 skip_special_tokens=skip,
346 spaces_between_special_tokens=space,
347 )
348 for idx, text in zip(indices, group_decoded):
349 decoded[idx] = text
350
351 if keep_idx is None:
352 logger.info(f"[detok-debug] 输出 results={decoded}")
353 return decoded
354 results = [""] * n
355 for i, text in zip(keep_idx, decoded):
356 results[i] = text
357 logger.info(f"[detok-debug] 输出 decoded={decoded} → 放回原位 results={results}")
358 return results

5.3.1.11 _decode_batch_token_id_output()

注释已读 · 原始行号 360–485
360def _decode_batch_token_id_output(self, recv_obj: BatchTokenIDOutput):
361 """增量解码，surr_ids / read_ids 的用法详见 detokenizer_manager.py._decode_batch_token_id_output.md"""
362 bs = len(recv_obj.rids)
363 vocab_size = self.vocab_size
364
365 # Initialize decode status
366 # 【Step 2.1】维护 decode_status[rid]：取或建 DecodeStatus，追加本次新 token；Scheduler 每次只发新增的部分
367 read_ids, surr_ids = [], []
368 for i in range(bs):
369 rid = recv_obj.rids[i]
370 # 每个请求第一个结果token返回回走到这个分支
371 if rid not in self.decode_status:
372 s = DecodeStatus(
373 decoded_text=recv_obj.decoded_texts[i], # recv_obj.decoded_texts[i] 在这里还是空字符串
374 decode_ids=self._clamp_decode_ids( # 对 decode_ids 做无害处理后赋值给 DecodeStatus
375 recv_obj.decode_ids[i], vocab_size
376 ),
377 surr_offset=0,
378 read_offset=recv_obj.read_offsets[i],
379 )
380 self.decode_status[rid] = s # NOTE 创建 rid 到结果的映射
381 else:
382 s = self.decode_status[rid]
383 s.decode_ids.extend( # 已有该 rid 的 DecodeStatus：把本次新 token ID 追加到 decode_ids 末尾，后面基于它做增量解码
384 self._clamp_decode_ids(recv_obj.decode_ids[i], vocab_size)
385 )
386
387 read_ids.append(
388 self.trim_matched_stop(
389 s.decode_ids[s.surr_offset :],
390 recv_obj.finished_reasons[i],
391 recv_obj.no_stop_trim[i],
392 )
393 )
394 surr_ids.append(s.decode_ids[s.surr_offset : s.read_offset])
395
396 # Decode token ids to strings
397 # 【Step 2.2】整批解码 surr_ids 和 read_ids
398 if not self.disable_tokenizer_batch_decode:
399 # NOTE 默认走 batch
400 surr_texts = self._grouped_batch_decode(
401 surr_ids,
402 recv_obj.skip_special_tokens,
403 recv_obj.spaces_between_special_tokens,
404 )
405 read_texts = self._grouped_batch_decode(
406 read_ids,
407 recv_obj.skip_special_tokens,
408 recv_obj.spaces_between_special_tokens,
409 )
410 else:
411 # Do not use batch decode to prevent some detokenization edge cases (e.g., gpt-oss).
412 surr_texts = [
413 self.tokenizer.decode(
414 surr, skip_special_tokens=skip, spaces_between_special_tokens=space
415 )
416 for surr, skip, space in zip(
417 surr_ids,
418 recv_obj.skip_special_tokens,
419 recv_obj.spaces_between_special_tokens,
420 )
421 ]
422 read_texts = [
423 self.tokenizer.decode(
424 read, skip_special_tokens=skip, spaces_between_special_tokens=space
425 )
426 for read, skip, space in zip(
427 read_ids,
428 recv_obj.skip_special_tokens,
429 recv_obj.spaces_between_special_tokens,
430 )
431 ]
432
433 # Incremental decoding
434 # 【Step 2.3】取差值得到新文本；未结束时推进偏移，结束时删除状态并补发剩余文本
435 output_strs = []
436 for i in range(bs):
437 rid = recv_obj.rids[i]
438 try:
439 s = self.decode_status[rid]
440 except KeyError:
441 raise RuntimeError(
442 f"Decode status not found for request {rid}. "
443 "It may be due to the request being evicted from the decode status due to memory pressure. "
444 "Please increase the maximum number of requests by setting "
445 "the SGLANG_DETOKENIZER_MAX_STATES environment variable to a bigger value than the default value. "
446 f"The current value is {DETOKENIZER_MAX_STATES}. "
447 "For more details, see: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/2812"
448 )
449 new_text = read_texts[i][len(surr_texts[i]) :]
450 if recv_obj.finished_reasons[i] is None:
451 # Streaming. Invariant: sent_offset >= decoded_text_len. The
452 # gap (`pending`) is "printable but uncommitted" text emitted
453 # in a prior "\ufffd" recovery step; we skip it from this step's
454 # emission so we don't double-send.
455 pending = s.sent_offset - s.decoded_text_len
456 if new_text and not new_text.endswith("\ufffd"):
457 # Clean text: commit to decoded_text and advance offsets.
458 s.append_decoded_text(new_text)
459 s.surr_offset = s.read_offset
460 s.read_offset = len(s.decode_ids)
461 s.sent_offset = s.decoded_text_len
462 output_strs.append(new_text[pending:] if pending else new_text)
463 else:
464 # Incomplete UTF-8: emit the printable prefix only; do not
465 # commit (token offsets stay so the next iteration retries
466 # with more tokens).
467 printable = find_printable_text(new_text)
468 s.sent_offset = s.decoded_text_len + len(printable)
469 output_strs.append(printable[pending:] if pending else printable)
470 continue
471
472 if rid in self.decode_status:
473 del self.decode_status[rid]
474
475 # Finished: materialize once, trim the matched stop, emit the tail.
476 output_str = self.trim_matched_stop(
477 s.get_decoded_text() + new_text,
478 recv_obj.finished_reasons[i],
479 recv_obj.no_stop_trim[i],
480 )
481 incremental_output = output_str[s.sent_offset :]
482 s.sent_offset = len(output_str)
483 output_strs.append(incremental_output)
484
485 return output_strs

class DecodeStatus(object)
76"""
77 Store the status of incremental(increases in value or worth, often by a regular amount) decoding.
78 GPU 输出 token ID → 追加到 decode_ids → 解码成新文本放进 decoded_text_chunks → 请求结束时合并进 decoded_text
79"""
